title: MineTap Merge Clicker
description:
MineTap is an idle clicker with merge mechanics and crafting. Also there is an adventure, where you can fight zombies and other monsters and even build your own village!

Enjoy mining and treasure hunting. Complete quests and level up your character. Craft your ultimate weapon and slay epic monsters!
Have you ever had a dream to be a hero and save the world? Then tap to play and become a legend of crafting.
Start your epic mining adventure right now - click, tap & rock!

title: Mickey Run Adventure Game
description:
Welcome to the great kingdom craft! prepare yourself brave mickey, get ready to run, jump, dash and rush through the kingdom.
In this craft game, you will be a runner who has to run and collect coins in an endless runner game mine. You need to be very careful as there will be many mouse in your way. You will need to use your craft Mickey and reflexes to avoid them and keep running. There will also be power-ups that you can collect to help you in the craft game.

title: Arrow Tap Puzzle
description: Arrows fill the board like traffic at a silent crossing. Some lanes are open, others blocked. Remove arrows one by one, avoid blocked paths and keep your daily streak alive. Solve the arrangement in front of you, then step into another.

title: Age of Zombies
description:
Age of Zombies, the nostalgic and thrilling twin-stick shooter, takes you through time to save the world from the undead menace with Barry Steakfries!  Age of Zombies is delivering pure, unadulterated fun with an unforgettable cast of characters.

Experience a lighthearted, action-packed story that spans 24 levels across 8 diverse worlds. Confront 7 unique bosses, encounter a variety of zombie types, and compete in 12 Horde levels for a spot on the leaderboards.

title: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship
description: Truck Simulator Arcade Championship is an exhilarating truck racing game that combines the intensity of high-speed competition with the precision of driving massive, powerful trucks. This game offers an action-packed arcade-style experience where players take control of different types of trucks and compete in various challenging racing events across diverse tracks and terrains.

title: Build A Queen 2025
description: In Build a Queen 2025, you will embark on a fun journey to become a real queen. You will need to make your way through different platform levels with your opponents. Choose outfits, skin colors, and more according to your goals. Dress up in the most glamorous queen look, meet the prince, and win. You can collect money to unlock more dance steps.

title: Tricky Life
description:
Welcome to Tricky Life, the funniest brain test puzzle game ever made!
Here, logic meets laughter every level is designed to make you giggle, think twice, and smile when you finally find the answer.

title: Clay Craft Tycoon
description: Clay Craft Tycoon is a fun factory management game where you build and grow your own clay production business. Process raw clay, craft products like pots, plates, and cups, store them in your warehouse, and sell to outside markets. Complete daily tasks, earn cash at every stage, and expand your factory with new production units to become the ultimate clay tycoon!

title: Puzzle Blocks
description:
Race against time in tense speed battles, employ tactical thinking in rescue missions, and unwind by creating massive structures in free-play mode. Hone your skills assembling perfect puzzles or challenge the ever-accelerating chaos.

Puzzle Blocks is more than a game; it's a curated collection of perfectly crafted puzzles for any mood. The world of puzzles awaits its hero. Can you conquer every challenge?

title: Merge Magnat - IDeaL Store
description: Welcome to the world of trade, where you can create your own shopping district! In this engaging game, you will build the area by placing various shops and attracting customers who will spend money. Merge similar shops to create higher-level versions that yield more profit. Watch as customers pass by your stores, leaving money while you relax and enjoy the game.

title: Choo Choo Spider Monster Train
description:
Welcome to the most terrifying train ride of your life!
Cho-Cho Scary Charles: Spider Train is a chilling open-world survival horror shooter where your only lifeline is a small yellow train armed with a machine gun and a whole lot of courage.
Face off against Charles — the monstrous spider-train hybrid that haunts a remote island, preying on unsuspecting humans. No one knows where he came from, but one thing is clear — he won't stop until he's fed.

title: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City
description: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City throws you into a thrilling sandbox of chaos and destruction. Explore a vast, deserted city where every street is your testing ground. Drive, crash, and experiment with powerful vehicles while mastering realistic physics and dynamic crash effects. Whether you’re speeding down empty highways or performing daring stunts, this game lets you push every car — and your reflexes — to the limit.

title: Domino Solitaire
description: Experience the free online Domino Solitaire challenge with 90 engaging levels! Match domino tiles to clear the board and sharpen your mind in this addictive puzzle game. With sleek graphics, intuitive controls, and unlimited play, Domino Solitaire offers hours of brain-teasing fun. Use strategy to connect matching ends, tap the closed pile for new tiles, and unleash wild domino power-ups when you’re stuck. Perfect for desktop and mobile, this single-player game tests your matching skills.

title: Perfect Shot
description:
Step into Perfect Pocket, a unique puzzle game inspired by classic pool, but with a twist – you only get one shot to clear each level! Test your aim, plan your angles, and pocket all balls in a single move. 
Game Highlights :- 
One-Shot Levels: Every level challenges you to pocket all balls with just one shot. 
Realistic Physics: Feel the true motion and collision of balls. Many Unique Levels: Each with different layouts and increasing difficulty.

title: Rocket Sky!
description: In Rocket Sky! you tap and hold the screen to launch your rocket as far into the sky as you can. Make sure not to overheat though, otherwise it’s game over!

title: Archers Random
description:
Archers Random is a fast-paced stickman archery game that tests your reflexes and aim.

Fight endless enemy waves, explore new areas, and earn coins to unlock helmets, armor, and triple arrows. Upgrade speed, damage, health, and arm power, master 12 special arrows like fire, poison, rocket, and electric, face epic bosses, and survive nonstop action.

Play solo or challenge a friend in 2 Player mode on the same device for intense head-to-head battles.

title: Space Craft: Ship War
description:
Explore deep space, piloting a cubic ship that can be infinitely expanded with modules. Collect new decks, melee and ranged weapons, boosters, and rare upgrades on the map, transforming your ship into a true battle station. Enemies also grow, making every encounter a dynamic battle for survival.

Complete levels, upgrade your stats, unlock new skins, and experiment with builds. Vibrant 3D graphics, rich effects, and constant progression make space battles exciting and unpredictable.

title: Grass Land
description: Grass Land is a vibrant exploration game that drops you into a sprawling world of thick greenery and hidden surprises. Take control of your grass cutter, uncover valuable resources beneath the overgrowth, and build up your base as you roam the fields. Stay sharp, move fast, and make the most of every patch of grass you find.

title: Obby Football Soccer 3D
description:
Online football / soccer and real sport — play with friends or random opponents.
Penalties and matches — score amazing goals, save shots, and become your team’s hero.
Obby challenges — train your reaction and speed while passing football obstacles.
Colorful 3D graphics and the atmosphere of a real stadium.

Go from rookie to champion. Prove that you are the best player in the world of football and sport.

title: Two Stunt Racers
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning sports car through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Childcare Master Online
description: Get ready to become a parenting superstar in Childcare Master Online! This wonderful casual simulation game is all about playing the role of a top parenting expert. As soon as you start the game, you'll find yourself in a lively daycare center with adorable kids. What's your mission? Give them love and care! First, you need to create a warm environment.

title: 2048 Merge Circle
description: 2048 Merge Circle is a fun and addictive number puzzle game with a twist! Rotate the circle, aim carefully, and shoot numbered balls to merge them. Combine matching numbers to upgrade them until you reach the ultimate goal—2048! It's a fresh take on the classic 2048 game with smooth mechanics and satisfying merges. Great for fans of casual games, brain teasers, and relaxing challenges.

title: Travel Mahjong Deluxe
description: Travel Mahjong Deluxe is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle where you match identical tiles and strategically clear the board. Find pairs of beautiful travel-themed tiles that are free on at least one side and remove them to complete each level. As you progress, new layouts and challenges will keep the game fresh and engaging. Use the Hint feature whenever you get stuck, or watch a reward video to gain unlimited time and continue your puzzle-solving adventure.

title: Forest Survivor Rougelike
description: Forest Survivor Roguelike is an addictive simulator adventure game that throws you into a dangerous forest. Only the strongest survivor can survive. From the very first moment, you must fight, explore, and adapt to stay alive in this intense roguelike world. Every step in the forest is a new challenge.

title: BFFs Luxury Loungewear
description: Get ready to style your way to comfort in the BFFs Luxury Loungewear game! Join the fun with Riri, Elsa, Polka, and Bonnie, each with a unique wardrobe. Choose from jersey cotton, knitted, velour, or silk sleepwear and accessories to create stylish sleepover outfits. Exercise your fashion skills and make every slumber party a plush, luxury affair. This game is perfect for budding fashionistas and dress-up game enthusiasts alike!

title: Earth Defender
description:
Earth Defender is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a spaceship orbiting around planet Earth. Deadly meteors are flying toward the planet, and it's your mission to stop them before they crash into Earth.

Your ship circles the planet. Time your moves carefully and collide with incoming meteors to destroy them

Tap to change your orbit direction and intercept as many meteors as possible. Survive the meteor storm and defend Earth for as long as you can!

title: Arrow Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced and strategic arrow challenge in Arrow Escape, an addictive arrows puzzle escape game built for players who love logic puzzles and intense puzzle escape moments.

title: MeatRider
description: Welcome to "MeatRider" — an intense action-packed game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. You find yourself right in the middle of the chaos, where your only goal is to survive at all costs. Choose one of the unique combat vehicles, each with its own special abilities and weapons, and get ready for dynamic battles across a zombie-infested desert landscape.

title: GT Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills?

title: Noob: Skyblock Survival
description:
Welcome to the game Noob: Skyblock Survival!

Noob: Skyblock Survival is a sandbox survival game on an island in the style of Minecraft, where you need to dig blocks.

Features of the game:
- Dig blocks
- Plant trees and wheat
- Survive on a cube island
- Expand your island, and then fight zombies!

Remember, you are a cool cube digger and you must survive!

If you liked our game "Noob: Skyblock Survival", then rate it and write a review, and also play our other games about Noob.

title: Seat Puzzle Cut The Rope
description: Face a wildly satisfying brain challenge in Seat Puzzle - Cut The Rope. This addictive puzzle game blends smart logic with relaxing casual gameplay, creating the perfect experience for those who love thinking fast and solving clever challenges! In each level, chairs are bound by ropes. Your task is to cut the ropes according to the passengers' colors.

title: Hidden Horrors
description: Ready to explore the haunted Halloween world? Play a hidden object game with 30 Halloween levels. Each level has 6 hidden objects. Find all objects before time runs out. If you need help, use a hint. The game is easy to play. Enjoy colorful Halloween scenes and fun gameplay.

title: ARROW OUT AND LINKER
description:
ARROW OUT AND LINKER is a smart, direction-based puzzle game where every move counts. Your mission is to guide the arrow through intricate mazes and lead it to the exit.

Rotate tiles, shift paths, and think several steps ahead to build the perfect route. Each decision shapes the outcome, rewarding careful planning and shap logic.

title: Yummy Trails
description: Can you help the hungry snake navigate the tastiest trail of all? The path may be tricky, but the reward is delicious. Test your brain and relax.

title: Mind Gambit
description: Mind Gambit is a relaxing puzzle game inspired by the classic Peg Solitaire. Plan your moves carefully to jump and remove pegs until only one remains. There’s no timer, just pure strategy and thoughtful gameplay. With unlimited levels, the challenge never ends.

title: Cozy Garden Idle
description: Unwind with this soothing and adorable place. Reveal, pick, and nurture attractive plants to extend your garden and provide more oxygen!

title: BMG: CrashDay 2025
description: The game "BMG: CrashDay 2025" is an arcade racing simulator that combines elements of action and realism. Players can choose from a variety of cars, each with its own unique characteristics and appearance. The game has various tracks, each with its own features, such as difficult turns, steep climbs and descents, as well as various obstacles.

title: Bounce Dunk Basketball
description: Love basketball? Want to master the art of bouncing and dunking? In Bounce Dunk - Basketball, you must skillfully control the balls bounce to make perfect shots and get high scores. Tap the screen to control the angle and strength of the basketball so that the ball bounces perfectly into the basket. Or destroy enemies, get coins, etc.

title: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds
description:
Dodge and shoot to survive 15 seconds! Master 40 levels of arrow chaos in this fast-paced pixel art platformer! 

Dive into Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds, a thrilling 2D pixel art platformer where every second counts! As a skilled archer, your mission is to survive 15 seconds per level by dodging deadly hazards and strategically firing arrows.

title: Happy Monsters 2
description:
A bundle of fun games designed for children of all ages that will delight everyone!

Our little monsters love to play all sorts of games where you collect coins. Help them gather as many as possible to unlock all the toys. Complete the entire toy collection!

title: My Pet Care Salon
description: My Pet Care Salon invites you to run your very own pet spa! Groom, pamper, and style a variety of adorable pets with fun, interactive activities. From bath time and nail trimming to trendy haircuts and accessory styling, provide the best care for your furry clients. Manage your salon, meet different pets, and earn rewards as you create a welcoming environment for pets and their owners. Transform your pet care dreams into reality and become the ultimate pet stylist!

title: Sudoku Relax
description: Sudoku Relax is a fresh take on the world-famous sudoku puzzle that you can enjoy anytime and anywhere. This free sudoku game keeps the classic rules but adds a clean, colorful design and smooth controls, making it ideal for both beginners and seasoned puzzle lovers. Simply fill the grid with numbers from 1 to 9 without repeating them in any row, column, or 3×3 square. Train your brain, challenge yourself, and enjoy one of the most beloved logic games in the world with Sudoku Relax!

title: Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting
description: Ready to become the coldest, deadliest sniper in the entire city? Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting is a FPS action shooting simulator where you complete high-risk missions. Use powerful guns to eliminate dangerous mafia targets.

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: X to Y: Almost Impossible!
description: X to Y is a fast-paced precision platform skill game focused on timing, reflexes, and speed control. Guide X through dangerous obstacles, traps, and tight spaces to reach Y. Every move requires perfect acceleration and sharp reactions — one mistake and you fail. Earn up to 3 stars per level to unlock new worlds, including dark mode challenges, auto-movement stages, and physics-based puzzles.

title: Mega Shark
description: One shark and a sea full of delicious fish. How hungry are you? You’ve got 60 seconds to prove it! Feed nonstop, survive the deepest waters and rely on your shark’s speed, strength and invincibility to complete each hunt. Collect coins and trophies to unlock and explore new stages.

title: Labubu and Treasures: Fun Adventure
description: Collect bright combinations, pass hundreds of levels together with amazing characters from the Labubu universe! In this exciting Match-3 puzzle you will find bright adventures, interesting puzzles and fluffy magic.

title: Capybara Screw Jam
description: Welcome to Capybara Screw Jam! This is a cute and brain-teasing puzzle game. You’ll join a lovable capybara on a journey of problem-solving and strategy. With simple gameplay and increasing challenges, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves casual puzzles and brain workouts. Your goal is to help the capybara solve various puzzle challenges. Each level presents various colors of capybara.

title: Cubatoria Merge 2048
description:
Welcome to the exciting world of Cubatoria Merge 2048! This game combines elements of the classic 2048 game with a three-dimensional visual design, which makes it unique and exciting.

The game is designed for fans of puzzles, logic games and those who appreciate a creative approach to classic concepts. Cubatoria Merge 2048 promises an exciting immersion in virtual space with the opportunity to enjoy a new visual experience.

title: Block Combo Blast
description: Enjoy a classic block puzzle game with exciting jewel blast gameplay and stunning visuals! Solve 1800+ challenging levels, earn combos, and climb the global leaderboard. Train your brain, relax with soothing sounds, and compete with friends for the top spot!

title: Basketball Rush
description: This isn’t just about shooting — it's about precision, patience and strategy. As you score, the game intensifies, but with helpful power-ups at your disposal, you’ll be ready for anything. Unlock a variety of unique ball skins to customize your game and add even more excitement.

title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
description: Welcome to the Y2K style fashion world! Two charismatic heroines are waiting for you, ready to try on fashion trends from the 2000s. Create spectacular makeup for them with lip gloss, shining shadows and glossy skin; choose stylish hairstyles - from smooth straight hair to playful ponytails and fashionable hairpins. Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.

title: Block Puzzle Tropical Story
description: Discover a new genre in the world of puzzles! This game intertwines block puzzles with a thrilling adventure on tropical islands! Complete levels to earn stars, unlock new territories and unique relaxation areas. From snow-white beaches to dense jungles – each location is filled with unique challenges. The booster system will help you in difficult situations, and the well-thought-out mechanics allow both beginners and experienced players to enjoy the game.

title: Sandbox - Destroy the Ragdoll
description:
Ready to destroy and earn? In this sandbox clicker, it's simple: choose your weapon, attack characters, and get paid for the damage you deal. The stronger your attacks, the bigger the reward!  

Use different tactics, unlock new gear, and upgrade your firepower. The further you go, the more powerful the weapons and the greater the possibilities. Ready to become the strongest fighter? Then tap, destroy, and earn!

title: Strykon
description:
Strykon is a mobile FPS game with exciting missions and battles. Play different modes like Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Free-for-All, where your goal is to survive.
Choose from many weapons, like pistols, rifles, shotguns, and snipers. Each gun has its own style. Enjoy great graphics, realistic sound, and easy controls. Earn rewards with the Battle Pass to keep the game interesting. Whether you complete missions or fight enemies, this shooter is full of action anytime, anywhere!

title: Sweet Triple Mahjong
description: Sweet Triple Mahjong is a relaxing yet challenging tile-matching puzzle game with a delicious candy theme. Match three identical tiles that are free on the left or right to collect them and clear the board. Each level introduces new tile layouts that test your observation and strategy skills. Easy to learn but hard to master, Sweet Triple Mahjong offers smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and satisfying progression across multiple levels.

title: Block Sniper
description:
Pixelated sniper action game where you have to complete various missions in a blocky world. 
Game where you are a sniper who performs various missions in a block-based world.

title: Italian Brainrot Bike Rush
description: Hop on for chaotic fun in Italian Brainrot Bike Rush, a meme-filled obby bike platformer. Pick from 5 absurd meme legends and ride through floating platforms, deadly traps, and wild jumps. Play 5 levels across 3 modes—Normal, Challenge, and One Life. Collect coins, unlock checkpoints, and conquer brainrot chaos. Perfect for fans of meme-based bike racing and Italian brainrot platformers!

title: Feed me Monsters! Idle Battle
description: The fate of the world is in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and become a beacon of hope in a land filled with darkness?

title: Live Star Doll Dress Up
description: Discover the makeover world of fashion and fun in Live Star Doll Dress Up Games! Immerse yourself in an interactive magic princess universe! In this dress-up anime simulator, you're in charge. Dress up your doll in trendy outfits. Get creative with makeup and personalize your cute doll!

title: Fish Kingdom
description: Our game will show you in all the beauty of the real sea world. A world in which life is booming, because it is inhabited by sea creatures, mermaids, shells, plankton and many other amazing creatures of the sea world!

title: Catch Thief
description: Catch Thief is an addictive puzzle game where you must outsmart a clever thief and stop his escape. Take control of the police, block every possible path and drive the criminal into a dead end. With each new level the challenge grows, requiring you to plan ahead, think strategically and act quickly. Bright cartoon graphics, fun scenarios and increasing difficulty make Catch Thief a perfect choice for fans of logic games who enjoy testing their skills, attention and reaction speed.

title: Clicker Hero
description: Click on the screen to defeat the monsters and earn gold in Clicker Hero. Spend your gold to buy and upgrade heroes that deal damage automatically. Then advance to fight tougher monsters that drop more gold. This game keeps going, even when you're offline, so come back later to earn and spend even more!

title: Stickman Rescue Draw 2 Save
description: Your brain is the only shield for the stickman! Enjoy a super casual puzzler in the Stickman Rescue - Draw 2 Save. Use your finger to draw lines and save the stickman from danger! In each level, the stickman is in trouble, such as falling rocks, flying arrows, deep pits, etc. It’s up to you to draw a safe shield, a bridge, or a clever device to keep him safe and complete your rescue mission!

title: Triangles
description:
If you like to organize your thoughts while playing, then "Triangles" is the game for you.
Combine, connect and match blocks in this exciting challenge that will test your logic skills. This king of puzzles will train your brain and help develop your logic and mental abilities. Don't let the shapes fill the hex grid!
The game will be interesting to fans of games with blocks.

title: Chess Online
description:
Options:
- Choose an opponent from 18 difficulty levels from Beginner to World Champion
- Selection of time control modes: Unlimited, Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Classic
- Highlighting possible moves when choosing a piece
- Cancel the move, if there was a yawn, you can go back
- Interactive hints, showing the best move during the game
- Analysis after the game, highlights mistakes and gives recommendations on how to play
- Replay the game from the right place
- Setting the handicap

title: PuzzleJam
description:
Puzzle Jam is a bright and fun puzzle game where you merge jellies of the same color to clear the board and complete each level!
Easy controls and smooth gameplay make it accessible for players of all ages . Each level brings a new challenge – find the smartest moves, use boosters, and unlock powerful combos!

title: Labubu Jetpack Rush
description: Fly high in Jetpack Jump with Labubu to survive the escape from the lab! Tap to use the jetpack and release to run . Upgrade your jetpack, your running speed and other upgrades to be able to travel further than before and beat your high score. The further you travel the more money you get!

title: Block Master - Super Puzzle
description: Welcome to a unique puzzle game where logic and strategy decide everything! Experience a fresh take on classic block games! The pieces appear at the bottom, and it’s up to you to decide where to place them. Drag the blocks onto the field, fill horizontal and vertical lines, and clear space for new moves. Every action requires careful planning—can you score the highest points?

title: Deep in the Lab - Chapter 1
description: Deep in the Lab is 2D '90 style survival horror game, with old style pre-rendered backgrounds, puzzles to solve, keys to collect, monster to avoid or defeat (your choice), poor resources, jumpscares, limited saves, FMV and a five floors lab to explore.

title: DIY Phone Case Shop
description: Welcome to Case Craft, a fun and creative game where you'll design and decorate phone cases to impress clients! Run your own phone case shop, attract customers, and fulfill their unique requests. Customize phone cases with various designs, patterns, and themes, and decorate your shop with attractive items to draw in customers. As you meet client demands, earn rewards and upgrade your shop to become the top phone case designer!

title: Panda Kitchen Idle Tycoon
description: Want to become the best restaurant tycoon? You’ll build your own panda-themed food empire in Panda Kitchen: Idle Tycoon. Earn idle profits, and manage your way to success. Unlock new dining tables and kitchen equipment to improve efficiency. Recruiting chefs and servers to create an ultra-efficient restaurant team.

title: FlowBall
description: Feel the adrenaline in an exciting 3D arcade game where you control a glowing ball racing through an endless tunnel! Avoid traps, chasms and obstacles, defying the laws of gravity. Your goal is to collect glowing dots to unlock new levels and set records! But be careful: falling into the abyss takes away lives, and losing them leads to defeat!

title: Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts
description: Play Sort Puzzle - Nuts and Bolts, a free and addictive sorting game! Train your brain by stacking nuts of the same color. Simple yet challenging, it's the perfect casual game to relax and sharpen your logic skills. Play now and start sorting!

title: Clash & Run
description: One chance, no turning back. Speed is your only ally in a world that won’t wait. Race through ever-shifting terrain where every jump could be your last. Collect coins and unlock unique looks. Precision and quick thinking will keep you in the game longer.

title: Math Obby
description: Combine your math skills with parkour prowess in Math Obby, an engaging Roblox experience that challenges players with arithmetic problems amidst obstacle courses. Navigate through stages that test both your agility and your knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Earn badges as you progress and showcase your mastery in this educational adventure.

title: Happy Blocks
description: Play Happy Blocks free online and jump into a colorful browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Arrange and clear blocks in a satisfying logic puzzle that feels like a smart brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, making it perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for easy, addictive puzzle fun anytime.

title: Obby On a Bike
description: Obby On a Bike, a thrilling bike-riding platformer that combines exciting obstacle courses with fun parkour gameplay! It features two exciting gameplay modes: Normal and Challenge. In Normal mode, you can carefully ride through each level without the stress of a timer. Challenge mode lets you test your speed and skill as you race against time. Whether you're playing alone or competing head-to-head in the 2 Player mode, there's always a thrilling challenge awaiting you!

title: Meme Wars
description: MeMe Wars is a strategy battler with US-style Shanhaijing flair. Build a quirky hero lineup with unique roles and stats. Place them on the board for max power, adapt to new foes each stage, and win.

title: Feet Doctor Urgency Care
description:
As a podiatrist in this medical simulation game, treat various urgent foot conditions and save patients. As a doctor, you will take care of the patient's feet.
Use all tools to cure them.

title: Dalgona Master
description:
Welcome to Dalgona Master, a thrilling game for those who loves dalgona, honeycomb, cookie game, and dalgona challenges.

This engaging sweet game challenge invites you to carve delicate shapes out of honeycomb candy, immersing you in the delicate skill required to perfect each piece without breaking it.

title: Italian Brainrot Survive Parkour
description: Step into the absurd universe of Italian Brainrot Survive Parkour, where chaos, memes, and tricky obstacle runs collide! Pick your favorite Brainrot characters, master wild parkour tracks, and survive each hilarious stage with your reflexes and timing.

title: SWAT Cats Shooter
description: SWAT Cats is an online shooter set in a world where every hero is a battle cat. Ready for purr-fect battle with wild action? Jump in, grab your helmet, and join the fight.

title: Bubble classic
description: The goal of the game is not to lose as early as possible and to score as many points as possible. Improve your accuracy thanks to very competent rolling of balls. The more blocks with balls you destroy, the more points you accumulate. Check your results in the world rankings, maybe you are already number 1.

title: Spa empire
description:
? BUILD YOUR DREAM SPA EMPIRE

Have you ever dreamed of running the ultimate spa, offering everything from soothing massages to exciting makeovers? Step into My Spa Empire, the idle arcade game where you dye hair, create stunning hair color makeovers and manage a bustling spa filled with exciting treatments. Design, upgrade, and expand your spa into the ultimate relaxation haven for your guests.

title: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets
description: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets is an exciting hidden object game where magic and time intertwine in a thrilling adventure. Everything changed when a mysterious magical crystal activated, scattering objects across time! You'll enter a world of riddles, hidden objects, and temporal paradoxes.

title: Airport Security
description: Airport Security is a casual simulation game that immerses you in the high-stakes world of airport safety, placing you in the role of a vigilant security officer dedicated to safeguarding a bustling terminal. Your mission is to maintain a secure environment by identifying suspicious passengers, spotting fake passports, and uncovering hidden contraband using cutting-edge X-ray machines.

title: Find the Ghost Cat
description: Your mission is to track down elusive ghost cats! These sneaky felines are masters of camouflage, blending into their surroundings, fading into transparency, or hiding in shadows. Stay sharp and see if you can find them all!

title: The Office Escape
description: The Office Escape is an exciting adventure where every step towards freedom becomes a test for the Regime and the thinking factor!

title: Mahjong Connect Fish World
description: Mahjong Connect Fish World is a captivating puzzle game with an ocean theme. In this beautiful underwater world, players need to connect matching mahjong tiles to eliminate them, unlock levels, and explore a rich variety of marine creatures. The game combines traditional connect-style gameplay with an ocean theme, providing players with a relaxing and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Unlock the Bolts
description: Unlock the Bolts is a challenging puzzle game where you carefully remove screws to solve mechanical puzzles. Each level tests your logic and precision as you figure out the correct order to unlock the bolts. In special levels, the stakes are even higher—you must free trapped animals by unlocking the right bolts! With satisfying mechanics and engaging challenges, this game will keep you thinking and entertained. Can you master every puzzle and rescue the animals in need?

title: Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D
description: Experience a high-speed realistic car collision simulator! Drive down slopes and crash into specialized obstacles with various vehicles, all featuring authentic physics and a detailed damage system with separating parts.

title: Archer Legend
description: Play Archery Battle Legend, the ultimate bow and arrow game! Test your aim in exciting archery battles, shoot targets, and defeat enemies like a true archer hero. Perfect for US students searching “archery game,” “stickman archer,” or “cool math games bow and arrow,” this free online challenge mixes skill, action, and fun. With endless levels, epic duels, and fast arrow shooting, sharpen your skills and become the legendary archer everyone talks about!

title: Hero Rabbit Idle Survivor RPG
description: We are rabbits! A fun offline survival shooting RPG game starring a rabbit!Hero Rabbit is an offline game. Players can play games anytime, anywhere without connecting to WiFi and the Internet.

title: Super Sprunki Clicker
description: Enjoy the Sprunki World in this clicker idle game. Immerse yourself in the beats and music simulation, create the band, and use the rewards to buy new upgrades and features. Break the screen touching the sprunkis, hire automatic clickers, social media features, instruments, and everything to become the Sprunki King.

title: Fish Shooting Fish Hunter
description: Want to begin a fun and relaxing fishing adventure? In Fish Shooting - Fish Hunter, you’ll become a fishing master. Use your skills and quick reflexes to catch various fish while enjoying a laid-back casual experience!

title: Paper.io 2
description:
Conquer as much territory as possible and beat the competition.
A smooth drawing experience!

Use your paper block to steal the area from your online opponents in this game. Capture as much space as possible and try to get the highest score in the lobby. If you move outside your own color, your tail becomes exposed. You will be eliminated when someone manages to catch your tail. So you need to take risks to expand your colored area.

title: Block Puzzle - Frozen Jewel
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Girlfriend from Hell
description:
Girlfriend From Hell is an addictive and fun 2D arcade puzzle game. The main goal of the game is the girl's revenge on her lover. The heroine needs to find objects and use them to make her boyfriend's life hell.  
You need to collect various items to make a trap with them.

title: Wonders of Egypt Match 2
description: Wonders of Egypt Match 2 returns with a brand-new Match-3 adventure in Ancient Egypt! Travel with your loyal Sphinx through pyramids, temples, palaces, and towering obelisks. Match 3+ sparkling gems to uncover treasures, artifacts, and hidden secrets. Conquer hundreds of fresh levels, complete tricky goals, and use powerful boosters when you need a helping hand. Earn dazzling rewards and prove your skills as the mysteries of the desert unfold in every chapter! Ready to play? Step in and match!

title: Merge Flowers
description:
Merge Flowers is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game! Grow your vibrant garden, discover unique flowers, and earn coins. Enjoy merge puzzle and match-3 mechanics as you combine flowers to create a blooming paradise.
With simple controls and cozy visuals, place flowers strategically to make space for new plants. Perfect for puzzle lovers and fans of casual idle games, Merge Flowers offers endless fun and a soothing experience. Start your floral journey today!

title: Noob in Geometry Dash
description: Move to the rhythm and help Nubik navigate challenging levels! Collect keys to unlock skins, complete courses, and see how high you can rank among the best players. Step into the beat-driven adventure!

title: Building Mods For Minecraft
description: Building Mods For Minecraft is the ultimate game for those who love to build and fight. If you’re a Minecraft fan looking for a new adventure, this game takes the building mechanics of Minecraft to the next level, combining construction with action. You’ll have access to a wide range of building tools and guns.

title: Deadly Parkour
description:
Dynamic Duo:
Take control of two distinct characters, each with their own strengths and abilities. 

Precision Platforming:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of precision platforming, where every jump matters. Test your reflexes and hone your skills as you traverse 70 meticulously hand crafted levels.

title: Block Craft 3D School
description: Welcome to Block Craft 3D-School. Here creativity meets adventure! In this pixel-style game, you will enter a world of endless possibilities, like Minecraft. To build and protect your school using blocks of various shapes! But be careful that this isn't just a building game! Enemies hide anywhere and are ready to hit you! Besides, collect and place blocks.

title: Words from Words
description: "Words from Words" is an exciting game, the purpose of which is to create as many different words as possible from the letters given to you. You can create 29 words from the word «example», «maverick» includes 71 words, and "chalkboard" stores as many as 142 words. Can you solve everything?

title: OUTSIDE
description:
OUTSIDE is a sleek and minimal puzzle game where every move matters. Guide a one-eyed character through a grid to collect the key and reach the exit — but there’s a twist: once you start moving, you won’t stop until you hit a wall.

Plan your route carefully, avoid dead ends, and use the environment to your advantage. With simple mechanics and clean visuals, OUTSIDE is easy to pick up but tough to master — a perfect test of logic and spatial thinking.

title: Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures
description:
Ready to go on a magical quest through a land made of candy?
Jump into Mahjong Quest: Candyland Adventures - where every corner is bursting with sweetness and surprises!

The streets are sprinkled with tasty treats, and they’re all yours to match! Find the snacky pairs, clear the board, and munch your way through this delicious adventure.

Can you collect all the colorful, candy-coated tiles? Play now and let's find out!

title: Dynamons 10
description: Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 10! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Gold Temple world and the bonus cave. Encounter Tyrexar, Tyceratox, Cobragora, Pterodanox, Knightanyx and the diamond Guardian and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
description: Zombies have taken over the world! Unlock bases and deploy soldiers with unique weapons, each with stats like damage, fire rate, and reload speed. Soldiers must reload at the base before defending. Place them wisely to stop zombies within range. Defeat waves to earn coins, upgrade bases, and survive stronger hordes. Strategically choose soldiers to clear waves and save cities across the globe.

title: Christmas Snowball Arena
description: Christmas Snowball Arena is a 3D stickman snowball IO game. You have to compete with nine other players in collecting snow blocks and making your snowball bigger. The goal is to be the last player standing by defeating and collecting other snowballs. You can also collect blank snowballs that are free for anyone. You can use two power-ups in the game to boost your snowball: one that makes it twice as big and another that makes it twice as fast. If you are looking for some snowball action, try it!

title: Dog Merge Mania
description: Merge cute puppies! Unlock breeds & grow your own fluffy dog paradise! A Relaxing Escape: The perfect mix of chill gameplay and light strategy.

title: 100 Hidden Capybaras
description: Are you ready for a hidden object game that's as cute as it is challenging? Jump into "100 Hidden Capybaras" – the ultimate hidden object adventure where your mission is to find and collect 100 adorable capybaras, each hiding in beautifully designed scenes! Explore stunning environments filled with lush forests, charming villages, secret dungeons, and unknown planets. Discover all hiding spots for our fluffy friends as you put your observation skills to the test.

title: Battle Arena
description: Fight enemies, grow your army, and dominate the battlefield! Upgrade your camp, train your soldiers and earn tons of coins to expand your unstoppable arsenal. Ready to battle?

title: Happy Town
description:
In Happy Town you have to lead your own city and make its inhabitants happy!

Becoming the mayor of your happy city is very simple! Combine items, upgrade buildings, complete tasks for residents, communicate with them, expand and enjoy a vibrant style and soundtrack. Residents are waiting for you!

title: Chess Duel
description: Master the art of chess with three exciting modes, each offering flexible time settings to suit every player. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Car Service Tycoon
description: Car Service Tycoon is a fun game designed for car enthusiasts. Open your own garage and start with a large collection of vehicles. In the game, you can fix the engines, repair brake systems, and fix electrical problems to get the vehicles ready for the road again. There's also the option to customize the exterior of the vehicles; you can change the paintwork, modify the rims and upgrade the exhaust systems.

title: Pesky Moles
description:
An ordinary farmer lived a quiet life and grew vegetables, but at some point, moles began to attack his garden and eat the entire crop.
After the next harvest, he decides to take everything into his own hands and protect his garden.
In Pesky Moles, you have to protect your garden from moles for a certain amount of time. The more pests you manage to neutralize and the more crops you save, the more coins you get. With the coins you earn, you can buy traps that will help you protect your garden.

title: Single Stroke Line Draw
description:
Single Stroke Draw Line is a puzzle game with with one touch line drawing. It is required for you to draw one line to connect all the points without any route repetition.
- The rule is very simple, Draw given figures with only one touch.
- Explore amazing levels of this puzzle at your fingertips and sharpen your brain IQ & skills.
- Game level starts with very easy levels and increases in difficultly as you progress in the game.

title: Tile Sort - Match 3
description: Tile Sort - Match 3 is an addictive match-3 puzzle game where your task is to sort and match identical tiles on the board. The game combines classic match-3 gameplay with elements of sorting, adding an extra layer of strategy and logic. Move tiles, creating combinations of three or more identical tiles to clear the board.

title: Car Jam Escape
description: Car Jam Escape is a puzzle game where players clear a crowded parking lot by moving cars in the correct order. Each vehicle can only move forward in the direction it faces, so players must study the layout and plan carefully. The goal is to guide every car out without collisions or blockages. As levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring logical thinking and strategy.

title: Fight for the Tree
description:
The gaming world is facing a serious tree crisis. Evil forces are running wild, and the trees are in great danger.
As a player, your mission is to protect these precious trees. Even when you're offline, your character will keep fighting to safeguard the trees, constantly accumulating experience and resources.
In the game, there's also a group of cute little sapling creatures imprisoned by the evil forces. You need to rescue them one by one through battles, explorations, and so on.

title: Royal Family Tree
description: Step into the world of royalty and unravel the secrets of noble bloodlines in this captivating family tree puzzle game. Your task is to complete intricate royal family trees by using the clues provided, piecing together generations of kings, queens, princes, and princesses.

title: Zombie Road
description:
In a world where the dead walk, the real challenge is getting smash them all with your car.
Even the apocalypse can’t stop the Zombie driver. Outfit your car with defenses, smash through the undead and reach the end.

title: Hospital Inc
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Hospital Inc, an exciting management simulator. This addictive idle tycoon casual game lets you build, expand, and manage your own hospital while earning profits even when you're away.

title: Doge Rush Draw Home Puzzle
description: Welcome to Doge Rush: Draw Home Puzzle! It's full of lovely adventures. There are two ways to play this game. In the Animal family party, you should help the dog and cat find their food and guide them home, drawing a line between the dog and cat's correct food. And avoid them bumping into each other. If they hit, they will get dizzy and the game will fail.

title: Hidden Kitty
description:
Hidden Kitty is an engaging and delightful hidden object game for kids, available for free! Step into a world of adventure as you help an old lady reunite with her beloved kitties, who are playfully hiding throughout the building.
Embark on a Kitty-Finding Adventure

title: My Tiny Land
description: An ultra-quiet and super stress-relieving fruit and vegetable matching game with hundreds of types of fruits waiting for you to collect.

title: Bloom Within: A life simulator
description:
The simulator of a pregnant mother allows you to fully experience the whole process of pregnancy.
In this anime game you have to play the role of a girl who has a loving husband and a child under her heart, who is waiting for her birth. Take care of yourself, give birth, take care of your baby and raise a healthy baby.

title: VegaMix Da Vinci Puzzles
description: "VegaMix Da Vinci Puzzles" is a match-3 adventure with quests and an interactive story. After a time-machine failure, Alice, Vika, and Lesha end up in Renaissance Italy and meet Leonardo da Vinci. To return home, they must help him finish his inventions, recover lost blueprints, and uncover secrets hidden in his workshop while exploring the art-filled cities and palaces of 15th-century Italy.

title: Last Standing
description: Players are dropped onto a map and start without weapons. The map is scattered with a wealth of weapons and equipment. Players need to constantly explore and collect these resources to enhance their survival ability and combat power. The core goal of the game is to be the last survivor. Usually, there are multiple players in each game, and they are randomly distributed on the map.

title: Farmer Rush: Idle Farm Game
description: The combination of merging crops, upgrading your farm, and the satisfaction of watching your fields bloom makes this game a perfect pick for players who love farming sims or idle games.

title: GT Championship Arcade
description: Get ready to ignite your engines and experience the ultimate rush of speed in GT Championship Arcade! This fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled racing game brings the excitement of GT racing into a visually stunning, arcade-style world filled with neon-lit tracks, intense rivalries, and heart-pounding action. Whether you’re a casual gamer looking for quick thrills or a hardcore racing fan seeking the ultimate challenge, this game offers an electrifying experience like no other.

title: Minicraft Chef Cake Wars
description: Hey player, would you like to have a cooking competition with your friend? In this cooking contest, you must beat your friend. Collect all the cooking materials as quickly as possible. We need to gather the cake ingredients floating in balloons in the air. The player who collects the most ingredients the fastest wins the game. To bake the cake, collect everything: salt, flour, and milk. Gather all the ingredients and win the game!

title: Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Unblock Ball: Slide Puzzle, a classic sliding puzzle game that lets you use your mind.You can feel a sense of accomplishment! Sliding the board to create the channel for the ball to roll smoothly to the end. You should use your logical mind to cleverly move blocks, avoid
obstacles, and solve every puzzle!

title: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker
description: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker is a fast, satisfying idle clicker built around one of the internet’s newest chaotic obsessions: the “Goo Goo Gaga” meme. Goo Goo Gaga Clicker takes the addictive, dopamine-fueled mechanics of Brainrot Clicker and gives them a surreal makeover.  What starts as a simple tap session quickly turns into a full-on collection grind where every click pushes you closer to the next weird, iconic form!

title: Kitty Match 3 puzzle game
description:
Kitty Match is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game with adorable cats. Match tiles, create combos, and clear levels in a relaxing and colorful world.

Easy to play and perfect for all ages. Enjoy smooth gameplay and endless puzzle fun.

Start your cute cat adventure now!

title: Mushroom Fever Match 3
description:
Immerse yourself in the magical forest with Mushroom Fever - Match 3! Bright and cheerful mushrooms replace traditional crystals, adding a fresh twist to the classic match-3 genre. This game will bring you hours of thrilling fun and bursts of excitement!

Match groups of three or more mushrooms, complete engaging tasks, and unlock new levels! Each level brings unique puzzles and fresh challenges. The more matches you make, the more points and bonuses you’ll earn!

title: Crazy Plane Landing
description:
Flying is easy - but can you stick the landing?

Get into one of the amazing flying machines and launch as high as you can. This part is easy… well, fairly easy. Not that anyone can do it. But you can. Surely you do!

What’s really interesting is what happens next. Will you crash? Or will you somehow make it a perfect landing?

title: Mighty Run
description: Mighty Run is an action-packed platformer where you jump, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies to progress. Collect gifts along the way and reach the end to grab the diamond, unlocking the next level. Use power-ups, master tricky jumps, and overcome challenges in this thrilling adventure. With smooth controls and exciting gameplay, every level is a test of skill. Can you collect all the rewards and reach the finish line? Play Mighty Run now and prove your skills!

title: Italian Brainrot Challenge
description: Welcome to the Italian Brainrot Challenge quiz game with the characters from Strange Animals! Choose your difficulty and test your knowledge of the Brainrot characters. Tap the correct answer from multiple choices and collect points as you go through the world of Italian Brainrot.

title: Skibronx Runner
description: Make your way through the streets in this endless runner game while you encounter various challenges. In the level mode its your goal to reach the grocery store without losing. In the endless mode your goal is to reach as far as possible without losing.

title: Theo Morini's Magical Resort
description:
“Theo Morini’s Magical Resort” is a magical, romantic, and captivating merge puzzle game about rebuilding a resort on an enchanted island.

Talented writers and actors created this story and brought its characters to life. Enjoy the story!

title: Football Penalty
description: Step into an exhilarating, never-ending penalty challenge! Show your opponents the power of your accurate shots and become a real football hero. Collect points for every target hit, progress through levels, and improve your football skills. Take part in a big tournament and get more rewards.

title: Celebrity Thanksgiving Prep
description: It’s Thanksgiving, and the celebrities are getting ready for the big day! In Celebrity Thanksgiving Prep, you’ll help your favorite stars get glammed up for the holiday dinner. Start by creating stunning makeup looks, styling hair, and choosing the perfect fall outfit. Then, join them in the kitchen for some festive cooking fun! From cozy sweaters to chic party dresses, show off your fashion taste and creativity in this delightful seasonal makeover game.

title: Merge Hotel Empire
description: You can generate and collect different new items by synthesizing the same items, and then use them to create and decorate a new mansion for the hotel empire of the story.

title: Board Kings Board Dice
description: Board Kings: Board Dice is a classic multiplayer strategy board game. Do you like to play Monopoly,Board Kings: Board Dice is similar to Monopoly. Become the real Board King by building and upgrading your empire with dice points, building and upgrading your board, or infiltrating other players' boards and attacking their buildings. This is a game where luck and strength go hand in hand to win,how is your luck today? Join us for more surprises waiting to be unlocked!

title: Weaponsmith Evolution - Weapon Merge
description:
- Start with basic weapons and drag identical ones to merge them into more powerful versions.
- Each new weapon brings more gold.
- Spend gold on upgrades: unlock new types of weapons or speed up the merging process.
- Fight monsters and progress through levels.
- From time to time, you’ll encounter powerful bosses. Defeat them to prove your mastery!

title: Merge Cube Challenge
description: Merge Cube Challenge offers a unique 2048 experience with its innovative endless mode. You can play alone or compete with your friends. Also, test your strategy and quick thinking skills by competing against the CPU. In endless mode, try to get the highest score by using the bomb special power. With the excitement increasing with each move, collect points and leave your opponents behind! Are you ready to immerse yourself in this excitement?

title: Solitaire Deluxe Edition
description:
Everyone's favorite classic card game is back. And this time, it's even more fancy and awesome!

Feast your eyes on the classic game that has been upgraded to look even better than before. Try your hand once again and see if you can beat it like you used to.

Is it all skill or does luck have some say in the matter? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Reach 2048
description: The classic 2048 puzzle — slide numbered tiles on a grid, merge them, and reach the legendary 2048 tile! Simple to learn, impossible to put down. Challenge your brain with this addictive number puzzle. Plan your moves carefully, build combos, and aim for the highest score. How far can you go beyond 2048?

title: Basket Sport Stars
description: A great basket challenge begins with random characters and with random basketball arenas with the Basket Sport Stars game! Play single or 2 player! The game consists of many levels, characters, and various game modes like Tournament, Quick Matches, 2 player Matches, and Practice Matches. You can play any of these modes for free, without unlocking. Pick most of the characters for free and start shooting your opponent's basket hoop!

title: Triple Cups
description:
Triple Cups is a bright and dynamic puzzle game where your goal is to flip colorful cups and arrange them to create rows of matching colors!
Every move requires focus and strategy: pick up cups from the top and place them on the stand below to form groups of three or more of the same color. When identical cups line up, they disappear, freeing space for new moves.

title: Head Runner Dash
description: Head Runner Dash is a 2D platformer game where you need to run, jump, and climb walls to overcome obstacles and traps. Pass the obstacles and raise the flag to complete the level. Difficult levels will make you addicted and feel challenged.

title: Princesses at Horror School
description: In this game you will meet two charming monster girls who study at a school for young monsters. Every morning, the girls carefully think over their images, mixing elements of a classic princess and a creepy monster. Girls have different fashion preferences, but they have one thing in common - these two unusual girlfriends always attract the admiring glances of classmates. After all, they are not just princesses, but real monsters whose terrifying style makes even the bravest tremble!

title: Town Run
description: Town Run is an excellent option if you enjoy games that require you to run continuously. It combines action-packed gameplay, vibrant graphics, and infinite running! Catching the raccoon is the goal. You'll need to sprint, leap, avoid obstacles, gather cash, and more in order to accomplish that!

title: The White Room 5
description: The White Room 5 is the fifth sequel of an adventure escape game with a cartoon art style. Find objects that can help you escape the room and use your logic to solve the puzzles. Good luck!

title: Strawberry Hero
description: Stick your fork and climb to the top! Hold down to keep sticking the fork continuously. If your fork hits a hero or an obstacle, it’s game over! Stick the fork just above the falling hero’s feet to trigger a Super Jump and earn a high score!

title: Gem Deep Digger
description: Dive deep into the underground world of Gem Deep Digger. In a fun and addictive simulation game,you dig, collect, and upgrade to uncover hidden treasures. With simple one-button controls, anyone can become the ultimate miner. Use your dig to carve through layers of dirt and rock, uncovering sparkling gems in the ground.

title: Two Carts - Downhill
description: Two Carts - Downhill is a fast-paced arcade game where you control two carts simultaneously, each on its own obstacle-filled road. Use the left and right arrow keys to steer each cart independently, collecting components to score points. Pick up power-ups like Ice to slow down the game or Shield to protect against obstacles. As you progress, the game speeds up, challenging your reflexes and multitasking skills. How long can you keep both carts on track?

title: Word Rivers
description: Play Word Rivers - an exciting word game where you can enjoy a sea of words and fantastic crosswords. Find words from letters and discover the wonders of the world and words right now!

title: Woodland Slide
description:
Embark on a relaxing journey in Woodland Slide! Slide the colorful jewels across wooden planks to create perfect matches and clear the board.

With every move, a new row of gems disappears, adding to the challenge. Use your strategy and unlock powerful abilities to remove gems, split them into smaller pieces, or clear entire rows.

Explore a serene, nature-inspired setting while testing your puzzle-solving skills. How far can you go in this addictive quest for the perfect match?

title: Meow Block: Color Collect!
description: A burst of color, clever thinking, and adorable cats await you in Meow Block: Color Collect! This charming puzzle experience turns simple movements into brain-teasing fun, where every swipe matters and every match brings you closer to victory.

title: Helix Crush
description: "The gameplay is very simple and can be accomplished with only one finger, yet it will also bring you countless challenges and fun. You need to jump and fall through the helix tower, cutting through the colorful fruit and cake slices on the way. But be careful! There are many obstacles and traps along the way, and it will be up to your reflexes and luck to get through them.

title: LampHead
description: The main character of this game is an amazing man with a lamp instead of a head who needs to get out of a dark and dangerous strange place at any cost. Are you ready to prove that you have an outstanding reaction, maneuvering between sharp obstacles, collecting bonuses, remembering that at the end of each dark path the light of victory awaits you? We are ready to offer you a one-time runner in which tedious jumps are replaced by moving the main character between two equal planes.

title: Get To The Chopper
description: Gear up and fight your way to safety in Get To The Chopper, a thrilling 3D first-person shooter where every mission is a battle for survival! Your objective is clear: reach the extraction chopper while eliminating all enemies standing in your way. Armed with a fully customizable loadout—including a primary gun, secondary weapon, grenades, and a melee weapon—you’ll face waves of enemies across dynamic battlefields such as forests, deserts, and more.

title: Real Car Parking Simulator
description:
Get ready to test your driving skills in Real Car Parking Simulator. In the parking simulation game, you will face various parking challenges. With realistic controls and detailed environments,you’ll feel like you're actually behind the wheel. From parallel parking to tight garage spaces,
this game offers many parking challenges.

title: The Hardest Puzzle Ever
description:
An Exciting Puzzle Game for the Whole Family! ?

Play together and train your brain every day! ?? Enjoy thrilling puzzles suitable even for the youngest players. With new levels added daily, there's always a fresh challenge waiting for you!

Have fun, improve your skills, and become a true puzzle master! ??

title: Color Maze
description: In Color Maze your mission is to light up all the paths on the map to complete a level. Make the right move, avoiding obstacles or just pay attention to not get stuck in a corner. Beat all the 20 levels with increasing difficulty to show yourself that you are the real king of Color Maze.  Remember, if a level is to hard for you, you can always skip it clicking or touching the reward button in the up right corner of the screen.

title: Sort Resort
description: Unleash your creativity and puzzle-solving skills in this unique game! Your mission: sort colorful liquids into the right flasks while also drawing beautiful pictures. Each level challenges you with tricky sorting tasks, but there's more — as you pour and sort, stunning images will come to life! Enjoy a relaxing yet engaging experience that blends art and logic. Can you master both sorting and drawing? Play now and find out how fun and satisfying it can be!

title: Carvivor Ops
description: Carvivor Ops puts you behind the wheel of a weaponized supercar in a nonstop chase for survival. Dodge relentless police, unleash rockets, and upgrade your gear as you fight through chaotic urban streets. Every second counts as you outmaneuver enemies, collect power-ups, and push your skills to the limit in this high-octane mix of driving and combat.

title: Conduct This
description: Conduct This is a cartoon-style free puzzle online game played on PuzzleGame for boys. You need to move the obstacles on the track so that the train can pass successfully. Get coins for passing levels and unlock the beautiful skins of the train. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable. I guess it's easy for you. Are you ready to try it now?

title: Mahjong build farm
description: A cozy blend of classic Mahjong and farm simulation! Start with a small green hill and turn it into a blooming farm by matching tiles and completing levels. The mechanics are simple and relaxing — find and match three identical picture tiles to clear the board. You'll have 90 unique levels with varying difficulty, from easy puzzles to real challenges for experienced players. If you get stuck, bonuses are always there to help.

title: Ballerina Cappuccina First Date
description: Tonight’s a big night—Cappuccina and Tung Tung Sahur are heading out on their very first date, and they want to look perfect. In Ballerina Cappuccina First Date, you’re the stylist behind their special evening. From choosing outfits to adding finishing touches, it’s up to you to make sure both of them shine.

title: Block Cut Cleaner
description: An original block puzzle where the field is filled with triangle blocks! Pull out your shapes and place them on the field to clear at 100%. But be careful: each piece you place can create new blocks! Use smart boosters to turn the tide: refresh your inventory, remove three random triangles or place a "clean" square that doesn't leave blocks behind. Plan your strategy to clear the board completely!

title: Swap Color
description:
Swap Color – Fast Reflex Color Challenge!

Swap Color is a fast-paced arcade game that challenges your reflexes and coordination. In this colorful tap-to-match adventure, you must swap your shape's color to match the incoming obstacles and survive as long as you can!

Simple to play but hard to master, Swap Color is perfect for casual players looking for a thrilling, one-touch arcade experience that gets more intense with every second.

title: Pizza Maker - Cooking Games For Kids
description: Become a pizza master by creating delicious pizzas from scratch with 15 unique recipes. Choose ingredients, slice vegetables, shred cheese, and prepare toppings. Knead and roll the dough, spread the sauce, add toppings, and bake. Once ready, box your pizza for delivery! Fun, engaging, and perfect for kids to develop cooking skills.

title: Catch The Pig
description: This is a casual elimination game. The main purpose of the game is to find three identical pigs, catch them, and collect all the pig collections!

title: Stack Blocks Connect Wooden Blocks!
description: ● This is a game in which you have to connect wooden blocks?! Compete with friends and colleagues?! In the game you have a playing area? where you must connect blocks to fill the line! Once the line is full, the blocks will disappear and give you the most points?! Compete with friends or colleagues on the leaderboard?! Enjoy your game?!

title: Good Sort Master: Triple Match
description:
A new game for those who like to put order on the shelf, in the closet, in the refrigerator. Collect identical items in groups of 3 - sort, arrange, tidy!
Connect items three in a row, create coziness! Cleaning has never been so interesting and fun!
A simple and relaxing game for women and men of all ages!

title: Capybara Block Blast
description: Capybara Block Blast is a cozy puzzle game where you blast blocks alongside the world’s chillest animal, the capybara! Match colorful block shapes, clear lines, and rack up points while enjoying adorable animations and relaxing vibes. Whether you’re chasing a high score or just unwinding, this game offers the perfect mix of challenge and comfort.

title: Animal Racing Idle Park
description: Animal Racing: Idle Park is an addictive racing animal transform game that will keep you playing for hours. In this game, you’ll train multiple animal racers such as lions, eagles, orangutans, dolphins, and more!

title: Wild Race Master 3d
description: Wild Race Master 3D is an exciting 3D racing game that brings you into a world of extreme speed!In this game, you can experience endless racing fun and drive various cool cars. Challenge the exciting track! ? Drive your beloved racing car through various unique and challenging tracks. You should show excellent driving skills on winding roads and be flexible when dealing with various complex track conditions.

title: My Little Farm
description: Welcome to My Little Farm! Roll up your sleeves and dive into the world of planting, harvesting, and selling to meet daily demands. Upgrade your tools, nurture your crops, and keep the farm flourishing. Can you handle the never-ending requests and become the ultimate farmer?

title: Find the Sprunki
description: Find out the hidden Sprunki in the specified images. Each level has 12 hidden Sprunki. There are 12 levels in total. The time is limited so be fast and find all hidden objects before time runs out. Clicking in the wrong place several times reduces the time by an additional 5 seconds. So, if you are ready, start the game and have fun!

title: Winter Hexa Stack
description: Winter Hexa Stack is a cozy and addictive winter-themed puzzle game where you clear the board by stacking three matching hex tiles. Tap a tile to place it in an empty spot or on top of a similar tile. When you match three identical tiles, they disappear and free up valuable space. Be careful—if your holding slots fill up or the timer runs out, the level ends. Plan your moves, stay organized, and enjoy a relaxing winter atmosphere.

title: Beat Blader 3D
description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate rhythm experience with Beat Blader 3D, where music meets action! Slash your way through vibrant, futuristic landscapes in sync with the beat of your favorite songs. Armed with dual energy blades, you’ll slice through incoming obstacles, hitting targets in perfect harmony with the rhythm, all while dodging challenges that appear in time with the music.

title: Energy Superman 3D
description: Come to soar through the skies in Energy Superman 3D! This exciting arcade game lets you become a powerful superhero. Your mission is to save the city from monstrous threats. Collect energy orbs,avoid obstacles, and achieve the highest score possible!

title: Radiant Rush
description: Radiant Rush is a minimalist synthwave drifting game where you control only the car's steering—not its speed. Your goal is to complete increasingly challenging levels while collecting all the datacubes scattered throughout.

title: Pin Puzzle Save The Sheep
description: Pin Puzzle: Save The Sheep is an exciting pin-pulling game. You will test your brain intelligence and have endless fun. In this game, you have to make the sheep eat food and save them from their predicament. You have many other tasks like pulling the pin to make the dog eat the food. But be aware that you may meet a lot of obstacles like bombs, lava, etc. and you need to avoid them. There are many interesting levels to play in this crazy puzzle game. Come and join the game.

title: Mahjong Pet Quest
description:
Dive into the colorful and engaging world of Mahjong Pet Quest, a fun and relaxing puzzle game where classic Mahjong meets adorable animal tiles!
Replace the classic Mahjong tiles with cute animal-themed ones! Each tile brings a charming, delightful touch to the game.
Explore a variety of levels, each designed to test your skills and logic. The difficulty increases as you progress, ensuring that you’re always challenged!

title: War State IO - Conquer Battles
description:
Welcome to ultimate strategy game that lets you improve your tactical skills and lead your troops to triumph! 

Lead your army, conquer enemy camps, and expand your territory in fast-paced battles filled with action and strategy.

Every decision matters — whether you’re attacking enemy strongholds or defending your bases, clever maneuvers are key to achieving victory.

title: Slingshot Fortress
description: Slingshot Fortress is an addictive 2D physics-based destruction game where precision, timing, and strategy are essential. Use your slingshot to launch stones, bombs, and shurikens to destroy towers, collapse structures, and uncover hidden enemies. Explore vibrant levels from forests to icy lands, unlock powerful abilities, trigger explosive chain reactions, and master increasingly challenging puzzles in this fun, casual browser game experience.

title: Mojicon Garden JigSolitaire
description: Piece together a paradise in Mojicon Garden Jigsaw Solitaire! Solve beautiful puzzles to restore a dry meadow back to a lush, blooming garden. Enjoy a meditative experience with smooth controls and the iconic Mojicon art style. Can you bring the garden back to life?

title: Fruit Merge Arena
description: Fruit Merge Arena is a fun and relaxing game where you drop fruits and merge the same ones to create bigger fruits. Keep merging step by step and try to reach the ultimate fruit — the watermelon! But be careful, space is limited and the board can fill up quickly. Plan your moves wisely and keep merging to stay in the game.Feeling stuck or running out of space? Don’t worry! You can watch a reward ad to remove all instances of a selected fruit and make room for new moves.

title: Block Breaker
description: Embark on a 2D adventure filled with dynamic physics! Break ice blocks, use springs and portals, and launch the character through the air to reach the goal platform. Master the environment and discover all the creative ways to complete each level!"

title: Spooky Halloween Hidden Pumpkin
description: In Spooky Halloween Hidden Pumpkin, you’ll explore haunted locations like creepy graveyards, abandoned houses, foggy forests, and more. Each level is uniquely designed with eerie Halloween-themed settings full of tricks and illusions. Your challenge is to locate 10 pumpkins hidden in plain sight within each scene. The faster you find them, the better your score!

title: Rocket Fest
description: Control the rocket to collect energy or other useful props along the way, and bomb the target at the end! This is a casual stress relief game.

title: Beauty puzzle
description: A puzzle game in which you need to connect the pieces in a line. To successfully complete the game, it is important to use its mechanics to your advantage

title: People Playground! Ragdoll Arena!
description:
People Playground! Ragdoll Arena! is a fun physics-based adventure where chaos is the goal. Tap and hold objects to move them, then release to throw them at the doll.

Your goal:
Inflict maximum damage and destroy your doll using everything at your disposal. Drop a car on his head, throw a rock at him, or throw him off a cliff. Every action triggers a reaction, so experiment with different ways to destroy. Sometimes there will be multiple dolls: twice the targets, twice the strategies!

title: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run
description: Get ready to dive into the exhilarating world of Shape Transforming: Shifting Run, where the power of transformation is in your hands! This game is a thrilling journey across diverse terrains, challenging players to adapt, transform, and conquer. If you have a knack for quick thinking and love dynamic gameplay, this is the perfect game for you! ??

title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo
description: Welcome to Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo, a unique and immersive game that lets you unleash your inner tattoo artist. This isn't just any game; it's your gateway to a world where art meets relaxation, and where your creativity can truly shine. Prepare to immerse yourself in the satisfying and intricate process of tattooing, all at the tip of your fingers!

title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
description:
In Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up, you’re dressing up your doll and getting her ready to go live. Pick from different styles—she can look like a fairy, wear chill street clothes, or go for a beach outfit. When you’re done, she jumps on the stream and starts showing off her look.

You can mess with her hair, add makeup, and try out accessories. There’s also a battle mode where you go up against other players to see who styled it best.

title: Sheep vs Wolf
description:
Protect the sheeps by blocking the wolf's way.
Simply click on tiles to block it. Every time you make a move The Wolf makes a move. So, be careful for the tile you block!

title: Save little red hood
description:
Match-3 puzzles combined with physics-based gameplay: eliminate blocks to make stones fall and become Little Red Riding Hood's weapons, which she then uses to attack the wolf.
Plan your elimination route carefully, utilizing gravity to make the stones fall and become weapons—that's the ultimate goal. Various power-ups can also help you.

title: Home Design - Match 3
description: Enjoy a perfect blend of home design and match-3 fun! Solve colorful puzzles, create your ideal home, and activate powerful boosters. Take on rewarding challenges, collect prizes, and personalize your interiors. Play anytime, anywhere!

title: From Nerd To School Popular
description: Embark on a transformation journey “From Nerd To School Popular”! Help our protagonist navigate high school life, overcome challenges, and discover their true potential. With your guidance, they’ll undergo a stylish makeover, gain confidence, and rise to the top of the social ladder. Experience the ultimate high school makeover story and watch as our hero transforms from a shy outsider to a beloved school icon!

title: Flick Baseball Super Homerun
description:
Experience various baseball pitches based on the pendulum movement. The ball will fly further if you can hit the ball directly with the quick flick. Experience a “real-life like” batting simulation in this baseball game.
# One Flick Easy Control
