You only use flick to control the batting for this game. The more accurate you flick your finger to hit the ball; it is more likely that you will be a home-run hitter.

title: Scary Pairs
description: In the new exciting online game Scary Pairs you will have fun going through the levels of an interesting puzzle that is dedicated to Halloween. In front of you on the screen you will see a playing field on which a certain number of cards will be located. They lie face down and in one move you can turn over any two cards. Look at the images on them, because after a while the cards will return to their original state and you will make your move again.

title: Link & Color Pictures
description: Link & Color Pictures is a captivating coloring puzzle game where you connect colorful dots to fill in the colors of intricate pictures. Dive into a world of creativity and challenge as you complete all sections of the picture to finish each level.

title: Halloween Store Sort
description: In Halloween Store Sort, match spooky toys and Halloween decorations by dragging them between shelves. Create sets of three to clear the shelves and reveal hidden ones above or to the sides of the screen. With many levels and increasing difficulty, each level has a time limit, so think fast! Use the shuffle button if you get stuck. Complete all levels to win and become the ultimate Halloween sorting champion!

title: Dreams
description: In the realm of slumber, dreams manifest as delicate tiles, each holding a fragment of imagination, memory, or longing. As a Dream Collector, your mission is to weave these ephemeral pieces together, creating a tapestry of wonder. Only by assembling the perfect dream can you unlock hidden secrets and awaken the Dream Oracle.

title: Vampiric Roulette Romance
description: Experience Gothic romance in "Vampiric Roulette Romance"! Help the Vampire Prince choose a date for the eclipse night party from four stunning beauties. Dive into Gothic dress-up and makeup levels, and witness the suspenseful roulette revelation under the moonlit eclipse.

title: Snake Go - Escape Puzzle
description: Your goal is simple: guide the snake through tangled grids and help it escape without getting stuck. Each level challenges you to think ahead, choose the right order, and find safe paths through tight spaces. Blending classic snake mechanics with modern puzzle escape logic, every maze feels handcrafted — clean, clever, and satisfying to solve.

title: Color Mix - Jelly Merge
description: This is an enthralling puzzle game with jellies. Dive into the world of exciting puzzles! Match jellies of the same color to reach new heights and beat high scores. With each level, the challenges get tougher and the fun gets bigger.

title: Red Stickman vs Craftmans 2
description: Classic platformer with shooting. Stickman got into the world of Minecraft, flooded with zombie people and zombie animals. Help Stickman destroy all the infected, save Eve and get out of this world.

title: Ping Pong Battle Table Tennis
description: Want to have an intense table tennis battle? In Ping Pong Battle - Table Tennis, you will become a ping pong pro and compete with your opponents in a fierce competition! This game combines realistic paddle manipulation with exciting match simulation.

title: The Walking Deadblocks
description: A fast-paced, cooperative survival game where players battle relentless waves of zombies across dynamic day-night cycles. Survive as long as possible by managing resources, unlocking new maps, and utilizing unique character abilities. Nights bring increased danger with randomized enemy spawns, challenging players to strategize using generators and lights to stay alive.

title: Sorting Balls
description: Sorting Balls is a fun and challenging puzzle game where players must sort colored balls into the correct tubes. The goal is to organize all the balls by color using logical thinking and strategic moves. As the levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring careful planning. With simple controls and engaging mechanics, Sorting Balls is perfect for players who enjoy brain-teasing challenges.

title: Solitaire Mahjong
description: This is Solitaire Mahjong at its best, offering a classic and elegant mahjong experience without any need to rush. Known as one of the top mahjong games, it features a beautifully traditional layout that fans of mahjong puzzles will love. With polished graphics, a soothing soundtrack, and no timer, Solitaire Mahjong invites you to enjoy each move at a relaxed pace, focusing purely on the pleasure of the game.

title: Fish Love Pins
description: Fish Love Pins is a physics-based game that requires players to actively use their brains to figure out how to complete each level. The game is very easy to play, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty gradually increases.

title: Mobile Legends Slime 3v3
description: Mobile Legends Slime 3v3 will bring you into a fun arena of exciting battles! In this 3v3 PvP game, you can unblock many slime characters. Enter a variety of colorful battle scenes. Each character has unique skills and fighting styles, ensuring you find the best gameplay.

title: Mr Long Hand
description: Immerse yourself in the quirky and delightful world of Mr Long Hand, where you take on the role of a stickman with incredibly long arms. Your mission is simple yet endlessly entertaining: use your elongated limbs to swing through obstacles, solve puzzles, and embark on thrilling rescues. Mr Long Hand offers a unique blend of creativity, challenge, and humor that is sure to captivate players of all ages.

title: Money Maker
description: Money Maker is an addictive strategy and idle game that lets you build your fortune from the ground up. Combine smart investments with clever upgrades to grow your virtual empire. Merge pins, upgrade your Money Machine, and watch your income skyrocket as you master the art of wealth creation. With its vibrant visuals and satisfying progression system, Money Maker turns every click into profit!

title: Fashion Famous
description: Step into the stylish universe of Fashion Famous! Compete in glamorous fashion contests, pick outfits that match each round’s theme, and impress the judges to earn high scores. Travel across global fashion capitals and showcase your look on dazzling runways. Explore makeup, hairstyles, and accessories to build the perfect outfit. Will your sense of style stand out among players from all around the world?

title: Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop
description:
"Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop" – A Charming Puzzle Game About Merging Jelly Dolls!

In this addictive game, you'll drop adorable Labubu dolls, match identical ones, and create new characters! When two matching Labubus collide, they transform into the next doll in your collection. Earn coins for every merge, then spend them to operate the claw machine – fish out exactly the Labubu you need to complete each level!

Can you collect all the Labubus?

title: Stickman vs Zombies: Epic Fight
description:
The zombie apocalypse has begun today!

Stickman vs Zombies: Epic Fight is an epic stick fighting game with cool effects and combos in the platformer genre.

The most epic battles and fights await you in a cube world similar to minecraft, where the red stick fights against zombies, skeleton archers, withers and even Noob!

The game is similar to Stick War, Stickman vs Zombies and Stickman Warriors. Hordes of zombies attacked the red stick and his friends!

title: Football Duel
description: Step into the arena in Football Duel! Take turns shooting and goalkeeping in this thrilling 3D penalty showdown. Swipe to score or defend — the first to 5 goals claims victory!

title: ASMR Water vs Fire
description:
Water vs Fire, upgrade your water power and damp down the fire!
And Have fun!

Upgrade your Water Power and your Amount of Canister.


- Easy intuitive controls
- Release to shoot

title: Stunt Bike Rider Bros
description: Stunt Bike Rider Bros is a motorcycle racing and show game that you can play in both 1 player and 2 player mode with your friend. There are 3 different game modes in the game. In the "Racing Mode", you can compete with both your friend and other motorcycle drivers. In the "Career Mode", try to complete the difficult stages in a limited time. In the "Open World", you can earn coins and diamonds by performing various stunts with your motorcycles.

title: Ragdoll Show: Throw, Break and Destroy!
description: Dive into the chaotic fun of ragdoll mayhem! Navigate thrilling challenges by guiding your ragdoll character through each level, leveraging realistic physics for epic destruction. Sharpen your skills and unleash maximum chaos—can you conquer every challenge and emerge victorious?

title: Space Blast
description: Space Blast is a 2D game full of action arcade game where your piloting skills and strategic thinking are key to navigating relentless waves of meteors. Command a powerful spaceship equipped with advanced weapons and take on the challenge of protecting the galaxy from incoming threats.

title: Hidden Easter Egg Hunt
description: Dive into the fun world of Hidden Easter Egg Hunt, a fun and relaxing hidden object game for players of all ages! Explore colorful spring landscapes filled with blooming flowers, green fields, and playful bunnies as you search for hidden Easter eggs scattered around the game board. With charming graphics and a festive feel, this game is perfect for getting into the Easter spirit. Test your observation skills, challenge your attention to detail, and enjoy the joyful hunt!

title: Block Digger
description: Dig, Click, and Get Rich! In Block Digger, every tap brings you closer to fortune! Smash stones, collect coins and crystals, and upgrade your mine to skyrocket your earnings. Unlock new mines, chase achievements, and build your mining empire. It's easy, fun, and totally addictive—start digging today! ⛏️

title: Ammo Rush Master
description:
Get ready to run, multiply, and blast your way to victory in Ammo Rush Master!
Dodge obstacles, choose the right gates, and build the biggest Ammo army of bullets. Then, grab your blaster and unleash a storm of foam darts to smash through targets, enemies, and bosses!

title: Limited Kaboom
description:
Use your buddies to take down the enemy structures and the enemies along with them! 
Can you make survive the hero? 
Use the physics of the world to skillfully take down Sam's enemies!

title: Domino Smash 3D
description: Domino Smash 3D is a free online puzzle game for boys played on a puzzle game. You will control a ball to rush to dominoes, knocking all domino cards down. The game uses unique physics to operate, just pay attention to avoid obstacles, and unlock brand-new Domino on different levels. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Cooking Stories: Fun cafe game
description:
Become the host of the popular transformation cooking show — Cooking Stories! You are not just a chef, you are a culinary genius, a style master, and an interior designer. Participants come to you at their most desperate moment: they urgently need help — and only you can change and save their lives!

But that’s not all...  
Take a peek behind the scenes of the TV show: intrigue, emotions, unexpected twists — all this in the game Cooking Stories!

title: Geometry Vibes Monster
description: Geometry Vibes Monster is a reaction-based arcade game where you must dodge incoming obstacles, spikes, and battle against a variety of unique monsters. Each monster features distinct attack patterns that you must skillfully avoid. Your main goal is to navigate your spaceship as far as possible while surviving the onslaught of attacks.

title: Funny Fever Hospital
description: Join Ruby, a schoolgirl battling a unique lung virus, in Funny Fever Hospital! Diagnose, operate, and dress her for the cosplay competition. Cure her, and she'll thank you with a dazzling dress-up session! Experience medical fun and fashion in one pet-tastic game!

title: Hamster Combo IDLE
description: Upgrade your stock market hamster! A new Idle clicker, thanks to which you will learn a lot about cryptocurrency exchanges. Dig up the crypt and upgrade your hamster.

title: Super Stock Stack
description: Super Stock Stack challenges you to sort food cans onto shelves with speed and clever organization! Match the cans by their labels, manage the growing stock, and test your skills as the levels get tougher. Can you become the ultimate stock master?

title: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls
description: With Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls, users can unleash their creativity and design unique outfits for their dolls. The game offers a wide range of clothing options, accessories, and hairstyles to choose from, allowing players to mix and match to their heart's content.

title: Word Game 2026
description: Immerse yourself in "Word Puzzle," a premium brain-teasing game featuring a stunning 3D animated background! Test your vocabulary and fast-thinking skills by guessing the missing letters before the thrilling 30-second timer runs out. With 100 exciting levels, neon-glassmorphism graphics, and highly addictive gameplay, this game will keep you hooked for hours. Can you become the ultimate Word Master?

title: Hook Master Mafia City
description:
Hook Master: Mafia City is a casual puzzle game that combines puzzle solving, escape and collecting elements. In this dangerous city, you have to solve puzzles with your smart mind and use a cool grappling hook and swing skills, like a secret agent's flexible dodge, precise strike
and successfully escape the enemy hunt! There are two kinds of gameplay: grappling and swinging. Use the grapple for flexible movement, quickly across the city by snagging walls, buildings and so on.

title: OMG Word Sushi
description: Swipe to connect letters and form words in this sushi-themed word puzzle game. Challenge your vocabulary with over 81 levels and a minimalist cartoon style. Perfect for trivia and quiz enthusiasts. Think it's easy? Try the advanced levels!

title: Mojicon Emoji Connect
description:
A fast, fun twist on classic Onet puzzles!
Get ready to match and relax with Mojicon: Emoji Connect – the cheerful tile-linking puzzle bursting with personality!
Connect identical emoji tiles, clear the board, and enjoy satisfying spark effects with every perfect match.
With hundreds of cute icons, calming backgrounds, and rewarding combos, Mojicon delivers endless relaxing fun for all ages.
Play anywhere, anytime – no downloads, just pure emoji joy!

title: Puzzle Wood Block
description:
Put the given blocks of pattern in 9x9 squares to fill them.
Once the 9x9 slots are all Filled up, the blocks in it will be cleared!
Achieve high score by clearing many combos at once!

title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: Chrono Drive
description: It's a game where you have to travel to the finish line without hitting any obstacles/ other cars. Other cars/obstacles move in sync with your movement and there are also additional twists to time mechanics.

title: Red Stickman vs Monster School
description:
Red Stickman vs Monster School - stickman game where you need to pick up different weapons and clear levels from mobs from the school of monsters. The game contains

- 60 levels
- 10 bosses
- Many types of different weapons!

Did you like the game "Red Stickman vs Monster School "? - Then write a review and play all our games about stickmen.

title: Closed City
description: Shooting game about a quarantined city due to the threat of infection with a zombie virus. The main gameplay will revolve around the fact that you will need to survive in this difficult, riddled city.

title: Idle Drive: Merge, Upgrade, Drive
description: Welcome to Idle Drive: Merge Upgrade & Drive! Unleash your creativity, craft a unique vehicle for travels. Start with a basic car, enhance it using in-game currency earned by tapping. Accumulate funds for components like engines and tires. Merge parts for higher levels, boosting speed and power. Visit the garage to customize your car. Idle DriftDrive offers exhilarating fun and satisfaction of creating your own ride. Perfect for car enthusiasts and racing fans. Exciting moments await you!

title: Block Puzzle King
description: Smart Puzzle Block is a classic elimination game. Its adorable graphics prevent eye strain, and varied level difficulties keep it engaging. The game maintains freshness while offering abundant props for players to strategically use.

title: Word Art – Color Book Puzzle
description: Discover a delightful gaming experience that combines the thrill of solving word puzzles with the joy of bringing art to life. In Word Art – Color Book Puzzle, you’ll embark on a creative journey where words are the key to unlocking vibrant colors and stunning illustrations.

title: Crazy Axe
description:
In Crazy Axe, you take control of a fearless warrior, armed with a powerful axe, to conquer a series of action-packed challenges. Swing your axe with precision, crush obstacles, and defeat waves of enemies. The game tests your reflexes and accuracy as you navigate through dangerous environments, dodging traps and outsmarting your foes. With each level, the difficulty ramps up, demanding quick thinking and faster reactions to survive.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and go axe-crazy?

title: ASMR Beauty Superstar
description: Welcome to ASMR Clinic, where relaxation meets rejuvenation! Our superstar guest is receiving expert care for acne-prone skin and rough feet in a serene atmosphere. Our skilled doctors will work their magic, providing personalized attention to detail and soothing care. Customize her look with various hairstyles, makeup looks, and shoes to create a stunning outfit that's uniquely hers. Unwind and express your creativity in this calming and fashionable game.

title: City Gas Station Simulator
description: Ever dreamed of running a bustling gas station? City Gas Station Simulator lets you experience the thrill of managing every detail of your very own station in a fun 3D casual simulator! From fueling cars to running a mini shop, every choice is yours to make. Fun and addictive casual management gameplay. Mix shopping and service for maximum efficiency.

title: That's Not My Neighbor
description: That's Not My Neighbor is a detective puzzle game. You are going to be the new janitor in this building when you are watching the tutorial video. Your job is to determine if the person who wants to enter the building is a monster. The monsters can transform into anyone and imitate them. Some monsters are not good at imitation and may develop flaws. You have no choice but to pay attention to the image of your neighbors. At the same time, remember to fill out checklists for each neighbor.

title: Brainrot Merge
description:
Merge adorably weird Italian brainrot characters! 
Combine them to unlock rare (and even weirder) species. 
Build the ultimate brainrot paradise!

title: Elemental Gloves Magic Power
description: Elemental Gloves - Magic Power is a superpower arcade game.  Experience the fun of superpowers in magic games? Fascinated by elemental games? In this game, you can use the superpowers in the magic gloves to fight with your enemies. Shooting with flames, attacking with lightning, and attacking with electromagnetic waves, are three ways for you to choose. Don't hesitate to take the opportunity to practice real elemental magic and wipe out the bad guys. Become the greatest elemental master!

title: Blocks Breaker
description:
Shoot Blocks break Blocks, upgrade your the tiny car to make it shoot faster to break more blocks!!!


Get coins with every block you break!

title: Lovely Cat Pet Life
description: Call for all pet lovers! If you are a DIY enthusiast or enjoy playing with cute animals, join Lovely Cat: Pet Life, a casual DIY cat game online. Dive into this adorable, fun-filled, and creative game that combines the elements of cats, pets, fashion, and DIY all in one perfect package! Play dress-up game: Try out charming suits on your pet. Decorate an ideal look for your kitten. Enjoy minigames unblocked: Join mini animal parkour games with your little cat.

title: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon
description: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon is a relaxing and strategic idle game where players grow and manage their very own dairy business. Start by raising cows to produce milk, process raw milk then deliver the fresh milk packages to the market. Automate processes, upgrade your workers and warehouse to maximize efficiency and profits. Your goal is to build the ultimate dairy empire! Perfect for players who enjoy business simulation games.

title: Dream Mania Happy Match
description: Ready to begin a fantastic match-3 puzzle adventure? Dream Mania - Happy Match is a fun puzzle game that you won't be able to stop playing. It's easy to play, yet the challenging level design. It's a casual game you don't want to miss! Match 3 or more identical items to clear the board and hit your level goals.

title: Pool Master
description: From a rookie with a cue to a legend of the table, journey through 100 challenging levels with closed pockets, special balls to clear and more. Unlock custom gear, gain special boosts and rule the table with precision and power.

title: Bears vs. Art
description:
Bears vs. Art is the premium version of the slash em’ up puzzle game you love! Exclusive to this version of Bears vs. Art - enjoy uninterrupted, thought-provoking puzzles.
Each painting is protected by sneaky security measures including lasers, spikes and mind-bending portals. Not to mention snooty guests, nosy security guards and art-snatching thieves!

title: Robocarpoli
description:
In Brooms Town, you must solve four amazing adventures:

Problems with the pipes: 
In Brooms Town, a water pipe broke and the road is getting flooded. Help the Rescue Team to solve these situations completing 6 games: 
    • Connect the wires in Jin’s invention
    • Block the water leaks as soon as possible.
    • Solve Poli’s maze.
    • Work in a team with Micky.
    • Help Roy with the hoses.
    • Make Bruner as clean as a whistle.

title: Polygon Space
description: Polygon Space is an intense shooting challenge. Fly a laser cannon in space, battle attacking sci-fi shapes, keep firing, upgrade weapons with resources, destroy them all, and stay safe.

title: Cleaning Princess
description: This is an ASMR game for girls. If you like to clean everything, our game is right for you. The game has 5 modes: ear cleaning, heel cleaning, back spa, teeth cleaning, and fan cleaning. You can use different tools to clean and massage your body parts. But it is important to note that each mode has a countdown time and you must choose the right tool to do the cleaning.

title: Gun Clone
description:
A free browser game Gun Clone in the arcade and runner genre about cloning guns. Upgrade your weapons, collect cards. The game for girls and boys. The game is endless and pay attention, the levels are simple, but there are also very difficult ones! 
Take weapons and destroy everything in your path! By collecting various bonuses, more and more destructive weapons appear in your hands.

title: Clean House: Clearing trash and dirt
description:
Welcome to an exciting game world where everyone can enjoy the process of cleaning. The further you advance, the more garbage accumulates, and your vacuum cleaner faces a real challenge. But don't despair! Collect all the garbage and take it to the garbage truck, earning money that can be spent on improving your vacuum cleaner.

Clean and declutter your homes to restore them to their original beauty!

title: Spider Evolution
description: Transform into the ultimate spider in Spider Evolution! Start small, grow stronger, and outsmart rivals on a vibrant track. Merge, dodge, and strategize to become the apex arachnid. Experience thrilling hyper-casual gameplay and dominate the spider world!

title: Food Truck Chef Cooking
description: Welcome to Food Truck Chef Cooking, a casual food cooking simulation game online. Want to experience a day of a food truck chef? Are you curious about what the screw's work is like on an airplane? Join our best chef simulator game and resolve all your doubts. Step into the kitchen of a running truck and answer all your customers' requests. Challenge your mind and boost your thinking in this cooking management game.

title: Word Scramble - Family Tales
description: Want a distraction from the annoyances of daily life, or is your brain tired of solving exactly the same problems? Welcome to Word Scramble: Family Tales! Train your gray matter by solving word search puzzles and level up your vocabulary! An exciting family adventure, colorful locations and engaging play make this game hard to tear yourself away from. The story of a long-awaited child finally arriving in a family will come to life literally in front of your eyes.

title: Tank Stars
description: Are you ready for an action-packed 2D tank warfare? Welcome to the Tank Stars, one of the best battle tank games that you can play with friends online & offline. Find the right shooting angle and unleash your iron force against your foe's war machines! Make the right shot quickly or you'll lose!

title: Mega Jump
description: Mega Jump is a fast-paced vertical arcade game where you leap from platform to platform, collect coins, and dodge hazards as you climb higher. Power-ups, shifting coins, and colorful boost stars keep every ascent exciting. With vibrant visuals and responsive movement, the challenge grows as you push for your highest score without missing a single platform.

title: Tower Guardian - Epic Defense
description:
- Strategically summon warriors and unleash devastating abilities to protect your tower from hordes of enemies!
- Fight off waves of monsters, unlock new levels, and upgrade your heroes as you rise to become the ultimate protector. Every wave gets tougher—only the strong and strategic will survive.
- Rotate around the tower, lock onto approaching foes, and eliminate them before they breach your defenses! 
With each wave, enemies grow stronger and more numerous.

title: Winter Tetrix Trails
description:
Winter Tetrix Trails is a relaxing shape-filling puzzle game set in a snowy world.
Drag and place colorful Tetris-style blocks to complete each unique silhouette — think carefully, fit perfectly, and enjoy the magic of winter puzzles!

title: Road Chase. Shooter Realistic Guns
description:
Shoot the enemies chasing you!
Break away from the chase, your AK47 will help you with this!
Huge selection of realistic weapons
AK47, Minigun, Crossbow, Stationary gun, Machine gun
Destroy motorcycles, ATVs, racing cars, helicopters
Realistic graphics

title: Ball Rolling Slope
description:
Navigate a rolling ball through endless neon slopes in the Ball Rolling Slope game! Test your reflexes, dodge obstacles, and aim for the highest score in this challenge.
Ball Rolling Slope game is an exhilarating 3D arcade game that puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Guide a rolling ball down a steep, neon-lit slope filled with challenging obstacles and sudden drops. The gameplay is simple to pick up but difficult to master.

title: Angry City Smasher
description: Angry City Smasher is a third-person RPG fighting simulation game with 3D-armed gorillas. Your goal is to defeat the enemy monster and destroy the marked number of buildings. Use the Ultimate Smash to make AOE damage and destroy more buildings with one hit. To be honest, it is necessary to defeat your opponent first because it will run to you on the level. No one wants to be disturbed by others. Good luck!

title: Deadflip Frenzy
description:
Deadflip Frenzy is a wild stunt-flipping action game where chaos meets style! Launch your character into the air, pull off insane flips, twists, and bone-crunching landings — all in the name of fun (and maybe a little destruction).

Bounce off trampolines, launch from cannons, smash through obstacles, and aim for the most outrageous combos. The more insane your flip, the higher your score. But beware — one bad landing and it’s ragdoll mayhem!

title: Sportsball Merge
description:
Stretch, pull, and jump! Lets workout and be active in Sports Merge.

Drop the orbs filled with energy to discover new and exciting forms of exercise. Merge them all but be careful how high you jump!

What is the highest score you can reach? Come play now and lets find out!

title: GenFire
description:
GenFire is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where players fight endless waves of enemies in intense 360° combat.

Survive increasingly difficult levels, defeat elemental creatures, and collect coins while mastering your strategy.

Features:
- 20 handcrafted levels across multiple chapters
- Unique enemy mechanics including splitting fire slimes and bosses
- Skill-based gameplay with increasing difficulty

title: Greek Tower Stacker
description:
Build the tallest structure by stacking beautiful new floors. Each floor contains intricate pillars and arches reminiscent of the mighty Greek civilization.

Challenge yourself to create the most majestic tower in ancient history.

title: Mow It
description: Mow It Harvest is a colorful simulator in which you will have a farm and your own harvester at your disposal. You need to cut grass, sell colorful hay and move on to new levels. Cut grass like a real farmer and become a millionaire in this bright, exciting game!

title: PoppyTile
description: PoppyTile is a soothing and delightful tile-matching puzzle game set in a peaceful, picturesque countryside farm full of charm!

title: Komaru cat
description:
Take care of Komaru the cat! Pet her, feed her, bathe her, and tuck her in for sleep!
Dress her up in stylish looks! Hats, glasses, collars, new fur colors, and more! Experiment and create your own unique cat!
Play the merge mini-game, compete on the leaderboard, and earn coins!
Watch the best video memes with funny moments from her life!
Complete the daily challenges and come back tomorrow, Komaru will miss you!
Try to unlock all achievements! Come and have fun!

title: Logic Blast Explorer
description: A fresh twist on the classic block puzzle experience, featuring hundreds of handcrafted levels, relaxing yet strategic gameplay, world landmarks to collect, boosters and custom tile skins.

title: Make It Boom!
description: Explosive puzzle adventure that challenges your strategy and timing skills! Your mission is simple: burst firecrackers to create thrilling chain reactions and clear each level. But beware—this isn’t just any ordinary puzzle game!

title: Jump Up 3D: Basketball Game
description: Jump Up 3D is a sports basketball game where you shoot to get that slam dunk, but the one hitch is you're doing it by jumping on a trampoline. Not your ordinary basketball game, this one promises and delivers the excitement! Take aim, bounce on the trampoline, and score baskets before your opponent. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, it tests your precision and unleashes your inner dunk master.

title: Chicken Strike
description: Meet the new exciting third-person shooter - Chicken Strike! Here you will act as a brave chicken who fights with opponents in different conditions. Buy a variety of skins to make your chicken unique. Enjoy jumping like a real chicken. Get ready for intense battles and become a true chicken champion!

title: Obby Tower Parkour Climb
description:
Dive into the parkour adventure with Obby in the Hell Tower game theme. Climb colored platforms and get to the finished platform for a great reward.
The game contains three hell tower maps easy, medium, and hard. Play these maps in two different modes normal mode and challenge mode. Try to do your best timing in challenge mode in either single-player or 2 player game mode. You can also compete against your friend in normal mode in the 2-player game mode option.

title: Bang Bang Mahjong
description:
In Bang Bang Mahjong, we mix classic Mahjong with a sliding puzzle twist. It might seem simple at first, but as the levels get trickier, every move counts. Move the tiles around and match identical ones.

Power-ups like shuffle, remove, or hints can help when things get tough. With each completed level, the challenge grows—but so does the satisfaction of solving it. Who can master every puzzle and clear the board like a pro?

title: Draw One Part Brain Puzzle
description: Ready to test your creativity and logic? Draw One Part: Brain Puzzle is a fun and clever brain teaser puzzle game that combines thinking with drawing. Each level shows an incomplete picture, and your task is to draw the missing part to solve the puzzle.

title: Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolution
description: Welcome to the world of "Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolution"! This free online game is perfect for children and teenagers. Develop your logic and strategic thinking while taking part in epic battles with monsters. You will control an army of fire, water, earth and air elementals in an exciting battle to liberate their worlds.

title: Ships 3D IO
description: Ships 3D is an IO game, multiplayer sailing ship simulator. The game is played in 'first person' where you control the sailor and move around the ship; interacting with the helm, sails and cannons. Sink enemy ships and shoot other players to score points.

title: Just Ludo
description: Just Ludo is a tabletop dice board game. Roll the dice and let your chess pieces reach the finish line first, so as to defeat the opponent and win rich rewards. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: PopSortica
description:
PopSortica is a new chapter in Poppy’s adventures! Join the underwater SORTING voyage! Challenging yet relaxing levels await as you sort things out.
The rules are simple, but the difficulty increases with each new level.
Special obstacles and conditions will challenge your skills, while boosters will help you achieve the best results faster.
Dive deep with Mermaid Poppy and challenge yourself in this exciting sea sorting adventure!

title: Tung Sahur Coloring
description: Tung Sahur Coloring is a colorful joyride just waiting to happen! This super fun coloring game for kids turns every blank page into a chance to sparkle with creativity. Grab your virtual crayons and get ready to dive into the world of Tung Sahur, where imagination runs wild and colors know no rules. From cheerful characters to wacky shapes, each page is your personal canvas. Fill it with the wildest colors you can think of—green suns, purple trees, rainbow hats—anything goes here!

title: Cupid’s Story: Love Archer Bow
description: In Cupid's Story: Love Archer Bow, you play as a love archer armed with a trusty bow. Your mission is to shoot love arrows that connect hearts and spark romance. Aim carefully and watch as sparks fly and love blooms in the most unexpected places. Mix and match hearts to create unique and charming couples, from quirky characters to unlikely pairings. The possibilities are endless in this one-of-a-kind game.

title: iColorcoin Sort Puzzle
description: icolorcoin  a reflexes and strategy thinking game.,designed color  sort game! This game so creativity and gameplay. this game like Ball Sort, Water Sort, and merge games is its incredibly straightforward gameplay. Your objective is to arrange chips of the same color together and merge them into larger numbers when a grid is filled, creating a challenging and addictively fun game, for all ages.

title: Unscrew Them All
description: Unscrew Them All is a challenging  puzzle game where players must strategically unscrew all the screws securing large wooden planks to the board. After removing each screw, place it into the correct open slot. Unscrew all the planks before time runs out to complete each level. Master every level to win the game!

title: My Arcade Center
description: My Arcade Center is a fast-paced management game where you build and expand your own arcade. Earn tokens by day, upgrade machines by night, hire staff, use coin bots, and handle freeloaders and vandals. Unlock new machines, optimize layouts, manage customer behavior, and progress through 9 handcrafted maps for long-term growth.

title: Find It Out Colorful Book
description: Begin a challenging yet relaxing casual game in Find It Out Colorful Book. It brings you into a colorful world. You will begin an adventure to find hidden objects. Choose your favorite mode like beach, city, zoo, etc. Each page is filled with color and mysterious numbers waiting to be discovered and unlocked.

title: Sniping aliens
description: Aliens skilled in disguise have quietly infiltrated Earth, and their traces may be found in every corner of the city. Find and kill them, and drive the evil aliens out of Earth!

title: My Purrfect Cat Hotel
description: Welcome to My Purrfect Cat Hotel, a super cute cat hotel simulation management game. Enjoy cute and vivid cartoon cat animations. This is the vacation spot for all meow stars, and your mission is to create the most cozy cat hotel. Serving a variety of adorable cats and catering to their needs. Make your hotel the most popular animal tycoon hotel.

title: Happy Bubbles
description: Boom! Hear that pop? The bubbles are calling! This classic bubble shooter blends quick reflexes with clever strategy. Spin the Lucky Wheel for extra rewards, claim weekly bonus and dive into a bright, cute world that never runs out of fun.

title: Super Ninja Balloon
description:
Aim your sharp Ninja Shurikens and pop as many Balloons as possible in fun and exciting puzzle challenges. Create amazing combos, hit tricky shots, and clear each level with fast reflexes and smart moves.
Every victory takes you further into a colorful balloon-popping adventure filled with cheerful worlds, playful action, and satisfying explosions. Unlock new challenges, enjoy vibrant visuals, and become the Super Ninja Balloon master.

title: Small Wardrobe
description: Small Wardrobe is a casual game designed specifically for cotton dolls. Collect and create beautiful and cute dresses for your cotton dolls, and experience heartwarming and fun stories. The game offers a variety of adorable doll clothes, shoes, and accessories. Let's happily organize and tidy up the doll's wardrobe together!

title: Magic Beauty Makeup
description: Welcome to Magic Beauty Makeup, a casual and relaxing girl makeover game on H5games4u. The girl is in trouble with her appearance. Help her return to her original beauty with skin care and makeup methods. You will act as a makeover artist who does skin care, applies facial makeup, and designs a perfect look in the virtual fashion salon. And the best part? All the makeup procedures are done just by clicking and dragging.

title: Block Blast 2048
description: Block Blast 2048 is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you merge blocks with the same number to create higher values. Keep merging to boost your score and face increasing challenges. How far can you go? Can you reach the ultimate block? Play now and test your puzzle skills!

title: K-Pop Hunter Fashion
description: Unleash your creativity in K-Pop Hunter Fashion, a unique dress up game where trendy K-Pop meets gothic demon hunter vibes. Style glamorous idols in bold K-Pop looks while blending them with dark, fantasy-inspired outfits. From leather jackets and spiked boots to neon hair, glowing makeup, and mystical accessories—you’ll create fierce, otherworldly fashion statements.

title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 5
description: The highly anticipated 5th installation of one of the most popular Solitaire Card Games of all time! Foxy, the game’s cute little character, will take you on a journey to new destinations, visiting distant countries, fantastic landscapes, and famous landmarks.

title: Moto Cabbie Simulator
description: Welcome to Moto Cabbie Simulator, where the thrill of the open road meets the fast-paced world of urban transportation! In this exhilarating and immersive gaming experience, players take on the role of a daring motorcycle taxi rider navigating the bustling streets of a vibrant city.

title: Digital Circus IO
description:
Grim AI gathered amazing creatures at the circus arena and offered them the chance to compete for life here!
Pick your character and get as much territory as you can! Run from your starting territory and return to add a chunk of space. Evade other characters or defeat them by stepping on their trail.

title: Link Flow
description: Enter the mesmerizing world of Link Flow, where logic meets creativity in a captivating puzzle experience! In this minimalist yet visually stunning game, your goal is simple: connect the dots with seamless lines, recreating intricate patterns that test your problem-solving skills.

title: Marble Puzzle Quest
description: Marble Puzzle Quest is a fun and addictive casual puzzle game where your task is to sort colorful marbles into the correct slots. With each new level, the challenge grows — chains become longer and more colorful, while the space for moves gets tighter. Use logic, plan ahead, and clear the board! Watch out: the marbles fill four slots at the top, and only three of the same color will disappear. Place them incorrectly, and you lose the round.

title: Hide and Build a Bridge!
description:
Welcome to the exciting world of "Hide and Build a Bridge"!

In this exciting game your goal is to collect blocks on the level and build a bridge from them to the portal. But be careful! There are also other players in the level who are trying to reach the goal together with you, and a seeker who breaks bridges and catches runners.

title: Pop Them!
description:
Link 3 or more emojis of the same color!
Link them in any direction to connect them all!
Reach the goal within the limited number of moves
Pop the bubbles around the boxes or evil emojis to destroy them
Use power-ups to accomplish your mission!

title: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Rooms
description: Immerse yourself in a game where the process of coloring becomes truly meditative. Create and decorate houses as a designer. Just touch the screen and the colors will match the numbers in the image. Forget about boring routine - now you are thinking about color combinations. For even more relaxation, a music player has been added.

title: Animal Bus Traffic Jam
description: All aboard for the cutest puzzle ride ever in Animal Bus Traffic Jam. This clever match-3 sort puzzle and casual logic game challenges you to help adorable animal passengers find their correct buses. Each level is a traffic jam of colorful buses filled with cats, dogs, pandas, and more. Your mission is to sort the animals by type or color, match them into the right buses, and clear the jam with smart moves.

title: CS: Upgrade Gun
description: The weapon is alive and ready to go hunting! In this fast-paced launcher, you control a cannon that runs itself and shoots at targets. Collect boosters, improve their performance and last as long as possible. The further you go, the more action and explosions!

title: Untwist Road
description: Collect cylinders, roll out the road and overcome obstacles in this unique game. It is suitable for all fans of arcade games who like to test their skills and reactions. Try all the features of the game, unlock new levels and beat your records! You only need a few minutes to fully immerse yourself in this exciting game. Try it yourself!

title: Candy Match Puzzle
description:
Dive into a delightful puzzle experience with Candy Puzzle Match, where matching candies is all about tapping! Simply tap on groups of two or more adjacent candies of the same color to clear them from the board. The more candies you clear at once, the higher your score!

Watch the board shift and cascade with every move as you complete deliciously fun objectives. With colorful visuals and satisfying chain reactions, this game is perfect for fans of casual and relaxing puzzle games.

title: Arrow Count Master
description: Arrow Count Master is a fast and satisfying runner where every choice changes your firepower. Swipe to move and choose between gates that add, subtract, multiply, or boost your arrows. Build the biggest arrow count possible while avoiding penalties and obstacles along the way.

title: Drop Bricks Breaker
description: Drop Bricks Breaker is an interesting casual puzzle game. You can relax yourself during play time. You only need to tap the screen to aim the bricks, then launch the ball. Isn't easy it? Come to try it now! Have a great time!

title: Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire
description: Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire is an adrenaline-pumping endless running game that combines the thrill of shooting with the excitement of parkour. You must swiftly collect bullets and ammo packs to keep your gun firing. The obstacles are everywhere, but with quick reflexes and precise aiming, you can dodge them all. With its fast-paced gameplay, stunning visuals, and addictive soundtrack, Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire will keep you on the edge of your seat for hours on end.

title: Pet Salon 2
description: Take care of the cutest puppy and cat that you can bathe, help it when it is sick and choose an outfit  and dress it up! Pet Salon 2 is very helpful for the daycare of your pet and have too much fun with this game.

title: Find It In The Haunted Mansion
description: “Find It In The Haunted Mansion” is a finding style game, where you are a detective and need to find all the keys hidden in each part of the house to complete all the levels.

title: C.A.P.
description:
Take to the skies and protect the carrier in this shooter inspired by WW2 dogfights. 
Dodge enemy fighters, protect your aircraft carrier, and blast through waves of incoming planes. 
Remember to come back to the carrier to refuel!
With crisp pixel-art 3D visuals and one-touch controls, this shooter delivers satisfying action perfect for short play.

title: Supermarket Sort N Match
description: In 'Supermarket Sort n Match,' rearrange items between shelves to match 3 identical items on one shelf, clearing it and allowing upper shelves to slide down. Clear entire stacks to shift adjacent shelves. Collect all items before time runs out as difficulty increases with each level. Enjoy the ultimate item-sorting and matching challenge!

title: Fire Truck Driving Simulator
description: Fire Truck Driving Simulator is a fire truck driving simulation game with 4 different modes. In Level Mode, you need to arrive at the fire area and put it out in time in 10 levels. In City Mode, you have a chance to decide to accept the emergency missions on the street freely. In Free Mode, you can train your fireman knowledge without any limitations. In Parking Mode, you can forget about fire-rescue missions and train your parking skills. Enjoy your fireman time!

title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes

title: Vice City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning sports car through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Mage's Secret
description: Combine monsters and increase your power by thinking every action. You have to meet monsters, complete more than 100 tasks and learn the secret of the magician.

title: Golden Frontier
description: This simulation game takes you on a Wild West adventure. Mine and manage resources, grow crops and craft goods as you aim to build a thriving city in the frontier lands. Invite friends to become your neighbors to trade and co-op, and progress quicker. Hunt for gold, unlock new locations, and discover secrets as the story unfolds. Meet a colorful cast of characters, including trappers, Indians and criminals.

title: Puzzle Box Brain Fun
description: Puzzle Box - Brain Fun is a brain game containing multiple modes. Different levels of difficulty and gameplay are waiting for you to unlock! Challenge your intelligence while enjoying casual games! Come and challenge Puzzle Box - Brain Fun to test your IQ and play with your brain! Start when you are ready and show your strength!

title: Force Master 3D
description: Force Master 3D is a battle Math online game for boys for free. In the game, all the enemies are waiting for you at each level. You need to give priority to attacking monsters lower than yourself. The more monsters you attack, the higher your level will be. Be sure to pay attention to your own strength, because only in this way can you not be destroyed by the enemy!

title: Restaurant VIP Masterchef
description: Restaurant VIP is a game where you have to run a restaurant and bring your management skills to every diner! Survive the daily target to get high score.

title: Move the rubber bands: Logic puzzle
description:
In this game you need to put the rubber bands in their places.
At the start of the level, rubber bands are scattered across the field. Your task is to move the cutters along the pins and place the cutters on the platforms of the corresponding color.
Your task is to solve logic puzzles. It won't always be easy to come up with a solution. Sometimes you will need to strain your logic and ability to navigate in space.

title: Nuts & Bolts Sort: Color Puzzle
description: Play Color Sort Puzzle: Nuts & Bolts free online and challenge your mind in a clever browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Unscrew, swap, and organize bolts by color in a satisfying logic puzzle that works as a focused brain game for all ages. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game built for smart, addictive sorting fun anytime.

title: Math Crossword Puzzle - Genius Edition
description: Challenge your brain with Math Crossword, the perfect mix of logic puzzles and number games! Solve clever math equations in a crossword-style grid by placing the correct numbers into the right spots. Each level sharpens your brain with fun and rewarding challenges that test your addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division skills.

title: Unicorn Find The Differences
description: Unicorn Find The Differences is a magical spot-the-difference game designed to test your observation skills and bring a bit of fantasy into your day! Each level offers beautifully crafted images with subtle differences that make every game exciting and engaging. Perfect for both kids and adults, this game is a delightful way to relax, challenge your attention to detail, and enjoy charming unicorn illustrations. See if you can spot all the differences and reach the next level of mythical fun!

title: Stickman Ragdoll Playground
description: Build-A-Flop: The Sickman Playground is not just a game—it's a people's playground of laughter and creativity! With its whimsical world and endless opportunities for hilarity, it's sure to become a favorite among players of all ages.

title: Super Star Animal Salon
description: Welcome to Super Star - Animal Salon, a paws - itively delightful casual simulator game that's perfect for girls with a passion for fashion and animals! In this game, you step into the role of a superstar animal stylist. Your very own salon awaits, filled with all the tools of the trade. First, meet your furry, feathery, or scaly clients. There are cute puppies with a zebra, an elephant, and a leopard. Start with the hair.

title: Funny Balls 2048
description: Funny Balls 2048 combines the 2048 genre with physics. Drop bouncing balls so that to collapse them with identical ones and get a ball of 2 times more value. The game has boosters that will make the game more exciting, as well as different ball skins.

title: Gloves of Block
description:
Become the last line of defense and lead your nation to World Cup glory!

Step into the gloves of your national team’s goalkeeper in this thrilling reflex-based football game. Your mission is simple: protect the net, stop the shots, and carry your team to the top. Choose your country and dive into a series of high-stakes matches where each save counts!

Opponents get tougher as you advance, stronger nations will demand sharper reflexes and quicker decisions. Can you lift the World Cup trophy?

title: Zombie Siege.io
description: As a soldier at the last base with unlimited potential, you must arm yourself and battle against dangerous zombies! Use your wisdom to select the best weapons, skills, and talents to defend against waves of zombies. How many maps will you be able to save?

title: Mermaidcore Makeup
description: In Mermaidcore Makeup, you ladies can step into the shoes of a talented makeup artist and work your magic on three stunning ladies. Journey into the realm of fantasy as you help these beauties achieve their perfect, enchanting looks. Prepare for a sensational trip filled with endless options as you explore an extensive selection of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascara, lipsticks, face patterns, and intricate shoulder and neck patterns that perfectly match each girl's unique style and personality.

title: Sea Match
description: See Match is a challenging match-3 puzzle game. Connect 3 or more of the same fishes horizontally or diagonally. The more fishes you match, the higher your score! Keep an eye on the time. You will fail to pass the level if you do not gather sufficient grids in time. The faster you complete the task, the more stars you earn! If you find yourself stuck, you can always use the special bonuses to help you.

title: Stickman The Flash
description: Stickman The Flash is a fighting RPG arcade game with 2D stickman warriors. In the Survival Mode, you need to survive as long as you can by dodging red areas and killing incoming enemies. You can collect different weapons when you kill the corresponding enemies. When you earn enough gems, you can unlock and equip them in the Equipment Store, and they will increase your full abilities. Keep calm and slaughter them all!

title: Happy Brothers
description: The New Year has arrived, and the two siblings have decorated the house beautifully. The siblings are very happy, but they want to go outside. To leave the house, they need to find the key and the yellow diamond. If they find both and activate the portal, they can escape the house. The two siblings, wearing Christmas clothes, begin searching for the key inside the house. They also need to gather the gift boxes.

title: MineBlocks 3D Maze
description: MineBlocks 3D Maze: A Mind-Bending Adventure in a Blocky World! Get ready to step into a world of puzzles and creativity with MineBlocks 3D Maze—an incredible game that’s perfect for kids and adults alike. If you’re a fan of brain-teasers and enjoy a good challenge, this 3D puzzle game is exactly what you need. It’s all about strategy, logic, and a little bit of muscle (virtual, of course)!  Push the blocks strategically to guide them onto the altars scattered across the level.

title: Exo Observation
description: Exo Observation is a space exploration incremental game where you uncover alien worlds and study mysterious lifeforms. You’ll collect resources, build advanced orbital science facilities, and manage them efficiently to progress. Each discovery pushes you closer to unlocking warp gates, letting you expand across the galaxy, and continue your quest for knowledge among distant stars.

title: Perfect Piano Magic
description: Perfect Piano Magic is a fun casual game. If you are a big fan of Piano Magic games, then this is a game you can't afford to miss! The gameplay of this game is extremely similar to Piano Magic, you need to shoot the blocks with a gun to capture the beat. You have three chances per game, start now and feel the real music when you click the blocks, enjoy the beats, and get ready to experience the delightful music and become a rhythm master!

title: Mustang City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate realistic traffic and monitor your fuel while exploring busy streets. Enjoy stunning night city graphics, transforming the city into a neon-lit spectacle. Pedestrians add unpredictability, and hitting them triggers police chases. Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Mustang City Driver offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.

title: Walkers Attack
description: Walkers Attack is an action-adventure game. The end of the world is coming, make your way through a world full of danger and survive! Experience non-stop action with auto-fire and strategic movement. Gather resources, defeat hordes of zombies, and complete missions to unlock new themed levels ranging from sci-fi to medieval and urban. As the levels increase, so does the challenge. Are you ready to embark on a survival adventure? Can you be humanity's last hope? Good luck!

title: Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle
description:
Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle! is a relaxing and brain-teasing puzzle game where you must spot, drag, and fix the misplaced parts of beautiful images.
Each level challenges you to find hidden pieces, pull them out, and place them exactly where they belong.
With handcrafted levels, soothing music, and satisfying visuals, it's the perfect game to relax and train your observation skills.
Can you restore every picture to perfection?

title: Ultimate Transport Driving Sim
description: The realistic and enjoyable driving characteristics of Ultimate automobile Driving Simulator combine to make it the best automobile driving simulator for mobile devices. The best driving physics are found in the best vehicle driving simulator! All types of vehicles, from off-road SUVs to race automobiles, have their unique physics!

title: Block Puzzle - Jewel Forest
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Archers Ragdoll Physics
description: Archers Ragdoll Physics is a physics-based archery action game where ragdoll characters fight using special arrows. The game features 10 characters and 12 unique arrows such as lightning, fire, poison, missile, and rocket. Players can equip three arrows and switch between them during battles. Some levels include traps like electric cables and spinning gears that can be activated with arrows. In 2 Player Mode, players choose from 7 arrows and compete to hit their opponent the most.

title: Mech Monster Arena
description: Mech Monster Arena is a robot-fighting turn-based strategy game. Differently in this fighting game, you don't need to learn how to operate the robot and release each skill. You only need to learn the basic skill counter rules and select the skills flexibly. By earning EXPs and coins from battles in Mech Battle, you can fight with AI opponents and develop your robot. When you have some sources to upgrade your robot in the Mech Warehouse, you can challenge other players in the Arena. Have fun!

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

title: Connect Clues - The Missing Professor
description:
A tangled detective story is about to unfold.

Inspector Hale and Detective Crane are on the trail of a mysteriously vanished professor of history and archaeology — who also happens to be Crane’s old friend.
Professor Eldridge was always a touch eccentric, but disappearing without a word and leaving his office turned upside down was never part of his habits. He’s clearly in trouble — and in need of help.

title: The Trendy Mermaid
description: Embark on an exciting journey of makeup, accessories, and fashion to help Ariel make an unforgettable comeback. With a wide selection of clothes, makeup, and accessories, help Ariel become the trendiest mermaid ever. Enjoy making her look dreamy and fabulous - The Trendy Mermaid is free to play for every girl.

title: Car Out Jam
description:
Car Parking. A puzzle game with cars and passengers.
Complete interesting levels with various mechanics!
The game will be interesting for both who want to relax leisurely and for those who like to unravel complex moves.
Easy levels are combined with more difficult ones. And some will be a real challenge for your brain!

title: Master Blender
description: Becoming the Strongest Bartending Master！Tap the bottle lightly to pour water. Organize the water so that each bottle's water is distributed to the corresponding colored cup!

title: Overprotective Boyfriend
description: Imagine the beautiful Princess Marie standing in front of a mirror, looking at her reflection. Her eyes are shining, and a sly smile plays on her lips. She is ready to put on an outfit that will emphasize her grace and charm. But then her lover appears and frowns: «My dear, are you really going to wear such an open dress?» Marie knows that her faithful knight sometimes takes too much care of her, but today she intends to look dazzling!

title: Vikings: An Archer's Journey
description: Vikings: An Archer’s Journey blends the fast-paced action of a shoot ’em up with the adrenaline rush of an infinite runner, all presented in a striking minimalist art style. Play as Nott, a fearless Valkyrie archer, on a quest to save her wolf, Oder, from the Underworld. Use intuitive controls, collect powerful upgrades, and team up with Viking heroes to face off against mythical Nordic creatures in this thrilling adventure.

title: Huggy Wuggy Escape
description: Huggy Wuggy Escape is a Poppy Playtime inspired fangame where you have to do 4 simple things in order to win: Find a gun, find some bullets, shoot down Huggy Wuggy and leave the factory before it explode. To kill Huggy you have to shoot him at least six times, but the bullets are rare, so you have to move around the complex looking for them. If Huggy catch you is game over. Once you shot him down, you have to reach the exit in less than 30 seconds.

title: Nuclear Day Survival
description:
Can you survive in a world where there was a nuclear explosion? There is radiation, hunger, disease and suffering around you. Your goal is to escape the dying city and find the love of your youth. A unique atmosphere and a heart-piercing plot. Uncover the mystery of the missing documents and make a choice: save the people around you or leave them to die..

Peculiarities:
— Crafting system
— Unique plot
— Exploring an interesting world

title: Mr. Dude: King of the Hill
description:
The famous criminal Mister Dude found himself on the top of a mountain, where residents were waiting for him, ready to hand him over to the police. Help him avoid getting caught, defeat all enemies and conquer the mountain!
Game Features:
Your goal is to knock out, drag and throw your opponents using physics and fun ragdoll effects. The game has a huge number of different objects that you can manipulate and throw at your opponents, different enemies, levels and modes.

title: Tsunami Brainrots Online
description: Tsunami Brainrots Online is a fast-paced survival experience inspired by meme culture and chaotic movement gameplay. Players must escape a massive tsunami wave while exploring dangerous areas, collecting valuable brainrot characters, and returning safely before time runs out. The game offers an online single-player mode where you can interact with others through chat, as well as a local 2 player option for shared-screen action.

title: Slope Snowball
description: Slope SnowBall is an intriguing endless-running game with a winter theme. Your aim is to roll a snowball as far as possible down slopes full of hazards!

title: Merge Hero - Survival Tower Defense
description:
Quickly merge heroes to defend against monster attacks in intense tower defense battles.
Merge Heroes is a strategy tower defense game. Form and upgrade your hero units to prepare for an epic conflict battle that will test your wisdom and abilities.

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Idle Town Billionaire
description: Dive into the world of entrepreneurship by purchasing lots in the town and building a variety of businesses. This idle game allows your businesses to automatically generate profit, even while you're away. Hire managers to boost your earnings and optimize your operations. Expand your business empire by strategically investing in new properties and upgrades.

title: Hidden Object Great Journey
description: “Hidden Object: Great Journey” is an engaging game that invites players to scour various themed levels for cleverly concealed items. With multiple modes, a lot of challenges, and a treasure trove of objects to find, this game promises endless fun for hidden object enthusiasts. Sharpen your observation skills and embark on a delightful search with every play!

title: Super Swing
description: Dive into the thrilling world of Super Swing, where you’ll swing, fly, and solve hilarious puzzles in this hyper-casual adventure! Play as a daring stickman hero, swinging through colorful and lively scenes filled with quirky challenges and creative problem-solving opportunities.

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description: Step into the delightful world of Connect Puzzle Image, a game designed to tease your brain and sharpen your observation skills. Match and connect a variety of funny characters, tasty foods, and interesting objects as you progress through colorful levels. Easy to play yet delightfully challenging, this free online puzzle game offers hours of relaxing entertainment on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Rough Ball
description: Bounce wildly in Rough Ball! Control your cute purple ball across wall-to-wall platforms, dodging spikes, skulls, and deadly drops. Collect shiny coins, unlock free burger skins, and conquer chaotic levels. Don't fall down—jump, roll, and thrive in pixel-perfect adventure!

title: Stick Kill 3D
description: Play as a stickman armed with a pistol in this puzzle-based shooter, where precision and clever thinking are key. Find the right angle, line up your shots, and eliminate enemies in creative ways. Each level becomes more challenging, testing your accuracy and problem-solving skills.

title: Jetstream Escape
description: Play Jetstream Escape free online and dive into a high-speed browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install required. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, making it perfect for quick breaks or long sessions. Race powerful boats, dodge coast guards, and outrun storms in this mobile-friendly arcade challenge. Designed for desktop and mobile players who love skill-based brain game style reflex tests, it’s a free online game built for pure,nonstop.

title: Hexa Sort
description: Hexa Sort offers a delightful blend of puzzle challenges, strategic matching, and satisfying merging experience. Engage your mind with stimulating brain games that involve clever puzzle solving and logical maneuvers, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a mental workout.

title: Blind Boat Shooting Master
description: Craft your raft and navigate through the colorful world. Take aim and fire to vanquish foes and gather riches. Featuring a unique comic book aesthetic and a diverse roster of over 30 characters, Raft Wars provides endless hours of fun for players of all skill levels. Dive into engaging turn-based battles against other pirates, thieves, and raft fighters as you journey across various lands and discover new territories. Dont miss out on the excitement - join the adventure today!

title: Roof Car Stunt
description: Challenging car game where you drive and collect coins. Jump around ramps, drive through various obstacles and drive into a giant pink donut to complete the level!

title: Dead Zone Mech Ops
description:
Dead Zone: Mech Ops thrusts players into the heart of a scorched Earth ravaged by endless war, where autonomous factions and rogue AI compete for control over the planet’s last remaining strongholds. You are a combat pilot in the elite “Mech Ops” unit — the final line of defense in a world on the brink of total collapse.
Players will command next-gen combat exosuits equipped with modular weapon systems, advanced targeting tech, and adaptive armor that reacts to battlefield conditions.

title: angry snake io
description: Angry Snake io " is an exciting and addictive arcade game where you take control of a fierce, hungry snake on a mission to grow, survive, and dominate the arena! Slither through a vibrant world, gobbling up colorful orbs to grow longer and stronger. But watch out—danger lurks around every corner! Avoid obstacles, outsmart traps, and navigate increasingly challenging levels as your snake grows bigger and faster.

title: Head Soccer Arena
description: Head Soccer Arena takes you into a fast-paced football world! Play 2-player matches on the same device, dive into quick games, or rise through 15 leagues in Career Mode. Win matches, collect coins and diamonds, and upgrade your power-ups—ice, lightning, anvil, big head, and more! Unlock new characters and dominate the field with strategy, skill, and speed. Every match is a step toward football glory!

title: Sprunki Match
description:
Sprunki Match: Train Your Brain with Sprunki Insanity!

Flip cards, match pairs, and enter the absurdly adorable world of Sprunki — the viral meme sensation! Test your memory across 30 colorful levels packed with expressive Sprunki characters, each more ridiculous than the last. With vibrant cartoon graphics, two game modes, and pure chaos in every flip, it’s time to sharpen your brain and embrace the Sprunki madness. Who knew memory games could be this unhinged?

title: Crowd Clash Rush
description: In this action-packed game, players will step into the shoes of a fearless warrior, ready to take on hordes of enemies. The game takes place in a vibrant and immersive 3D world, offering stunning visuals and realistic sound effects that will captivate players from the beginning.

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 4
description: Solitaire Farm: Seasons 4 is here with over 3,800+ levels and fresh adventures! Explore beautiful new maps like Greenland, South Korea, Sumatra, and Nepal while growing unique crops such as Mountain Avens, Ginkgo, Durian, Flax, and Orchids. With new level packs, seasonal events, and charming visuals, this relaxing solitaire journey is more exciting than ever. Ready to train your brain and enjoy country life? Dive into the adventure now!

title: Human Evolution Run
description: Start with a skeleton, choose your evolution route.

title: Save The Sheep
description: Save The Sheep offers an immersive mental challenge as you step into the shoes of a shepherd. Relentless wolves have invaded your flock, seeking to feast on your precious sheep. Safeguard your flock by strategically placing wooden stakes to separate them from the predators. Experience the electrifying thrill of rescuing sheep and demonstrate your unmatched intellect in this captivating game.

title: Battle Zone 2D
description: Immerse yourself in a dynamic 2D top-down shooter. Fight on a vast map, search for weapons, ammo, and gear to survive epic battles. Use strategy, cover, and tactics to become the last survivor. Simple controls, fast-paced matches, and thrilling gameplay make the game accessible to everyone. Test your skills, defeat enemies, and prove that you are the best fighter!

title: 2 Player Battle
description: Seeking an exciting way to spend time with friends and family is most significant. Look no further than Party Battle, the ultimate 2-4 player game! With 30 different games, this exciting collection has something for everyone.

title: Mutant run
description: When you are running on a track full of various obstacles, you need to choose to go through the mutation gate to evolve your body, gain the talents of specific animals, and clear the obstacles in the road!

title: GT Cars Mega Ramps
description: Exotic cars, mega ramps, colorful giant bosses and face to face races all come together in this game. GT Cars Mega Ramps invites you to a fantastic driving experience with its completely unique game-play. Fly over mega ramps with your customized exotic car, destroy giant bosses or try to finish the stages first in face to face races!

title: Crazy Traffic Control
description:
You control the traffic in the most realistic, craziest one-touch traffic game!
Put your timing and skills to the test with:

- realistic traffic 
- realistic acceleration   
- realistic stopping times!
- trains
- cows
- pedestrians

Unbelievably absorbing and incredibly fun — clear the intersections with Crazy Traffic Control!

title: Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training
description:
Challenge your memory, speed and attention in "Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training". Watch boxes appear, remember the count, then submit your guess faster and more accurate each round wins.

Enjoy single-player focus mode or competitive rounds vs local friend or multiplayer. Simple tap controls, short rounds, addictive replayability perfect for quick brain workouts on desktop and mobile.

Train memory, logic, agility and reaction time now!

title: Children's doctor: treating ears
description: Ready to become the best pediatric doctor in the world? Learn to use medical instruments, give first aid to patients? Play our doctor without downloads, registration and absolutely free!

title: Ludo Star
description: Enter the arena of strategy and chance! Choose your favorite mode, unlock stylish dice skins and climb the trophy road. Outsmart opponents, master your moves and prove you’ve got what it takes to rule the board and become a Ludo Star.

title: Hero Fight Clash
description: A thrilling adventure, hearty duel, don't you want to play a horizontal fighting game like Hero Fight Clash? Various cool skills, choose your favorite hero, keep adventuring, keep upgrading, and defeat more powerful enemies.

title: Wave Chic Ocean Fashion Frenzy
description: Welcome to the game in which every new tide carries a new wave of style! Help two girlfriends to celebrate the new beach season with dignity. Each of the girls has her own unique sense of fashion and style. Combine swimsuits with a variety of accessories to create unique summer looks. And don't forget to pick up a surfboard or a sapboard. Get ready for adventures on the water and to become the most stylish on the whole coast!

title: Shape Transform Blob Racing
description: Shape Transform: Blob Racing is a casual running game. In this game, you will control a little Blob, running, shape-shifting, and go through various challenges! It would help if you quickly switched the Blob’s shape while running to navigate various obstacles. For example, turning into a ball helps you roll through narrow passages. When you become a square, it helps you cross flat areas more  easily.

title: Stick Hero Battle
description: Stick Hero Battle is a fast-paced and explosive action fighting game that throws you straight into intense battle arenas. The game features easy-to-learn controls with deep combat mechanics. Control a fearless stick hero and fight your way through waves of enemies using powerful attacks, smart movement, and perfect timing.

title: Mojo Emoji
description: Moji Emoji is a fun and clever word/emoji puzzle game where each level challenges you to guess the hidden word or phrase from a set of expressive emojis. Think fast, connect the clues, and test your emoji decoding skills across hundreds of creative puzzles.

title: GunFu Stickman 2
description:
Armed with a pistol in each hand, take control of the famous Stickman from the "Gun Fu" series and blast through hordes of enemies!

Reflexes and reaction times will be challenged and put to the test as the never-ending onslaught gets faster and faster!

Unlock more deadly guns and outfits, and customize your Stickman to suit your style!
