description: Become a top pizza delivery expert! Race through city streets, dodge obstacles, and switch between vehicles to deliver pizzas on time. Earn money, upgrade your gear, and master exciting challenges. Fast-paced, fun, and addictive—start delivering now!

title: Stickman Shooter Bros
description:
Stickman Shooter Bros
Ready for action? Choose one of your 3 stickman characters with different powers and defeat your enemies with 4 different weapons.
Melt your enemies with the lava gun, destroy them with the minigun, deal damage from close range with the shotgun, and stun them with the teslagun.
Strong enemies, challenging bosses, and exciting levels await you.
Stickman Shooters is an immersive top-down shooter game.

title: Toilet Roll
description: Remember the fun of unrolling toilet paper as a kid? Now relive that joy in a fast-paced game. Unwind as many rolls as you can in one minute, but be careful not to tear the paper—it costs valuable time. Earn points for upgrades. Play Toilet Roll for free and let your inner child loose!

title: Easter Eggventure
description: Welcome to Easter Eggventure! Embark on an exciting journey to find Easter eggs scattered throughout the beautiful spring landscape. Your mission is to discover the hidden Easter eggs and collect them all. Are you ready for this thrilling search game? Let's get started!

title: Idle Landmark Builder
description: Enjoy a casual idle simulation management game in the Idle Landmark - Builder. Here, you'll play the role of a construction tycoon and build world-famous landmarks from scratch. Manage workers to increase speed or your income, hire more workers and build your own construction empire. Build world-famous landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the Pyramids, and witness the entire process of their construction.

title: Merry Christmas Stickman
description: Help Stickman escape from jail just in time for the holidays! This time, he’s on his own, relying solely on a mysterious Christmas package filled with special items. Choose carefully to aid his breakout in this festive, story-driven adventure packed with seasonal surprises—can Stickman make it to freedom before the New Year?

title: Queens Royal: Sudoku Puzzle
description: Queens Royal: Sudoku Puzzle reimagines the classic eight queens challenge into a sleek logic game with over 5,000 levels. Place queens strategically so none share a row, column, or color zone while avoiding attacks in all directions. With elegant visuals, daily challenges, endless mode, and smart hints, every puzzle offers a unique test of reasoning and precision for players who enjoy refined brain-teasers.

title: Type Sprint
description: Are you good at typing on the keyboard or mobile? Type Sprint is both a running racing game and a typing relaxation game with 3D stickman players. It is managed for you to type fast to make platforms for your character to run forward as the first three. I think typing on PC is easier than it on mobile. Good luck and have fun!

title: Hit Knock Down
description: Hit & Knock Down is a fun casual game where you aim to throw baseballs. Shoot as many targets as possible. Test your precision, reaction speed, and throwing skills. You aim to hit the right targets in each level. The goals at the level are very varied, such as wood, stone, etc. Each level presents different targets. You should hit with a baseball.

title: Math Master
description: Unleash your inner math whiz! Math Master turns numbers into art—solve fun math problems to unlock drawing tools, sketch colorful shapes, and bring numerical puzzles to life. Perfect for learners and creativity lovers alike!

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: Robbie: Stand on the Right Color!
description:
Welcome to the vibrant world of speed and reaction!
You are about to be tested on your attentiveness and lightning-fast decisions. Your task is simple but tricky: step on the right color before the floor disappears beneath your feet!
Suitable for anyone who loves fast, simple, and addictive games.
Are you ready to help Robbie stand his ground?

title: Fishing Life
description: Fishing Life—a relaxing clicker game with 2D cartoon visuals. Choose your target fish, click the water to reel it in, and manage its energy. Prioritize upgrading Strength first. Skins enhance tap strength, outfits boost damage, and Keepnet nets extra prices. Assistants increase Income, Strength, Damage, and Price. Open chests and claim cash from charged drift bottles. Luck might grant you treasure chests—open them for valuable assistants!

title: Air Block
description:
Jump, Place Blocks, and Conquer Challenging Levels!

In Air Block, use quick reflexes and smart block placement to overcome obstacles and enemies. With limited blocks per level, every move counts! Avoid saws, spikes, and unlock doors to progress—plus, grab those bananas if you can!

Game Modes:

Single Player – Test your skills across unique levels.
Two-Player Mode – Compete in quick place challenges and mini-games like Beach Ball, with more to come!
Think you’ve got what it takes? Start now!

title: Venetian Love Affair
description: Go to the festive Venice and become a fashion stylist for two girlfriends, each of whom dreams of an unforgettable fancy dress. Create unique masks with great designs and choose luxurious Baroque dresses, jewelry and accessories. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of mystery and romance of the Venetian carnival. Unleash your talent as a fashion designer in a unique way for the masquerade participants. Get ready for a magical journey into the world of love and mysteries!

title: Army Truck Driver Online
description: Take control of a cargo army truck in a military game and deliver high-ranking soldiers to their camp. Carrying out your assignment as an army truck driver cargo in this military game is no easy feat, especially when you're an officer. The highways are filled with hazards and obstacles.

title: Coin Color Sort
description: Dive into the colorful world of Coin Color Sort, an addictive online puzzle game that puts your sorting skills to the test. Arrange and match coins by color to create perfect stacks and clear each level. With its relaxing yet challenging gameplay, this free game offers endless fun and mental exercise. Play anytime on your computer or phone and see how far your logic can take you!

title: Infantry Attack Battle 3D FPS
description: Soldier! Stop playing the escape game! The third world war is here, and the mission is waiting for you! The enemy is attacking our country, and we count on you to protect it, so grab your weapon and prepare to fight! Easy control to aim and shoot the enemy, finish each task to win the ultimate victory!

title: Prison Escape Online
description: Prison Escape Online is a fantastically stickman game where you... Well, help him to escape the prison! After being thrown in a prison cell, you must use your skills to escape! Nothing is off limits in your attempt to escape! But be careful not all ways are safe to escape.

title: Dino Hide N Shoot
description: Do you want to begin a fun dinosaur-themed shooting game in Dino Hide N Shoot? Play a brave gunman on an exciting adventure! In this game, you will constantly run to avoid the attack of dinosaurs.And pick up the bullets, accumulate enough firepower. Pay attention to using the box as cover,seize the moment to shoot at the dinosaur! The gameplay is simple yet challenging.

title: Farm Defense
description: Farm Defense is a fast, arcade-style shooter where you guard your ranch from waves of quirky mutants. Move between lanes, aim, and blast anything that crawls out of the burrows before it reaches your crops. Earn coins, unlock new weapons and gadgets, and power up your electric fence. Bright visuals, snappy controls, and escalating waves make every run tense and satisfying.

title: Castle Craft
description: Castle Craft is a mystical adventure puzzle game where you merge resources while looking for Fiona's missing husband, Michael, all the while uncovering plenty of mysteries along the way. Begin in a fog-covered land, using ancient keys to explore hidden realms and trace the path of your lost family through different eras.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Parkour World 2
description:
Welcome to Parkour World 2, an exhilarating Minecraft-inspired parkour game with thrilling challenges and delightful gameplay. 
-Each level in this game boasts its own distinct and features, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience every time you play. 
-While the initial levels may seem relatively simple, as you progress through the game. By the time you conquer the first ten levels, you'll find yourself facing increasingly demanding obstacles.
-Get ready to run, and conquer in Parkour World!

title: CANDY LOVE
description: Let's erase the same candies by matching 3 or more of them! You can take a candy from the tapped row and put it on the tapped row. The game ends when the candy reaches the bottom.

title: Grand Theft NY
description:
This amazing 3D game is a free online take on the legendary Grand Theft Auto game. As you play, you'll take control of a thief with assignments all throughout New York City. You have complete freedom to run and explore the game's open world.

Using the arrows to guide you to the control points, you must sprint across the city and complete over ten interactive levels.

In each level, you have the option to play missions with certain goals or just explore the world at your leisure.

title: Brain Find Can You Find It
description: Brain Find brings new brain puzzles! Combine brain power and discovery for a brain challenge like no other! You can use your brain and reverse thinking to get the final target item. The unexpected way of passing levels can bring you endless laughs.  The game tests your logical thinking skills, reflexes as well as memory and creativity. Come and experience it and prove that you are the smartest!

title: Room Sort Floor Plan
description: Room Sort Floor Plan is a fun creative puzzle game with elements of sorting and design. In this casual game, you’ll go through proper sorting and organization. Designing the perfect layout for every room. Rearrange the floor plan to create your unique home. Each level is a jigsaw puzzle challenge.

title: Dynamons 11
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 11! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Guardian Island world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Chyroax, Scorvenox, Axolotix, Uryndur, Skyvioru, Golunaryx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Candy Battle: Sweet Survivors
description: The city is under attack by dangerous zombies, and you must become a hero to save it! Awakened by a dream, you take on the mantle of a human warrior with unlimited potential, joining other survivors to fight against the evil horde. But with the zombies greatly outnumbering you, any mistake could lead to dire consequences. You must find a way to survive this crisis.

title: Pirates Match The Lost Treasure
description: Enjoy this pirates adventure and find the lost treasure . Immerse yourself in an exciting match 3 game with many levels and excellent graphics. Solve all the match 3 puzzles and escape find the pirates lost treasure using your skills, and amazing power-ups to complete the levels.

title: Russian Fishing at Sea
Get Ready With Me: Concert Day
description: Join us in the excitement as you follow the thrilling journey of teen Riri, who is preparing for the concert of a lifetime. From choosing the perfect outfit to applying stunning makeup, you'll get to walk her through all the steps of this beautifying process. But before you start the fun, be sure to help her customize her cowgirl hat, a signature item for the concert she will attend. Then go crazy with the makeup, dress her up in a jaw-dropping outfit, and accessorize for a complete look.

title: Train Drift
description: Train Drifting is an addictive arcade racing game that offers players a unique and incredible train drifting experience. In this game you will become a real master of drifting on iron horses.

title: Brick Match
description: Brick Match is a fast, fun puzzle game! Tap to match colorful bricks, trigger combos, and beat brain-teasing levels. Use boosters like the Shuffle, Colour Bomb, Extra Moves, and Row Blaster to blast through tough spots. Can you clear the board and beat your high score?

title: Hexon Rush
description:
Hexon Rush is a time limited puzzle game with a little bit of sci-fi look.

Main goal in the Hexon Rush is connecting all the lines inside the hexagonal tiles before time runs out.  There are 600 levels with increasing size, difficulty and complexity.

Don't worry, you will have two types of helpers to solve these puzzles. Be careful when you spend them because they are hard to obtain.

title: Brainrot Hole
description: Brainrot Hole is a fun casual game where you control a hole that sucks in objects. Your task is to guide the hole to eat all the objects and defeat all the Brainrot Enemies . As you progress through the levels,  the game gets more challenging with more complex obstacles to avoid. Use your strategy and quick reflexes to become the ultimate Brainrot Hole master!

title: Memory Match Magic
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Memory Match Magic," a delightful casual game that challenges your memory and takes you on a magical journey of matching pairs! Immerse yourself in a whimsical realm filled with colorful cards, charming animations.

title: I Am Security
description: Have you ever wanted to be a hardened security officer and be on the front lines of maintaining order? In I Am Security, an ultra-realistic role-playing simulator, you play the role of a professional security guard. You decide whether or not to allow them to enter. Some guests may try to sneak in with prohibited items and find these hidden items. Performs tasks in a variety of scenarios to identify suspicious persons.

title: Merge cubes 2048 3D
description: A completely new approach to the classic game 2048?! Now in 3D and with dynamic physics?! Number cubes don't just merge - they bounce and collide?, adding an element of surprise to every game! Compete with friends or colleagues?!

title: Biking Extreme 3D
description: Do you like riding a mountain bike? Biking Extreme 3D offers you a chance to ride a mountain bike and challenge multiplayer mountain racing tracks. It doesn't matter when you crash any other riders on the track, they will be crashed into the sky. But please always keep a safe distance between your vehicle and obstacles like trees and rocks. Or else, you will lose the game directly. The coins you won are used to upgrade your bike. Don't forget to try another 5 characters!

title: Cat Match 3
description: Dive into Cat Match 3, the thrilling Match-3 puzzle adventure! Match, swap, and blast through vibrant levels filled with unique obstacles, epic power-ups, and explosive combos. Journey through enchanting worlds, unlock daily rewards, and conquer special events. Challenge friends on the leaderboard or team up in exciting tournaments. With increasing difficulty and endless puzzles, every swipe brings you closer to victory. Ready to start matching magic? Join the adventure today!

title: Toy Match 3
description: Toy Match 3 is the third sequel to one of our cutest Match 3 puzzle games! Get ready for colorful graphics, fun animations, and a catchy soundtrack. Match adorable toys in over 4,100+ exciting levels and take on Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges! Embark on thrilling quests like the Treasure Hunt for amazing rewards. With tons of extras and surprises, Toy Match 3 is pure puzzle fun. Start playing now for free!

title: Merge Archer Defense
description: Merge Archer Defense is an archery game focused on castle defense. Are you prepared to fight for your king? Meld archers to create a formidable stickman archery team and battle to safeguard your fortress. Don't hesitate for another moment. Rise to the top as a merge master, vanquish the army of archers, and ascend as the greatest archery hero!

title: Connect Em All
description: Play Connect Em All Online and Solve Colorful Dot Puzzles. Connect Em All is an exciting and addictive puzzle game that you can enjoy for free right in your browser. The goal is simple yet surprisingly challenging: connect all the dots of the same color to complete each level. It sounds easy at first, but as the puzzles grow in size and complexity, you will need clever thinking and careful planning to succeed.

title: BAT!zo Runner
description: Become the cutest vampuuurrr bat! Fly, dodge, and collect mysterious red potions in BAT!zo - new addictive endless runner!

title: Tunnel Road
description: Tunnel Road is an adrenaline-filled arcade game that requires quick reflexes, sharp focus and a great visual reaction! Keep up with the speed, avoid obstacles and cover the longest distance while advancing in a colorful and dynamic tunnel!

title: Extreme Makeover Harley Edition
description: In the Extreme Makeover: Halrely Edition you witness the complete transformation of a famous villain. Are you ready to give it a try? Play it today and give her a full makeover routine, starting with removing the two signature colors in her hair, then dealing with her makeup, manicure, and more. Don't forget to also dress her up in something girly-girl and super-colorful so she can strut her stuff through the streets of Gotham City.

title: Obby: Tsunami Escape +1 by Car
description:
A giant tsunami is approaching - and only you can outrun it! Dodge the waves, upgrade your car, and race to the finish line. The faster you get, the further you can go.

Buy new cars - each one gives you more speed, control, and capabilities.
Upgrade your vehicles to survive the most challenging races.
Defeat brainrots - from common to rare and legendary ones.
Practice, improve your reactions, and find the perfect strategy.

title: Doggo Drop
description: Doggo Drop is a cosy puzzle game where players guide an energetic Shiba Inu as it drops numbered blocks. Land the right blocks to merge them, and reach the best possible score!

title: Nitro Speed Car Racing
description:
Nitro Speed Car Racing is a very unique racing game. You need to focus on the pointer on the dial and stop it at the right moment to get the Nitro that can help you rush to the finish line. This
is a test of your quick reaction ability. Of course, you can use the coins you collected in the game to upgrade your engine and nitro. Come to a brain contest, stimulate your dopamine, and
challenge your reflex limit!

title: Tiny Fighter - Unstoppable Run
description:
10 Levels of an exciting and action-packed game that brings player to a mysterious woods and castles. The game begins with a dramatic scenario in which a vampire has stolen the princess and the brave Tiny Knight is the only one who can save her.

As the princess is abducted, the Tiny Knight embarks on a quest to retrieve her by through dangerous woodlands and battle his way through the castle's maze. Along the journey, the knight must fight Orcs, Skeletons and win Dracula to save the princess!

title: Axe Throw
description:
Ready to test your precision? Welcome to Axe Throw, the ultimate test of aim and timing. The rules are simple, but the challenge is endless. You have one goal: Break the target.

But be careful—the path to victory is rigged with danger. Explosive bombs are moving, and blocking your way. One wrong move, and it's game over!

title: Live or Die
description:
Welcome to the Live or Die pixel puzzle. The goal of the game is to escape the room. To do this, you need to get a key to open the door.
When your player is alive he can move right, left, jump, take the keys and escape the room. If the player takes any damage, they turn into a ghostly form and can fly and pass through obstacles. However the ghost can't take keys or escape.
To return to human form, the ghost must fly to the gravestone.
Remember that you have only 3 lives. Can you escape the room?

title: Sort Games Challenge
description: Sort Games Challenge is a puzzle game. Here you can challenge yourself and choose from multiple modes, not limited to one. Your goal is to complete the mission within a limited time to pass the level. Dont underestimate this game, its still very difficult to pass. Come and challenge!

title: Cubes 2048.io
description: Cubes 2048.io is an addictive online game that fuses Snake and 2048. Get a bigger number by collecting free cubes and eating other players with a smaller number than you.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Online Cats Multiplayer Park
description: Come to run, jump, guess, and race as a cute but competitive kitty in Online Cats - Multiplayer Park. It’s a real-time multiplayer chaos arena. Here are seven modes you can choose from. In Grab A Shabby Ball, for example, you will have to compete with your opponents and try to touch the ball to get points.

title: Only Up Parkour 2
description: Only Up Parkour 2! is an exciting arcade game in which you have to overcome obstacles and conquer heights of 500M. Inspired by the popular game Your task is to guide the character through a vertical labyrinth full of various obstacles. You must react quickly, jump accurately and climb up dexterously to avoid crashing into obstacles and falling down. As you progress through the various levels, you will encounter increasing difficulty and new challenges such as Jumping platforms and obstacles.

title: Mini Grand Theft City
description:
Free game of Mini Grand Thef City, an entertaining game based on the famous GTA game in a minimalist world!! In this entertaining game you can walk, run through the streets and assault passers-by to create new buildings!!!

In this incredibly fun little world you will have the freedom to enter homes or businesses to steal furniture or sell it to get more money to build!! It sounds fun, have fun with this game on your favorite device in your favorite browser.

title: Chibi Doll - Avatar Creator
description:
Street - it's no matter build your modern city life or just stick with village-like town world you always be enjoy with it! 

Room - decorate and design home girly world.

Gacha - unlock countless gachapon surprises your lovely avatar, bring gacha to your fantasy life! 

Dress Up Games - match and mix more than 5000+ girly items for dressing up princess: hairstyle, clothes, hats, accessories, freckles, moles, blush, wings, tails.

title: Solitaire Klondike
description:
Step into the timeless challenge of Solitaire Klondike, an addictive HTML5 card game designed for fans of classic solitaire. Enjoy hours of relaxing gameplay with this popular version of Klondike Solitaire, where players arrange cards in descending order and alternate colors to win. If you need a fresh start, simply shuffle new cards to explore different winning strategies!
Perfect for anyone who loves solitaire,  Solitaire Klondike combines strategy, patience, and quick thinking.

title: Dots Master
description:
Dots Master is a fun and strategic puzzle game where you connect matching dots to solve colorful challenges. Connect dots vertically or horizontally, and form squares to clear all dots of the same color in a single move!

Each level has a special goal — clear a certain number of colored dots, pop stars, make loops, or conquer the tiles — all within a limited number of moves. With 5 exciting chapters packed with creative puzzles.

title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
description: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a game where you are the third son of a great king, sent to a distant land to prove your worth. Collect six vital resources—food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal—to construct new buildings. Unlock all structures and create a stunning, magical kingdom!

title: Stickman Kombat 2D
description: Adrenaline unleashed! Rage, speed, and chaos collide in explosive 2D battles. Feel every hit — and dive into the madness. Are you ready?

title: Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
description:
Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
Swipe fruits, blast combos & solve hundreds of juicy match-3 puzzles! Fun for all ages with vibrant graphics, daily rewards, offline play & no time limits. ?? Perfect for quick play or long sessions. Match, crush & enjoy!

Play now and test your brain!

title: Crazy Stunts 3D
description: Get behind the wheel and conquer extreme tracks! Jump from ramps, compete with players, complete modes and unlock new cars!

title: Toy Assembly 3D
description:
Assemble a wide variety of brick buildings and scenes in this classic constructor game. Start as a baby builder and level your way up to increasingly complex construction sets. This relaxing and
satisfying game is sure to bring you back to the imagination and fun of your childhood!  Find the right piece and simply tap to add it to your build.  Get hands-on fun without the clutter or accidentally stepping on toys.

title: Idle Bathroom Empire Tycoon
description: Ready to become the ultimate bathroom tycoon? In this exciting mix of simulation, management, and idle tycoon gameplay, you’ll start with a small restroom. Grow it into a luxurious five-star hygiene haven! Upgrade facilities, optimize services, and expand your empire to make your bathroom the most popular spot in town. Manage your front desk with care, and faster cashiering will give you more cash flow.

title: Heritage Mahjong Classic
description: Immerse yourself in a timeless Mahjong experience with Heritage Mahjong Classic. Featuring a single elegant layout, three unique tile skins, a time bonus for quick matches, and a competitive leaderboard, this game offers a simple yet captivating challenge. Perfect for players of all levels, enjoy a relaxing atmosphere as you match tiles, earn bonuses, and climb the ranks. Are you ready to test your skills and embrace the charm of classic Mahjong? Start your journey today!

title: Puppy Merge
description: Puppy Merge is a unique merge game where you must grab and combine identical puppies to create a new and bigger one. Puppies will fall automatically into the arena; what you must do is drag the puppies around and merge them into identical ones. Don't let the puppies fall outside the box, or the game will end. You can try to catch the puppy and bring it back to the arena if the puppy falls.

title: Hide And Seek Blue Monster
description: Enter a world full of mystery and fun. In Hide And Seek: Blue Monster, you will experience a unique hide-and-seek adventure. The game combines casual games with puzzle challenges. You should keep running away to prevent being caught by the blue monster, and when the blue monster is staring at you, hold stop in front of the fruit, in front of the coke, or front of the water glass, etc.

title: Cake Sorting Deluxe
description: Cake Sorting Deluxe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your sorting skills! Shift cakes across shelves to make matches of three or more. Clear the board, uncover hidden and shadowed cakes, and solve tricky puzzles as you go. With cute visuals, smooth gameplay, and lots of sweet challenges, Cake Sorting Deluxe is a treat for anyone who loves a good puzzle. Ready to mix, match, and clear the shelves?

title: Paint Tiles Puzzle
description: Welcome to Paint Tiles Puzzle, where creativity meets logic in a colorful puzzle adventure! This is a relaxing puzzle game that combines drawing and puzzle-solving elements. Each level presents a tile grid and your task is to fill the empty spaces with the right colors.

title: Agent Hunt: Spy Shooter Game
description: Step into the role of an elite hitman in this tactical first-person shooter. Complete covert missions with precision shooting, stealth infiltration, and strategic planning. Use advanced sniper weapons to eliminate targets across diverse environments from cities to enemy hideouts in this action-packed spy thriller.

title: Knife.io
description: Knife.io is a fast-paced 2D battle game where you throw knives at your enemies to eliminate them! Dodge incoming attacks, aim precisely, and take down as many opponents as possible without getting hit. With vibrant worlds to explore and tons of unique characters to unlock, every match is a colorful and action-packed challenge. Play solo or team up with a friend in local multiplayer, only the sharpest player will survive!

title: SORTSTORE
description: Swap products to match three of the same kind and fulfill customer requests. Products can be moved to empty shelves, and items in the back will move forward when the front ones are removed. Each move decreases the number of moves left, and the game ends when the move count reaches 0.

title: Cat Evolution
description:
Embark on a paws-itively thrilling journey of discovery and creativity in Cat Evolution! Combine adorable cats to unlock hilarious and surprising new species. From cuddly kittens to fantastical hybrids, every merge brings you closer to unveiling the ultimate evolution.

Merge & Unlock Cats Evolutions. 
Build Your Cat Universe!

title: Fun Sorting Through The Shelves
description: Unwind with this charming match-3 puzzle game! Spot matching items, place them neatly on shelves, and merge triplets to free up space. Collect treasures, decorate, and design your own cozy virtual nook in a relaxing experience for all ages.

title: Avatar Life My Town
description: Avatar Life: My Town game is a casual simulator game for kids. You can enjoy creating your sweet home stories! Meet fun family characters in the dollhouse game! Role-play house games and manage family life in your new home! You need to take good care of your character and prepare delicious food. Cooking a big meal.

title: Dark Academia Wedding
description: Step into a world of moody elegance in Dark Academia Wedding! Help the bride and groom prepare for their enchanting, gothic-inspired celebration. Choose vintage dresses, romantic accessories, and rich color palettes that capture the essence of dark academia. From candlelit ceremonies to mysterious venues, every detail matters. Create the perfect blend of classic romance and intellectual charm in this stylish wedding dress up game!

title: Word Voyager
description:
Word Voyager - Embark on the ultimate quest for words,right on your touchscreen!

Solve puzzles and expand your vocabulary smoothly.

Follow Olivia, your trusty guide, as she navigates you through the gentle murmurs of an ancient library. Uncover secrets during the 'Daily Mission'. Find hidden stars that unlock new thematic categories that will take you on a odyssey through the infinite universe of words.

title: GT Cars City Racing
description: GT Cars City Racing is a driving game with a fantastic open world, epic stunts and magnificent super stylized cars! The game, which brings many innovations and game-play to its previous series GT Cars Mega Ramps, has different surprises waiting for you in its 2nd series. The open world, which is especially demanded by the players, was designed as a Toy City. Incredible shows in the Toy City offer a dazzling game-play experience and never-ending action!

title: Spring Tile Master
description: Welcome to Spring Tile Master! Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of spring as you match tiles adorned with blooming flowers, colorful leaves, and charming insects. Draw tiles from the board to form sets of three. Keep up to 9 tiles in your stack and shuffle when needed. Collect all tiles to unlock new levels. Enjoy the enchanting springtime adventure and become the ultimate Spring Tile Master!

title: Idle Inventor
description:
Grow your industrial powerhouse: become a heavy machine titan of industry!

Manufacture cars, trucks, planes, military vehicles, and high-tech instruments for space exploration!

Watch your factory grow from a single production line to a world-famous industrial powerhouse. And because you’re automating, your factory keeps working while you’re away - check in the morning,  it’s amazing to see how much money you made while sleeping

Try it now, and see how the idle tycoon life suits you!

title: Ninja Climb
description: Embark on a thrilling ascent in Ninja Climb, a captivating 2D game where your nimble ninja scales towering buildings. Click to seamlessly leap between structures, dodging obstacles along the way, and utilize rewarded video ads to revive when challenges arise, ensuring an adrenaline-packed ninja adventure.

title: CityMix Solitaire
description:
Play card games, relax and train your memory and brain with CityMix Solitaire. Solitaire CityMix is more than just another game♠♥♠♥!
Which would you prefer: decorating and restoring a quiet town, or solving puzzles and seeking adventure on a lost island? With CityMix Solitaire you can decorate, solve puzzles and mysteries, follow adventures and help brave heroes. Vicky and her pet Raccoon will help in this challenging quest.

title: Paint race
description: Run around the circle and jump over dark obstacles. Paint the circle to pass levels. Collect the stars. Enjoy and get fun.

title: Glacier Rush
description: Welcome to "Glacier Rush," an exhilarating endless driving game set in the breathtaking icy landscapes of a frozen world. Brace yourself for an adrenaline-fueled adventure as you navigate treacherous snow-covered terrains, speeding through towering glaciers and sweeping icefields.

title: Sand Block Blast
description: Play Sand Block Blast free online and enjoy a relaxing browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Drop sand-shaped blocks, watch them crumble into grains, and clear lines in a clever logic puzzle that feels both calm and strategic. This unblocked game loads fast and works smoothly at school or home. Mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online brain game perfect for quick breaks and focused play anytime.

title: Sea Monsters Mahjong
description: Dive into 'Sea Monsters Mahjong,' an underwater twist on the classic game. Match sea monster tiles strategically—remember, you can only draw tiles that are on top of a stack with no blocks on their sides. Explore the depths, revealing krakens, dolphins, and mermaids. With easy controls and oceanic vibes, enjoy a relaxing Mahjong experience with charming sea creatures.

title: Fish Jam
description: This game is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts. The fish is trapped on the beach, and you need to come up with a reasonable moving plan to release the fish one by one from the crowded scene. Strategize to free the trapped fish on the beach, testing your problem-solving skills. With numerous levels that increase in difficulty, it's a great way to pass the time.

title: Base Jump Wingsuit Flying
description:
Spread your wings and start flying like you’ve never been before!

Base Jump Wing Suit Flying allows you to take part in awesome and exciting extreme sports. Use Wingsuit to jump and fly over multiple cool environments and beat your high scores! This is the new kind of arcade flight experience!

title: Stack Battle.io
description:
It is a fun and casual puzzle. In the game, the game screen is fresh and simple, and the cute cartoon style is very eye-catching. The biggest highlight is the addition of tower defense battles to the brick-moving gameplay. The game level is very rich, and the gameplay is very simple. 
You can control the movement of the character by pressing and sliding on the screen.
What the player has to do is to control the character to collect the bricks on the map, stack the bricks and send them to your base. When there are enough bricks, your base will be upgraded and the area will be expanded and the number of tower defenses will be increased. 
When the enemy enters the range of your tower defense, you will be attacked.

description: Crocodilo Tralalero Run is a fast-paced platformer where your Crazy fiends runs forward automatically, and you must jump, dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect coins. Unlock and customize your Crazy fiends in the shop to enhance your adventure. With its exciting gameplay and charming rewards, Crocodilo, Tralalero, Tsung Tsung and others characters offers fun for all ages!

title: Slime Rush
description: Join the colorful adventure of *Slime Rush*! Control a lively group of slimes as you race along challenging paths, avoiding obstacles and growing your slimes. Collect gems to unlock unique skins and power-ups. Can you lead your slimes to victory? Start your journey in *Slime Rush* today!

title: Colors Runners
description: Colors Runners is an interesting game that you can not miss. Slide to gather your companions of the same color and rush to the finishing line. Remember to walk the same way as your body color or you will get shot and fail. Challenge this game now!

title: Popping Candies
description: Match and crush candies to achieve goals in this addictive puzzle game! Swap adjacent candies to form rows of three or more and clear the board. Create special candies like striped, wrapped, or color bombs to enhance your progress. Overcome obstacles like chocolate and blockers while completing each level's unique objectives. Be mindful of your limited moves! Use boosters for extra assistance and advance through challenging levels to unlock new stages.

title: Join Clash Color Button
description: Are you ready for a game of choices and surprises? Color Button is the game for you! You need to pick the right door and make it to the end safely. But be careful, each door can lead to a different challenge or enemy. You have to use your skills and strategies to avoid traps and obstacles. Teamwork is the key to success in this game. Color Button is an exciting game that tests your judgment and decision-making skills. Do you have what it takes to beat the enemies and reach the end?

title: Grill Party
description: Welcome to Grill Party! Step into the exciting world of grilling and become a master at crafting tasty skewers! In Grill Party!, you’ll experience a thrilling match-3 puzzle game where you’ll arrange meats, seafood, and veggies to create perfect combos. Serve up mouthwatering treats and show off your grilling skills!

title: Cameraman vs Toilets Puzzle
description: Cameraman vs Toilets Puzzle is an exciting game in which you play as Cameraman's Agent, whose task is to destroy all the toilets with the heads of rainbow friends. You have to use your shooting skills to accurately hit each toilet bowl and avoid hitting a Nubian friend.

title: Pumpkin Catcher
description:
Fly on a jetpack between walls and avoid rotating traps. Catch pumpkins using your favorite monster: zombie, vampire, devil or even a cat!

Try this challenging Halloween game and set a new world record in catching pumpkins. Compete with your friends on the online leaderboard! Collect them all!

title: School Teacher Simulator
description:
Evaluate the students' answers in the Teacher Simulator game! Give grades to students, check your homework  and test your school knowledge! This is a cool game for teachers, as well as for students who want to try themselves as a teacher!

In the Teacher Simulator game, you will have to evaluate students' answers, check their homework, conduct tests for two-year students and check your school knowledge. Become the best teacher and cope with any challenges that your students throw at you!

title: Dudu Engineering Truck
description: DuDu Engineering Truck is a casual and puzzle game where you drive engineering trucks to finish tasks on the worksite. Use your sensitivity to shapes to construct a truck and conquer all challenges ahead. If you love car designing and car games, never miss DuDu Engineering Truck! You will enjoy an adventurous journey of being an engineer.

title: Dusty Cat
description: Help the little speck of dust to grow into a real cat! Eat other dust, avoid larger enemies and grow to see all the phases of your Dusty Cat! Collect points and compete with other players to get your scores on the leaderboard!

title: Secret Rooms
description: After entering one of the rooms you have to find all the hidden objects. The names of the items you need to find will appear on the left side. You need to concentrate well and find all the objects in the room. You have to watch the time, because if it runs out it will be game over. Try to get the maximum points and three stars in every room.

title: Color Jam 3D
description:
Color Jam 3D is a fun and relaxing match-and-merge puzzle game! Combine crayons of the same colors  to fill the picture and bring stunning images to life with vibrant colors.
With engaging gameplay and satisfying color-filling mechanics, Color Jam 3D offers a unique blend of puzzle-solving and artistic expression.

title: Free the Ball
description: Try out Free the Ball, a super fun puzzle game! Your job is to guide the ball to its goal by moving blocks around. And get this – there are a whopping three thousand levels to play, and they're all free! No need to buy anything.

title: Bubble Mania Shooter
description: So easy to play, yet challenging to master - welcome to the wonderful bubble universe! Get ready for a game with colorful shooting action where the fun never ends! Sharpen your aim, perfect your shots, blast bubbles, and claim the highest score.

title: 3D Match Puzzle Mania
description: Enter the world of match-3 game brought to life in 3D. Solve captivating puzzles and collect coins to acquire power-ups. Complete daily tasks to earn fantastic bonuses and experience endless fun with every move you make!

title: Otu
description:
In OTU, you control a nimble triangle bound to a circular orbit. Your mission is simple: stay alive as long as possible. But the universe is against you! Spheres close in from the void, shrinking bars attempt to crush you, and lethal rotating lasers force you to keep moving.

Think you’ve mastered the rhythm? Every 10 seconds, the game throws a Random Debuff at you. From screen-shaking earthquakes and inverted controls to pixelated vision and orbit shifts—no two runs are ever the same!

title: Divinex
description:
Embark on a captivating journey into the world of Divinex! Solve challenging puzzles by matching pairs of themed tiles adorned with intricate symbols! Сhallenge yourself with increasingly difficult levels, create a unique atmosphere by choosing new avatars and backgrounds. Immerse yourself in the magical world of Divinex - a new relaxing game with stunning visuals - explore all levels and uncover the magic hidden within the tiles!
Begin your journey today with Divinex!

title: Tropical Match 2
description: Tropical Match is back with its highly anticipated second sequel! Join your island friend Coco for a colorful Match 3 adventure in a lush tropical paradise. Match juicy fruits, vibrant flowers, and clear away algae and clouds across 1,250+ exciting levels. Complete Daily Missions and discover tropical treasures along the way! With relaxing island tunes and gorgeous scenery, this is the perfect summer escape. Dive in and start your tropical adventure today!

title: Fish Feeding
description: Nobody can stop you, but you are not the only fish in the sea: you will have to avoid the vicious sharks that wander in the deepest, darkest depths, looking for a nice little fish to eat! See how high you can score!

title: Home Pin 2
description:
Welcome to chapter 2 of the Home Pin. Start your adventure of the pin world in the secret manor!

You want to protect the family? You want to create your own manor and restore the beautiful manor to its former glory? Play Home Pin 2: Family Adventure now - a unique pull pin game with a family storyline you can’t ignore. No more fake ads, this is the game you are looking for!

title: Soccer Euro Cup 2025
description:
Can you hear the deafening cheers of a mighty crowd? Get pumped for the Soccer Euro Cup 2025!

Pick your favorite country to represent and get ready for kickoff. Do your best to kick or headbutt the ball into your opponent's goal!

How many did you manage to score? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Giant Sushi Merge Master Game
description:
Giant Sushi is a relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to merge sushi!
Sounds easy, doesn't it? Take the challenge and become the new sushi master!

title: Legend of Dragon Hunt
description:
Legend Of Dragon Hunt is a clicker game. Players control a skeleton hero to eliminate invading monsters, gain resources/skills, and defeat bosses.
Features: light-hearted 2D cartoon style, joystick control, auto-shooting.
Systems: Pet, Player Upgrade, Sign-in, Weapon, Weapon Fusion, Idle.

title: 3D Ball Balancer
description: 3D Ball Balancer is a fun 3D rolling ball game. Control the ball to roll on the floating bridge. There are obstacles all over the floating bridge, including broken bridges, ramps, single-plank bridges, etc. Not only do you have to control the direction of the ball, but you also have to control the speed of the ball. How far you can go? Have a try!

title: Dragon Year Jigsaw
description: Dive into the lively universe of 'Dragon Year Jigsaw,' a comical online puzzle game set in the Chinese Dragon Year. Solve 24 levels of dragon-themed jigsaw puzzles, featuring vibrant and playful comic art. Perfect for puzzle lovers and those seeking a whimsical online experience. Join the fun – start piecing together your dragon adventure now!

title: Inspector Cat
description:
Inspector Cat is a competitive hidden object game where you play as a sharp-eyed cat inspector racing against other feline players!
Each round challenges you to find specific items on a crowded board full of objects. Be faster and more accurate than the other cats to earn points and climb the ranking.
Stay focused, react quickly, and prove you’re the best inspector in the pack!

title: Dummies World Cup
description: Dummies World Cup is a fun HTML5 football game for all ages! Choose your favorite team from 32 national squads and control your silly dummy player on a mini soccer field. Score goals, enjoy simple controls, and have fast-paced football fun. Easy to play, perfect for kids and families!

title: Age of Apes Run
description: Welcome to the wildest adventure of the ape era! Age of Apes Run is a fun platform running game. It is full of puzzles and nervous battles. Perfect for every arcade-loving boy out there! You'll be a brave ape warrior and run through a platform full of obstacles! Collect many bananas to boost your skills.

title: Delicious Emilys New Beginning Valentines Edition
description: "Delicious Emily's New Beginning Valentine's Edition" invites players to experience heartfelt moments in the culinary world. Join Emily as she embarks on a romantic journey, balancing love and career. This special edition celebrates Valentine's Day with captivating storylines, delectable challenges, and festive visuals. Engage in time management gameplay, serve delicious dishes, and witness the magic of love unfold. With its charming narrative and festive atmosphere.

title: Baby Piano Children Song
description:
Do you like playing musical instruments? If you love music, we have just the game for you. This educational game offers 5 musical instruments to choose from. They are piano, xylophone, flute, drums, and guitar. You can select the instrument you are interested in playing. Apart from
offering a wide range of instruments, this game lets you choose your favorite music.

title: Garden Block Puzzle
description: A neglected garden, overrun by weeds and dried flowers… it can't stay like this! Test your wits, place the bricks strategically, complete each level and bring your garden back to life. Have fun playing and create the perfect space to relax.

title: Iron Legion
description: Iron Legion is an action tank combat game where you command powerful military vehicles in intense warfare. This game demands focus and nerve, as every decision on the battlefield determines your fate.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Goods Sorting Shopping Master
description: In Goods Sorting Shopping Master, you organize messy goods by moving and matching them into neat groups. It’s a fun puzzle game that combines smart thinking with relaxing gameplay. In the game, you’ll face shelves filled with mixed goods such as drinks, snacks, and daily items. Match and sort three identical items to clear the space and proceed, based on the customer's needs. Manage space carefully to keep sorting.

title: Push The Colors
description: Push the Color game features colorful squares, obstacles, and color gates. It is a 2-player casual game where you can find various costumes during the adventure. The goal is to get the cubes to the finish line and challenge the giant at the end. The more cubes you have, the more power you will possess. You can defeat the color monster by having many cubes. Make wise choices along the way and increase the number of cubes in your possession.

title: Ayla World Princess life
description: Step into the magical world of Ayla World: Princess Life, where you can live the ultimate princess adventure! This exciting game lets you dress up your avatar, create stunning outfits, and design beautiful nails with endless styles.

title: Lady Pool
description: We are glad to welcome you to the bright world of a humorous dress-up game where fashion collides with the comic book universe! Get ready for a creative reinterpretation of your favorite comic book anti-hero costumes: bold color combinations, unexpected prints and fun accessories are available to you. There is everything here: from funny hats that emphasize individuality to stylish superhero jumpsuits. Unleash your imagination!

title: Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon
description: Get spooky and stylish in Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon, where gothic meets glam in a 3-level makeover game. Treat Wednesday to a facial, apply stunning dark-themed makeup, and finish off with iconic dress-up fashion in her unique style. From skincare to eyeliner, you control every detail of her transformation. Whether you’re a fan of the Addams aesthetic or just love alternative beauty, this salon experience offers a complete glow-up from head to toe.

title: Earthquake io
description: Earthquake io is a realistic 3D physics-based disaster simulator in which you take control of the forces of the Earth to destroy cities, destroy buildings and crush all small objects to compete with other players in a fierce battle.

title: Tic Tac Toe Merge
description:
Tic-Tac-Toe Merge is a revolutionary twist on the classic game! Unlike traditional tic-tac-toe, pieces have power levels from 1 to 3. Place higher-level pieces to capture your opponent's weaker ones!

MERGE TO DOMINATE
Combine two level-1 pieces to create level-2, and two level-2 to forge powerful level-3. Create chain reactions when 3+ same-level pieces align — they merge into an even stronger piece!

title: Eco Block Puzzle
description: Unleash your creativity in a classic block puzzle game, then collect pets like in farming games! You are commanding the team of ecologists who are restoring the valley after an environmental catastrophe.

title: Gravity Matcher
description: In Gravity Matcher, you’ll launch circles of various sizes and types into a dynamic gravity field. Your goal? Match identical circles by carefully aiming and timing your throws. But beware – gravity is unpredictable, and the slightest miscalculation can send your circles spiraling out of control!

title: Ball Eating Simulator
description: Get ready to have a great eating and growing fun under an open sky with cool balls inside different costumes in this great simulator game! Eat as much as balls around and get as much as big in the ball’s arena. Eat others, earn coins, and unlock new skins. Chase after gifts, rotate the lucky spin, or enjoy the everyday gifts to carry your eating simulator experience further. All you want is to become the king of the ball arena with your cool player.

title: The Noob Aventures
description:
The Noob Adventures invites you to join a dangerous journey through a colorful world full of action, traps, and enemies. Travel across challenging lands in search of diamonds and overcome all obstacles. Complete 70 levels packed with danger and surprises as you fight enemies determined to stop your progress. Rescue the friends, survive the challenges along the way, and prove that even a noob can become a true hero.
Collect diamonds and unlock new characters to continue your adventure

title: Butterfly Sort Puzzle
description:
Various kinds of butterflies sitting on leaves.
Shy butterflies can only fly next to friends of the same kind.
Bring its friends to one leaf and fly them together~

title: DriftClicker
description:
Race Clicker: DRIFT MAX is an action clicker that immerses you in the world of thrilling drift races, demanding lightning-fast reflexes and the ability to make decisions at high speed. Participate in dynamic drift where every turn is a high-speed challenge.
- Open containers to obtain unique parts and enhance your car.
- Participate in high-stakes races to earn keys for containers and unlock new possibilities.
- Upgrade your car to dominate races and defeat all your rivals.

title: TCG Card Clicker
description: TCG Card Clicker is an addictive clicker game inspired by TCG Card Shop Simulator, where collecting never stops! Click to earn coins, open card packs, and expand your collection with over 8000 unique cards. Each card boosts your passive income, letting you earn more even when you're not clicking! Trade duplicates to discover new cards and complete your ultimate collection. Can you find the rarest cards and become the ultimate collector

title: Asylum: Baldi Granny Slender
description: You'll be heading into the forest to find a mental hospital. Legend has it that this mental hospital is where rare Brainrot figurines are found. Characters like Baldi, Granny, and Slenderman guard these figurines. A bipedal deer also lives in the forest, so be careful not to fall into their clutches! You can hide under beds in the mental hospital to avoid being caught by the monsters.

title: Color Block Blast 3
description:
Drag and drop the correct block into the grid. Match 3 or more tiles of the same colour to eliminate them.

Score beautiful combos while earning bonus points and watching beautiful animations take shape.

How high can you score in this endless match 3 game?

title: Tarcat
description:
Enter the world of feline destruction with Tarcat, a hilarious casual game where you control a cats paw! Your goal? Smash all targets with quick reflexes and pinpoint accuracy!

With just one tap, hit targets, avoid traps, and dominate each level with the style of a true feline destroyer.

title: Human Leap Evolution
description: Want a wild evolution adventure from caveman to futuristic super warrior? Human Leap: Evolution is a high-energy action evolution puzzle game where every jump you make shapes your destiny. Choose wisely, evolve rapidly, and battle your enemies with unstoppable power!

title: The Branch Runner
description: Are you good at endless running arcade games? Here is a chance for you to play a funny running arcade game with 3D pixel blocks. You need to help the character run forward by means of rotating the platform track and avoiding the obstacle blocks. There are many beautiful skins in the shop. As long as you earned enough gold coins, you could unlock and use them!

title: 2 Player Games Kids Kitchen
description: Do you want to run your own restaurant? Want to experience the blend of collaboration and cooking fun? Join H5games4u's best restaurant tycoon game and enjoy cooking fun. You will engage in different gaming modes. The best part is that you can work together with your friends in the virtual restaurant!

title: Dragon Escape
description: The cute dinosaur wants to reach the exit by eating Sandwich in the area protected by robots. If you want to help him, try to pass the levels by using laser traps without entering the robots' field of vision.

title: Knife Up 3D
description: Knife Up 3D is a casual game that tests your reflexes. Feel the rhythm, don't damage the ball and beat your opponents. You can unlock new skins with the rewards you get by passing the levels. It's time to test your reflexes, so if you find it interesting, don't forget to share it with your friends and join in! Have fun!

title: Aim Ninja
description:
Aim Ninja is a fast-paced skill game that tests your timing and reflexes. 
Stop the moving needle at the perfect moment to score points and improve your accuracy. 
Simple to play but hard to master, Aim Ninja delivers quick, satisfying gameplay sessions 
for players of all ages.

title: Mahjong Stack
description: Mahjong Stack is a unique tile-matching game featuring realistic 3D mahjong tiles. Unlike classic match-3, blocks appear in stacked piles. Match identical tiles and drag groups of three to the tray to clear. Use boosters to speed up progress. Dive in and enjoy!

title: Space Waves
description: Space Waves is an arcade game where you control an arrow through dozens of levels across multiple worlds and modes, dodging obstacles at every turn. Pick any level, any time, and let the difficulty faces guide how brave you're feeling.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Island Puzzle: Build & Solve
description: Welcome to the ultimate Island Puzzle adventure! Test your logic and strategy skills in this captivating logic puzzle and building game.

title: Timewalker: Survive!
description: Time Walker: Survive – Embark on a thrilling journey through apocalyptic landscapes in this fast-paced 2D top-down survival game! As a Timewalker, battle relentless hordes of zombies across different eras, fighting for survival against increasingly intense waves of the undead.

title: War Of Gun
description: Experience the electrifying world of War Of Gun, an exhilarating first-person multiplayer shooter game. Take your shooting passion to the next level and immerse yourself in thrilling game modes like Raid, Deathmatch, Battle Royale, and Duels. Conquer territories and emerge victorious with stunning graphics and gripping gameplay. Join us now for an unbeatable gaming adventure!

title: Island Battle 3D
description: Jump and survive in Island Battle 3D, a 3D IO game that will keep you on your toes. You will play as a jumper who must avoid falling off the island. You will also have to knock back your enemies and be the last one standing. You will face a strategic challenge, as the island’s surface is constantly breaking and changing. You can use this to your advantage and push your rivals into the gaps. But watch out, they can do the same to you.

title: Chicken shooter io
description: SUPER COOL SHOOTER game, in which you will plunge into exciting fights with chickens, roosters and chickens. Your task is to choose the best equipment and make full use of your shooting skills to defeat other characters in this feathered battle!

title: Crazy Motorcycle
description:
Drive Nubik along exciting tracks. Jump over gaps, go around obstacles and reach the finish line! Lots of different levels, drive a motorcycle, get there without destruction.

You have to drive a motorcycle with a noob and get to the finish line.
Jump over gaps and go around obstacles at high speed.
Exciting levels are waiting for you!

title: Cat Rescue
description: Protect the cat from dragon invasions through strategic sort puzzle combat. As enemies display colored patterns, your cannon must sort puzzle sequences to match their hues. Click the correctly colored cannon to obliterate matching dragon sections. Each precise cannon shot slows their advance toward the cat! Repeat until dragon threats vanish, but remember: rescue missions demand speed and sort puzzle accuracy!

title: Isometric Escape
description: Isometric is an escape game where you solve a series of puzzles to escape from isometric rooms. Find all the useful objects and use your logic and memory to solve the riddles.

title: Royal Jigsaw
description: Welcome to Royal Jigsaw, the enchanting puzzle game where you embark on a captivating journey to build your very own majestic kingdom! Get ready to immerse yourself in a world of breathtaking landscapes, magnificent castles, and charming characters, all while enjoying the timeless fun of jigsaw puzzles.

title: BURGER CATCH
description: Move the tray left and right to collect the ordered ingredients! If time runs out or you collect too many extra ingredients, you will lose hearts. If you run out of hearts, it's game over.

title: Bullet - Superhero
description:
Destroy your opponents in an exciting puzzle game! Become a superhero, shoot ricochets at enemies and win! A physical game with ragdoll-style heroes will help you improve your marksmanship skills and solve difficult missions!
A fun 2D game in which a superhero must destroy all his enemies.
It's not that simple, the hero's hand is constantly moving and you'll have to aim well to hit the target!
Shoot a ricochet at the enemy and complete all levels.

title: BillyTheBox
description:
Want to deep dive into a cute graphics cozy puzzle game? BilBox is for you.

Simple puzzle game which can be enjoyed by anyone who loves playing cozy puzzle games with fun elements.

title: Emoji Match
description: the emoji match includes dozens of different emojis. you can increase or decrease the number of pieces of these puzzles as you wish. so you can make it suitable for all ages. you can have a pleasant time by having fun and exercising your brain. come on we are waiting for you.

title: My Castle. Merge & Story
description:
My Castle: Merge & Story is a relaxing merge 2 puzzle game set in a warm and atmospheric medieval world of renewal, mystery, and self-discovery. Merge items, restore and decorate an ancient castle, and follow the journey of a young princess who chooses a new path in life.
This calm offline merge adventure combines cozy gameplay, castle restoration, and a story about starting over — far from royal expectations, closer to one’s true self.
Restore and Decorate a Forgotten Castle

title: Valley of Wolves Ambush
description: Valley Of Wolves Ambush is an action-packed survival game where waves of enemies attack your fortress. Your mission is to protect the fortress without leaving the area. Each wave brings more enemies, making the fight harder. If the enemies capture your fortress or defeat you, the game ends. Earn money by defeating enemies to buy better weapons. The most fun part? You can jump really high! Experience intense battles in a realistic war zone. Can you survive?

title: Hyper Knight
description:
The apocalypse began and ancient creatures emerged from their graves. You are people's only hope. Put on your armor and start fighting.

-Collect the souls of monsters and earn money.
-Find new weapons and armors.
-Discover your magical powers.
-Find a companion and it will accompany you.
-Save different towns, encounter unlimited enemies.
-Destroy the bosses that threaten the world.

Why are you waiting? Come on, grab your sword and join us.

title: Squid Escape But Blockworld
description: You need to escape from the Squid competition, but while running away, you fell into the Block world. It’s a bit hard to escape from the Block world, but don’t stop and keep running. Never stop running until you reach the purple portal. Don’t forget to collect the money you see on the way. Be careful of the big monsters chasing you from behind; they want to catch you, and if they do, you’ll lose.

title: Steal Car Duel
description:
Step into a high-energy world of engines, rivalry, and fast reflexes. Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game that evolves the idea of Steal a Brainrot into a car-based experience filled with duels, rare collectibles, and endless upgrades!

Race, collide, and steal your way to the top. Build your own garage, earn coins and tickets, and outsmart rivals to prove who rules the arena. Each match combines skill, timing, and strategy as you fight for dominance in Solo or 2 Player mode.

title: Stickboys Hook
description: Swing with Stickboys and jump your way to the finish line. Stickboys needs your help. Assist him and reach the goal! Jump from launch ramps and shoot webs to get to the end. You must complete every level. Be careful — if you fall from the sky, you lose the game.

title: FreeCell
description: Unlike other card games that rely on luck, almost every game of FreeCell is solvable—if you have the skill. Use the four open "free cells" as temporary holders to juggle your cards and organize the chaotic tableau. Plan your moves carefully, stack cards by alternating colors, and clear the board. Whether you want a relaxing break or a serious brain workout, this is the perfect puzzle for you.

title: Kingdom Cats
description: Become friends with the King of Cats and build a whole kingdom together! Dive into a colorful, exciting world where you can fully demonstrate your creativity!

title: Mage Castle Idle Defense
description: Mage Castle Idle Defense is a strategic idle game where you wield the power of a mighty mage to protect your tower. Unlock devastating spells, enhance your runes and skills, and unleash clever tactics to overcome endless waves of enemies and towering bosses.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Antistress - Simulator Of Sequins DIY
description: ASMR sequin simulator game offers a realistic stress relief experience. Immerse yourself in the world of sequins, where every touch feels real and sensory. The antistress simulator will allow you to relax while enjoying the visual and tactile effects.

title: Bus Jam Escape
description: Bus Jam Escape brings addictive color-matching puzzle action straight to your browser. In this free online game, you’ll guide waiting passengers into buses by matching their colors - no download required. Ideal for fans of casual puzzle and sorting games, Bus Jam Escape delivers crisp graphics, instant play and intuitive click-and-drag controls. Jump into this vibrant web game for quick brain teasers or marathon sessions - every tap pushes you closer to a high-score win.

title: Math Block
description: Math Block is a brain-teasing puzzle game where you slide numbered blocks and operators on a grid to form valid math equations. Match the target value using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to earn stars and progress through 500 challenging levels!

title: Merge Christmas
description: Merge Christmas is a festive puzzle game where you combine matching snowballs to create new character / bigger snowballs, and unlock a cozy Christmas world. Relax and merge Christmas-themed snowballs in a cheerful winter atmosphere perfect for the holiday season.

title: Openfront
description: Openfront.io is an IO battle game where you expand your territory, build up your economy, forge alliances, and drop bombs to dominate the map.How to Play OpenfrontBefore jumping in, you'll choose how you want to play.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bubble Escape
description: Navigate the bubbles to the exit without getting popped by the spikes. More the bubbles escape, more the scores you get. Play through 30 levels. Be careful with the bubble jiggles.

title: Space Shooter - Speed Typing Challenge
description:
Get ready for an exciting space adventure that helps you improve your typing skills! In this free educational online word game, you'll pilot a spaceship and face waves of enemies.

It's a fun way to boost your typing speed and accuracy. Jump into your spaceship, start typing, and help save the galaxy one word at a time!

Think you're the fastest typist in the galaxy? Prove it! The universe is counting on you - start your adventure now and become the ultimate space hero!

title: Obby Tower
description:
Climb. Think. Survive.

Ascend a towering obstacle course filled with tricky jumps, moving platforms — and surprise math challenges! Combine your parkour skills with quick thinking to make it to the top.

Perfect for players who love obbies and want to test both reflexes and brainpower.

title: Fantasy Math Number
description: Embark on an epic adventure in Fantasy Math Number! Test your math skills in exciting battles against monsters by solving addition, subtraction, and multiplication problems. Every correct answer brings you closer to victory! Power up, defeat enemies, and aim for the highest score in this fun and educational math quest!

title: Halloween Challenge
description: Get ready for a spooky adventure in Halloween Challenge! Bats are flying through the night, carrying candy that you must protect. Your mission? Tap the bats before they escape with the sweet treats. But beware, if even one bat escapes, the game is over! With simple controls and addictive gameplay, Halloween Challenge offers a fun and fast-paced experience for players. Test your reflexes, compete for high scores, and enjoy the eerie Halloween atmosphere. How long can you defend the candy?

title: Domino Online Multiplayer
description:
Do you like strategy, excitement and duel battles? You will find different modes, flexible settings and strong opponents.

Variety of modes:
With a computer – hone your skills against AI of varying difficulty
Online Duels - fight with live players in real time
Play with a friend – send a link and play together, even from a distance
On one screen – convenient for pair battles at home

Every game is a challenge, and every move is a step towards victory!

title: Save Her Tour
description: This complex and relaxing puzzle game you've read about has finally become a reality! Only the smartest can pass these brain teaser quizzes and save the girl! Each level will give you a scenario where you must use your ingenuity to solve the problem. If you mess up, it won't end well for our heroine. There are so many different challenges waiting to be solved. This is the best puzzle game ever! Solve interesting puzzles, protect the girl from harm, and experience the thrill of success.

title: Las Vegas Poker
description: Play one of the most exciting card games in the world. Win up to 3 types of big tournaments and unlock your avatar. Rule the poker game and become King Of The Table. Collect daily rewards, customize your game mode, and live the excitement of Las Vegas Casino.

title: Press "A" to Party
description: Press A to Party is a casual arcade game collection designed for players of all ages. Gather your friends and family, settle onto the couch, and dive into the action with simple one-button controls and fast-paced gameplay. Compete against up to 4 players on the same screen, vying for the coveted title of the ultimate arcade champion. Get ready for a blast of fun and excitement at your next gathering!

title: Dynamons Connect
description:
Dive into the exciting world of Dynamons Connect! This fun and engaging game with adorable, colorful characters helps improve focus and visual perception.
Match identical tiles by connecting them with a path that has no more than two turns to clear the board. With endless levels, the challenge never stops!

title: Stickman in space
description:
You have to play as a Stickman astronaut who is stuck on the moon.
Use all possible ways to leave the moon and get to our planet Earth.
On the way you will encounter various dangers, such as aliens, flying meteorites and much more.
You will have several objects in your hands with which you can try to escape from the natural satellite of the moon. Several objects will lead you to death, and some objects can save your life, be careful and cautious.

title: SLIDE STONE
description: Horisontally slide the blocks and create a complete row across the board. Every time you slide a block and additional blocks are added from the bottom of the board. If you create multiple rows simultanepusly or create a row consecutively that becomes a COMBO! Good luck and let's aim for the high score!

title: Cute Kitty Merge
description: Step into the role of a farmer and grow your own fruits and vegetables. In Solitaire TriPeaks Farming you will spend time in beautiful nature and play fun and constantly changing levels that will never allow for boredom. It is all about having fun.

title: Monster Dash
description:
Sprint, Jump and Blast your way through Monster Dash, an action-packed game by the creators of Jetpack Joyride and Fruit Ninja.

Join Barry Steakfries and his iconic Machine Gun Jetpack in a world full of menacing monster mayhem, as you run and gun your way through hordes of zombies, vampires and more with the most explosive and powerful weapons you can find!

title: Hazmob FPS
description: Hazmob FPS is an intense first-person shooter that blends tactical depth with fast-paced action. Players engage in strategic, team-based battles across diverse maps, utilizing customizable loadouts and a variety of game modes. With its dynamic gameplay mechanics, realistic graphics, and competitive ranked play, Hazmob FPS challenges players to master their skills, coordinate with teammates, and outwit opponents in a visually immersive and constantly evolving environment.

title: 99 Nights (Bloxd.io)
description: 99 Nights is an action-adventure game where your survival skills are put to the test, and nighttime creatures attack you after dark. Gather resources, weapons & build your defenses along with other players while you unlock tools to help you level up and protect your base.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Eye Attack - Toilet Monster War
description:
Help Secret Agent to survive in Toilet War! Solve puzzles and prevent toilet invasion in our world!

Every single level in Eye Attack: Toilet Monster War is an unique challenge that will train your logic and shooting skills. Only the smartest players can solve all the puzzles and destroy all the Toilet Monsters on the level. Try to get three stars on each level! Can you?

Try this Trending Toilet Monster game and join the fight against the Toilet Monsters!

title: Neon Blast
description: Upgrade your defense cannons by merging them!Watch as your cannons level up and become powerful defenders, and get exciting new powers to crush bosses and attackers!

title: Marble Blast
description: Ready to match, blast, and conquer? This vibrant marble shooter game offers endless fun and challenges that test your skills and strategy. Clear colorful marbles, unlock powerful boosters, and prove you’re the master of marble puzzles! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, this game delivers excitement like no other.

title: Farm Block
description: Farm Block is an engaging farm-themed puzzle game where players slide adorable animal blocks to free them from the farm. Test your strategic thinking and enjoy the charming countryside setting! With its mix of puzzle-solving and elimination mechanics, Farm Block offers a fun and rewarding challenge for all ages.

title: Farm Merge Valley
description: Farm Merge Valley is a puzzle business farming game where you merge various animals and objects to upgrade them. Grow crops and add animals to your farm while expanding to exciting new lands.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Labubu Merge
description:
Engage, Merge, and Challenge!
Dive into a labubu-matching journey where you collide identical labubu to evolve them and keep them from falling out of the box. But here's the twist: when the same labubus collide, they transform into an entirely new labubu. Can you merge your way to the grand labubu?

title: Hidden Object: Emily's Case
description:
A detective adventure set in Victorian London.

Search for hidden objects, uncover clues, and investigate the disappearance of a young girl. Solve puzzles, play mini-games, and step by step reveal the secrets of the old city.

title: Kitchen Sorting
description: Kitchen Sorting uses well known meachanics of ball and water sorting games. Sort cooking ingredients into glass jars right in your comfortable kitchen. When sorted, pour them into the pot a cook meals.

title: TimeWarriors
description:
Lead your army to glory through the ages! Embark on an epic journey through history. From primitive battles of the Stone Age to the futuristic wars of the future — become the greatest commander the world has ever known.

Become a great commander and lead your army to victory! Play “Time Warriors” now!

title: Cloak Master Shooter Run
description: Cloak Master-Shooter Run allows you to show your shooting and running skills in an exciting environment! In this casual game, you will be transformed into a mysterious hero. Navigate through different scenarios, avoid obstacles and complete challenges.

title: Jewel Garden Story
description: Enter a dazzling realm where sparkling jewels await your matching skills. Challenge yourself to achieve high scores and enjoy the visually stunning jewel combinations. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless entertainment.

title: Blue Mushroom Cat Run
description: Catch the mischievous thief in Blue Mushroom Cat Run! A cunning thief has snatched your gold, and guess what? Unlock vibrant worlds and zoom through endless obstacles in this action-packed runner. From sun-kissed beaches to neon-lit night streets, every map offers fresh surprises and heart-pounding thrills.

title: Bottle challenge
description: This is a puzzle game, the game provides different volumes of the kettle, according to the game level prompts each kettle needs a different magnitude, to reach the required magnitude of the prompt can be cleared

title: Wreck The Tower
description: Take control of a powerful tank and unleash destruction in Wreck The Tower, an explosive demolition game where precision and power determine your success! Your mission is simple: demolish buildings by firing your tank’s bullets repeatedly until the structure collapses. But be careful not to hit the moving walls. If you hit them, your bullet will ricochet back toward you, adding an extra challenge to your aim.

title: Big Head
description: Looking for a logic puzzle that’s both smart and funny? Big Head is a mobile maze game that flips classic mazes upside down with creative challenges and comedy. Each tricky puzzle is a brain challenge that makes you think outside the box while enjoying hilarious animations.

title: Club Tycoon: Idle Clicker
description:
Idle Manager / Clicker game where you have to manage little club: upgrade abilities, defend area, resist various enemies, earn money, get resources and become a club tycoon!
Highly addictive and fun Idle clicker game with area defense elements. If you enjoy tycoon simulator and incremental style games, where you have to find the right strategy for resource management, "Club Tycoon: Idle clicker" will be best for you. Good luck capitalist, don't forget to share your scores on the leaderboard!

title: Ragdoll Arena 2 Player
description: Ragdoll Arena 2 Player consists of 14 super cool and challenging 2 player games. You can play these games in either 1 player or 2 player modes. Each game you will have a different goal but your main goal is to score three before your opponent.
