Use the bouncing ball to smash a solid brick with precision. Each level has a different objective and difficulty, you need to break these bricks in the smartest way possible.

title: Mini Games Casual Collection
description:
Mini Games: Casual Collection is an online game. The gameplay is simple, fun, and addictive, so
you won't be able to stop playing. There is no stamina display. You can play anytime anywhere. You can use hints to help you pass when you are stuck on a level. If you have any problems playing this game or have any suggestions for this game, please leave us a message. If you like our games, please share them with your friends to double the fun!

title: Northern Lights - the secret of the forest
description:
A new hit for fans of the Match 3 game genre!

The Scientist Cat is already hiding items throughout the mysterious forest so you can enjoy finding things and earn as many emeralds as possible. The cat is happy to have new guests!

title: Super Elip Adventure
description: In Elip Adventure, you engage in a thrilling quest as an ellipse, navigating through treacherous maps to locate stars that unlock the elliptical house. Each stage presents a different challenge, with numerous obstacles and antagonists designed to hinder your progress. Whether you choose to outmaneuver or confront these enemies calls for strategic choices contributing to a dynamic gaming experience.

title: Geometry Arrow
description: Dive into an exhilarating journey through a treacherous cave! Your mission: reach the portal at the end of each level while avoiding deadly spikes and obstacles. With six progressively harder levels, you’ll need sharp reflexes and spot-on timing to survive. Can you conquer every challenge and make it out of the cave? Put your skills to the test in this high-speed action game!

title: Eye Art Perfect Makeup Artist
description: Eye Art Perfect Makeup Artist is a very sophisticated makeup game. This game has an eye makeup  theme that is very targeted. This game has 26 levels, which means there are 26 types of eye makeup  for you to choose from. No matter what style of makeup you prefer, you can find one that satisfies  you in this game. Want to know more about this game?

title: Battle Racing Stars
description: Join an epic racing adventure where you can unlock and upgrade iconic characters from beloved Halfbrick games, including Barry from Jetpack Joyride, The Ginger Ninja from Dan the Man, and the nimble ninjas from Fruit Ninja.

title: Imposter Coloring Book
description: Get ready for a colorful twist on the mystery and excitement of the Imposter Coloring Book! Inspired by the thrilling world of imposters, this coloring app lets you bring your favorite characters to life with vibrant colors and unique brush styles. Choose from various brushes, including pastel, watercolor, and pencil, to add a unique touch to each crewmate, imposter, and spaceship scene. Whether you prefer bold colors or a soft pastel look, every coloring page is yours to make unique.

title: Stick: Tactics & Destruction
description: Stick: Tactics & Destruction! For fans of Stick War, Teardown, and Playground. Limited ammo, grenades, monsters, explosions. Destroy everything and win!

title: Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game
description:
Tap Block Puzzle: Smash Game is a satisfying and addictive puzzle game where you tap on two or more matching blocks to smash them!
? Clear the board, create massive combos, and reach high scores in this colorful, fun-packed block smashing experience.
Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike!

title: Boxing Fighter
description: Boxing Fighter is a fun boxing game. It's a handheld boxing game where you can easily swing your fists! It's all about the fast and furious fights, the lovable characters, and the casual style of the game. Dodge the oncoming attacks and deliver the killing blow when it counts! Feel the pain with your whole body and mind! What are you waiting for? With just one punch, you too can become a big star in the boxing world!

title: Chicken Banana Quest
description: Help the Chicken and Banana to solve all puzzle quest and find the play button. Use your skills to solve the puzzles before the lives run out and complete all levels with the less possible clicks

title: Ocean Small Hospital Doctor
description: Dive into the exciting world of Ocean Small Hospital - Doctor! This casual and educational game is an absolute blast for animal lovers. In this game, you'll step into the role of a heroic doctor on a submarine-turned-hospital. Your mission? Rescue injured sea animals from the vast ocean depths. As you spot a distressed creature, quickly assemble your medical team and gear.

title: Foam and Find
description: Foam and Find is a relaxing hidden object game with a playful bubble twist. Explore cozy houses, each filled with charming rooms and easy-to-spot hidden items. Your tasks appear inside floating bubbles — and when you find an item, it flies into its bubble and pops with a satisfying animation. No timers, no stress — just a calm, casual experience at your own pace.

title: Giant Wanted Monster
description: The city is being occupied by giant monsters. You, as an elite sniper, pick up your sniper gun. Defeat these crazy monsters and protect the survival of humanity. In Giant Wanted Monster, the fate of the city is at stake with every bullet. You need to use the powerful sniper weapon to shoot accurately from a distance and hit the monster's Achilles heel.

title: Blocksss
description:
Blocksss is challenging, exciting and sometimes infuriating minimalist puzzle game. Enjoy the world's most beloved puzzle game for FREE!
Easy to play, and pleasurable game for all ages.

title: Racing Limits
description: Racing Limits is a racing game that lets you push your skills to the max. Race and overtake vehicles in city and highway traffic with four thrilling game modes: carrier, infinite, against-time, and free mode.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Flower Block
description: Dive into our unique COMBO gameplay, where you strategically place blocks to clear rows or columns. Watch as clearing multiple lines triggers exciting animations and earns you bonus points. Challenge your mind and plan your moves wisely to ace Flower Block!

title: Italian Brainrot Bomb - 2Player
description: The dynamite bomb is left in the space hangar. Whoever has it when the time runs out wins the game, because the bomb will explode. Take the bomb from your opponent before the time runs out. When the time ends, the player holding the bomb wins. Grab the bomb to win the game. Be very careful — take the bomb and run, and never let the other player have it.

title: Granny GTA Vegas
description: Granny GTA Vegas drops the infamous horror legend into the heart of sin city! Armed and unhinged, Granny escapes her haunted house and brings chaos to the neon streets of Las Vegas. With red-hooded masked enemies hot on her trail, she must shoot her way through crime-ridden alleys, casino districts, and the Vegas Strip.

title: Soccer Snakes
description: Two wild, clumsy snakes competing in a soccer match is the perfect mix of humor, chaos, and sports. Play solo or share your keyboard with a friend and score some 'hiss-terical' fun with Soccer Snakes!

title: Doge's Battle Royale
description: Want to join the most hilarious and action-packed survival shooting game ever? In Doge's Battle Royale, you take control of the legendary Doge. Battle on a battlefield full of guns, weapons, and crazy opponents. Defeat enemies and pick up their items. Strategize your moves, and shoot with precision to outlast your enemies in this intense Battle Royale challenge.

title: Idle Farm
description:
Run your own successful farm and build an empire! The more you grow and harvest, the more money you get!
Use the money to upgrade your fields and make harvesting even more effective at producing food. Keep an eye on your production - with careful planning you’ll achieve everything! Expand your farm further and further until you truly own an empire.
Hire farm managers to do most of the work for you. Use their help to expand your farming empire, plant new crops and produce even more food!

title: Math Quest
description: "Math Quest" - an exciting game for the whole family that develops mathematical skills, logic, and reaction speed. Overcome challenges, calculate correct answers, and reach new levels!

title: Hill Racing - Egg drop!
description:
Press down to accelerate your car. Go as fast as you can carrying an egg while collection coins. 

Upgrade your cars and levels with coins.

title: Monster Arena
description: Be the longest monster ever! Beat out your rival monsters by eating fruits and grows. This snake io game let you roam free, grow large, and finish your enemies by making them crash into you. Be the king of the island!

title: 2248 Musical
description: Once you start playing it, you will absolutely get addicted to these 2048 puzzle games. designed with beautiful graphics and intuitive gameplay, making it a great choice for those who love number block puzzle games

title: Maido
description: Welcome to the Maido Shop! Pull items from the box and merge them together. The more you merge, the better the items become. Do you have what it takes to unlock the final item? Set the right price to sell your goods! If it's too cheap, you lose profit. If it's too expensive, you gain nothing. Start managing your shop now!

title: Gloves Grow Rush
description: “Gloves Grow Rush” is a 3D arcade game where you control stickman boxers in a vertical running challenge. Collect boxing gloves, battle weaker opponents, and take on the final boss at each level. If you encounter a stronger boxer, evade rather than fight to survive. Beware: a direct punch means game over! Claim gems to upgrade your starting level and attack power (ATK). The shop offers 6 unique boxing gloves, but they don’t grant extra ATK or levels. Best of luck!

title: Graffiti Tags: spray painting
description:
Become a graffiti master in our simulator! Realistic physics, a wide range of colors and surfaces. Draw on the walls, avoid the police and create unique masterpieces of street art.

Your path will not be easy — the police will pursue you at every step. But if you avoid them, your works can become a real cultural heritage! Get inspired, develop your skills, experiment with colors and fonts to create unforgettable graffiti.

title: Jump Girl 3D
description: Jump Girl 3D is an addictive casual jumping game. It's time to stack your own tofu towers and help the lively girl climb the delicious bouncy tofu trampoline tower. Beware of obstacles that appear from both sides and try to stand in the middle for a smoother and safer ride. Try to challenge every move and unleash the girl's acrobatic skills! Go, Tofu Girl!

title: Sniper Shot Secret Mission
description:
Sniper Shot Secret Mission is a game of nerves and skills. Each time you start the new level, a challenge is waiting for you to solve. Never fire on the wrong target otherwise their no second chance as a sniper. 
As a sniper you need to work silently once you shoot the bullet everyone will be aware of the situation and you might loose your target. You can be targeted through security guards once you shoot at your high profile targets.

title: Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Step into the shadows with Twilight Solitaire TriPeaks! Explore abandoned castles, fend off lurking vampires, and rebuild forgotten halls. Play 200+ haunting Solitaire levels plus 50 chilling Mahjong boards. Face spooky twists like frozen and locked cards, tricky obstacles, and powerful boosts. Search the dark, cobwebby corners of every last level for gems and coins to purchase new castle upgrades and power-ups. Are you ready for a Solitaire adventure that sends shivers down your spine?

title: Poxel.io
description: Poxel.io is a, io fast-paced first-person shooter that throws you into intense pixelated battles across diverse maps. Choose from a wide arsenal of weapons, master different game modes, and outplay your rivals to claim the top spot.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Arrow Puzzle
description: Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

title: Obby Rescue Pin
description:
Obby Rescue Pin is a brain-burning, high IQ puzzle game that is especially addictive. How you pull the pins to rescue the Obby depends entirely on your logic and strategy!
Avoid Dangers: Navigate around bombs, ferocious animals, and deadly traps.
Outsmart the Room: Unlike simple rope rescue games, this experience focuses more on strategic adventures.
Help the Escape: Clear the path to help the Obby escape out of the dangerous room.

title: High Speed Crazy Bike
description: Get ready to take on the ultimate mud dirt bike racing challenge as you barrel through rough terrain at breakneck speeds, using your skills and quick reflexes to navigate through a myriad of obstacles and emerge victorious in this adrenaline-fueled test of skill and daring.

title: Ice Cream Inc.
description:
Ice Cream Simulator is a satisfying casual game where you step into the shoes of a master ice cream artist. Your goal is to run the most popular shop in town by creating the ice cream of your dreams!

From classic Vanilla and Dark Chocolate to fruity Mango and Juicy Strawberry, you have all the ingredients needed to create the perfect frozen treat. Whether your customers want a soft-serve cone, ice cream rolls, frozen yogurt, or traditional Gelato, it’s up to you to serve them with a smile.

title: Fitness Club 3D
description: Fitness Club 3D is a casual game where you plunge into the world of fitness and make every workout count as you strive to build an empire. Help your clients achieve their dream bodies and fitness aspirations while transforming your studio into the ultimate gym. Jump into the aerobics class, making a splash to rake in the cash. Pay close attention to your clients' forms, ensuring proper training techniques.

title: Dig out of Prison
description:
You are a prisoner determined to break free. Dig tunnels with a spoon, shovel, or anything you can find. Discover valuables, trade with fellow inmates and even the guards, and earn the prison’s top currency — toilet paper.

Upgrade your digging and trading skills, unlock better tools, and speed up your escape. But be careful — plan your moves and avoid drawing attention, because freedom is the prize only for the most cunning.

title: From Zombie to Glam A Spooky Transformation
description: Embark on a spooktacular journey with Ellie in "From Zombie to Glam: A Spooky Transformation"! Help her shed her undead appearance and embrace a new, ordinary life. Dive into levels of makeover, hand clean, makeup, nail decor, and dress-up for an epic Halloween makeover!

title: Stickman Archer: Shooting Arrows at Reds
description:
Red hooligans have started to take over ancient excavations!

Only the Great Archer can stop the villains in red!

Stickman the Archer wants to save the world from evil hooligans and now he needs your help!
Your goal is to destroy enemy shooters and defeat all the bosses. You are armed with a bow and arrows!

title: Put the fruit together!
description: A game in the genre of "Connect the Balls" and "2048". Stack identical fruits to combine them into a new larger fruit! The game has incredibly beautiful and cute graphics, nice music accompaniment and addictive gameplay!

title: Brainrot Clicker
description:
Brainrot Clicker is a hilarious and chaotic idle clicker game that plunges you into a bizarre world of meme-fueled madness. Your mission is simple: tap the screen to earn “Italian Brainrot Points” and unlock increasingly ridiculous AI-generated characters from the internet’s wildest corners.

With eye-catching visuals, meme-inspired humor, and endless upgrades, Brainrot Clicker offers a weirdly satisfying experience you won’t want to stop!

title: Shipbuilding tycoon
description:
Do you want to become a shipyard manager and build big ships?
Step into the role of a shipyard manager and grow your very own ship empire in this addictive idle game! As you build ships, earn profits, and unlock epic vessels, you’ll expand your factory and boost production efficiency.

title: Stolen House
description: Stolen House is a free leisure online game for boys. You play the role of a thief in the game, and you need to steal the specified items to complete the task. There are many dangerous things to pass the levels, so you need to avoid traps and obstacles, and don't be found by guards. The game is exquisite and the gameplay is simple. Come and challenge to unlock more levels!

title: Craft of Wars
description: The war between the Reds and the Blues has never been more epic than in Craft of Wars! In this cubic game, you'll fight for strategic points on the map using a classic combat system similar to the one found in older versions of Minecraft. Prepare for intense sword and bow duels, TNT explosions, tactical use of potions, and the legendary golden apples that will help you survive the fiercest battles.

title: Animal Merge: Bubble Shooter
description: Welcome to Animal Merge, where you evolve adorable creatures by merging bubbles! Launch, connect, and combine animal bubbles to create advanced species. Watch as identical animals merge into exciting new forms! Keep merging to reach the ultimate evolution and complete your goal. Use special tools to boost progress. With each level, the challenge grows—can you master merging and collect all the final animals? Jump in and start merging now!

title: Stickman Choosing actions
description: The Stickman character was kidnapped by a creature and locked up in prison. Your task is to escape from prison. Use an item selection or action. What should I choose? Left or right? It's up to you.

title: L.O.L. Surprise Game Zone
description: Hi, B.B.s, welcome to the big city of L.O.L. Surprise! where you will visit the coolest shops, full of games and surprises.

title: Stack Tower Pro
description: Test your precision in this addictive 3D block stacking game! Build the tallest skyscraper, unlock stunning themes, and master the art of balance. Can you reach the stars?

title: Turbo Stars
description:
Hop on your skateboard and speed down the track in this wild and fast-paced racing game!

Zoom through a wide variety of exhilarating tracks and defeat your opponents!

Think fast to pick up items that will help you gain an advantage — or even pick up and throw your competitors if they get too close to you! 

Don’t forget to snatch coins and keys to unlock a whole bunch of awesome items, including power-ups, new objects to ride on, and gear for your character.

title: Zoo Anomaly Simulation
description: Experience a zoo mutation crisis like no other. In Zoo Anomaly Simulation, a peaceful zoo has turned into a nightmare filled with mutated animals, and you’re the only one who can stop the chaos! Enter a first-person shooting experience like no other. Explore the eerie zoo environment, grab your weapons, and fight back against giraffes, zebras, elephants, etc.

title: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat
description:
Break bricks, collect power-ups for more fun breaking bricks and watch Chipy Chipy Chipa Cat and El Primo Bara Bere dancing. Go through interesting and exciting levels in the fun game about Chippy Chippy Chippy Chappa Chappa Cat and El Primo.
Pass levels of different difficulty and set a personal record.

title: Match Factory
description: Welcome to Match Factory - the most relaxing and non-stop casual triple puzzle game. Step into a vibrant factory full of colorful items, and play the role of a master matcher. Match three identical items to clear them from the board, pack them up, and keep the factory running smoothly! Every level is uniquely designed with tricky layouts and challenges. Use power-ups that help you overcome difficult puzzles!

title: Planet Hopper
description: Use your ship to navigate and jump between different planets across the galaxy, but be careful not to drift off into the vastness of outer space!

title: Butterfly Shimai
description: Butterfly Shimai is a captivating mahjong connect game that takes you on a journey to match and release beautiful butterflies. Explore the enchanting world of butterflies as you connect identical pairs and set them free to soar.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Sniper Freeze
description: Experience thrilling sniper action in Sniper Freeze, a unique online game where you hunt down moving rule-breakers marked in red. Sharp graphics and challenging gameplay await - stay alert and precise!

title: Purrfect Scoops
description:
Welcome to Purr-fect Scoops,
Run your own ice cream shop, serving up delightful cones and cups to a menagerie of animal customers. 
Choose from a variety of flavors.
Unlock new cups, flavors, and toppings to expand your menu and attract even more customers. 
Use power-ups like the Coin Multiplier and Tip Booster to maximize your profits and become the ultimate ice cream tycoon. 
With its charming visuals and addictive gameplay, Purr-fect Scoops is sure to delight your day.

title: Classic Mahjong
description:
"Mahjong Classic" is a classic mahjong solitaire with a unique algorithm for generating levels - a random layout of chips always has a solution! Each playthrough becomes unique, allowing you to play your favorite fields an unlimited amount of times!
In the game you will find popular fields: Turtle, Fort, Crab, Spider, Cat, Dragon and many others.
Play solitaire at your own pace, there is no time limit!

title: Rainbow Balls 2048
description: A game in the genre of 2048, where you can skilfully use game physics to achieve victory. The main task is to connect the balls and reach the number 2048. The game also features a booster, which makes passing the game more fun and easier.

title: Amazing Airplane Racer
description: Amazing Airplane Racer revolutionizes the airborne gaming experience by combining high-speed plane racing with strategic special skills. Maneuver through challenging tracks while collecting power-ups like turbo boosts and shields to outsmart opponents. With stunning graphics and intense multiplayer action, the game delivers an adrenaline-packed aerial competition where skill and strategy take center stage. Are you ready to dominate the skies and become the ultimate airborne champion?

title: Army Base Of America
description: This military tycoon game combines base management, soldier training, and territorial conquest into one action-packed experience.Train your soldiers and improve their combat abilitiesUpgrade your troops with better equipment and stronger statsBuild and expand your military camp to grow your armyFight against enemy forces in strategic battlesCapture enemy territories and expand your control across the mapManage your resources and strengthen your war operationsLead your army to victory and protect America from hostile forces
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: ChickZ Stack
description:
ChickZ Stack is a fun and addictive arcade game where flying chickens take to the sky! stack your chickens to overcome obstacles and glide through colorful, challenging levels.

The taller your chicken stack, the easier it is to pass walls, traps, and enemies.

Unlock adorable flying chickens, explore new worlds, and compete for high scores.

With simple one-tap controls and fast-paced gameplay, ChickZ Stack is easy to play but hard to master.

Stack, fly, and flap your way to victory!

title: Trolley fun
description: Trains connect cities and carry goods, but bandits are constantly attacking them! Collect resources, upgrade your train to repel all attacks!

title: Going Balls Adventure 2
description: Going Balls Adventure 2 is a ball-rolling arcade game with a 3D game engine. Your main mission is to collect black balls and reach the checkpoint. Your side mission is to collect all coins on the platform. It doesn't matter if you don't fish the job. Before the level begins, you have a chance to try some free skins for you to decide on a favorite one.

title: Butterfly Match Mastery
description:
Plunge into the atmosphere of a magical forest in a new game in the style of Mahjong Connect. Free the butterflies by finding identical pairs of wings!

Butterfly Match Mastery is an amazing game that will give you moments of pleasure. Free butterflies in an enchanted magical forest by connecting pairs of identical wings and enjoy their flight! But don't forget about the time, when it runs out - you will lose.

title: Drive To Survive
description:
Dive into the world of the zombie apocalypse, where your car is the only weapon!
Shoot down hordes of zombies, earn money and unlock new powerful cars.

Earn money - use your skills to become a master of survival!
Buy cars - from classics to supercars!
Explore new locations - each level is full of challenges!

Show the zombies who's boss!

title: Shape Shift
description:
Shape Shift is a fast-paced arcade game set in colorful outer space. Pilot your spaceship through a field of moving geometric shapes and collect the correct targets to score points.

But stay sharp, the target shape or color constantly changes. One moment you must collect blue circles, the next moment it might switch to red triangles. Grab the right shapes and avoid the wrong ones as long as you can!

title: Super Hero Driving School
description:
Drive unique super hero vehicles and perform stunts on multiple crazy tracks.

It’s a bird! No, it’s a plane! Or maybe a car? What the hell is that thing? I want to drive this right now! 

So buckle up and prepare for super fun times in Super Hero Driving School. Because even heroes need a driving license, you know! 

Drive, and fly unique super hero vehicles and perform stunts like never before. And be careful, because super heroes can have super crashes! :D

title: Red Hide Ball
description: In Red Hide Ball you protect designated balls from roaming monsters by manipulating the level layout and placing shields or obstacles. Each stage presents a fixed arrangement of elements and predictable monster movements, turning each solution into a small tactical exercise. Success depends on reading patterns, timing actions and using limited moves to create safe zones. The game balances accessible mechanics with steadily increasing difficulty to engage players who enjoy pure logic challenges.

title: Flappy Rush
description: flappy rush is a simple casual game. touch to fly, hold to hover and release to fall. in this game your agility will be tested, pass obstacles and don't crash to stay alive, enjoy the music and complete levels that challenge your adrenaline

title: Papa's Bakeria
description: Papa’s back with a brand new pie shop - Papa’s Bakeria! As your newly employed baker, your task is to bake various exquisite baked goods for customers.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Sum Master
description: Sum Master is an engaging and challenging number puzzle game designed to enhance your mental arithmetic and logical reasoning skills. The objective is to select numbers within a grid so that the sums of each row, column, and colored region match the specified targets. Each puzzle has a unique solution, requiring players to carefully consider which numbers to include or exclude. The game offers a stimulating experience that combines fun with educational value.

title: Super Kid Adventure
description: Hi there! It sounds like you're interested in playing Super Kid Adventure, an online game similar to Super Mario. To play, you'll need to jump on platforms, avoid obstacles and spikes, and defeat enemies. Don't forget to collect stars along the way! The game has 25 levels for you to explore, so there's plenty of adventure to be had.

title: TearDown - Destruction SandBox
description:
The player is given complete freedom of action. You can explore various locations filled with structures. The main feature of the game is the ability to destroy everything you see.

Have you ever wanted to level a multi-storey house with your own hands? Now you have the opportunity to do just that! The physics of destruction is close to reality. You can use a variety of weapons to destroy objects, from a hammer to a powerful bazooka.

title: Gin Rummy Mania
description: Gin Rummy Mania is the ultimate classic card game experience, now available in a solo mode against a smart AI opponent. Form sets and runs, knock or go gin to score points, and enjoy hours of strategic gameplay as you master this timeless card game.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fruit Connect 3
description: Get ready for a tropical twist in Fruit Connect 3 – the juicy sequel to the popular fruit-matching puzzle series! This vibrant new chapter brings even more summer vibes, exotic fruits, and relaxing gameplay that fans love. Collect daily rewards, participate in limited-time summer events, and unlock fresh, fruity designs along the way. It’s a fun, family-friendly Mahjong-style connect game for all ages – no download required!

title: Tap To Color: Painting Book
description:
Unleash your inner artist and paint your stress away with Tap to Color: Painting Book Game! Dive into a vibrant world of color where creating a masterpiece is as simple as a single tap. Forget the mess of crayons and paints; this is the ultimate digital coloring book for all ages.

Find your calm and enter a state of flow as you bring beautiful illustrations to life. It’s the perfect way to relax after a long day, pass the time on your commute,

title: Elite Chess
description: Enjoy classic gameplay with three chess modes, each offering varying time settings suited to your play style. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond, and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Unicorn Princess Dress Up
description: Welcome to Unicorn Princess Dress Up, a casual girl dress-up game online. Dive into a fashion world where you design fashionable clothing, create trendy hairstyles, and produce perfect eye makeup. Unleash your creativity and talents in fashion design to make your princess doll charming and beautiful!

title: Fruit Catcher
description:
Catch as many fruits as you can before they fall! ?
Move your basket left and right to collect fresh fruits and avoid rotten ones. Each fruit gives you points — how high can your score go?
This fun and colorful game tests your reflexes and speed. Perfect for kids and casual players who love simple but addictive gameplay!

title: Deep Fishing
description: Dive into the fun with Deep Fishing! Explore the deep blue, cast your line, and reel in a variety of exciting fish species. Upgrade your gear, unlock rare catches, and become the ultimate fishing legend! Easy to pick up, but hard to put down – can you score the rarest fish and show off your skills?

title: Arrow Escape
description: Arrow Escape is a puzzle game that delivers fast-paced, strategic challenges for players who enjoy logic-driven gameplay and intense escape scenarios. Each level is a tricky arrow maze puzzle where you must carefully study the arrow paths and decide which arrow to tap first in order to clear the board.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Loop Ghost
description: Time loop puzzle: ghosts of your past cycles automatically repeat your moves. Use them to press buttons, open passages, and escape together.

title: Chaos Road Combat Car Racing
description: Chaos Road: Combat Car Racing plays like a shoot-em-up car shooting arcade game. With 3D vehicles on the ground, your mission is to defeat the final boss by collecting upgrade items and shooting down vehicles on the ground. Your vehicle will keep shooting automatically. Don't forget to collect the magnet to collect all kinds of items easily. To defeat the final boss, you need to avoid its bullets and keep shooting. Have fun!

title: Hole Eat Grow Attack
description:
Eat objects, and ammos, and attack other holes around. Two unique game modes, time attack and infinite modes are waiting for you. Let your hole battle begin in the arena against the other holes.

The game consists of two levels Time Attack and Infinite. There are more than 20 characters. You can play the game either in single-player mode or in 2 player mode. Pick your hole fighter and start the game. You can activate player 2 with keys. Make sure you avoid larger-hole enemies around.

title: Thread Sort
description: Thread Sort is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game where you organize colorful threads on spools and turn them into beautiful cross-stitched pictures. Sort mixed threads by color, clear the pegs, and watch as neatly arranged strands automatically stitch a charming image on the canvas. With cozy visuals, smooth animations, and simple controls, Thread Sort is perfect for fans of sorting puzzles, knitting games, and calming casual challenges.

title: Stick War Saga
description: Prepare for an epic clash in Stick War: Saga, an exciting blend of fighting, action, strategy, and tower defense. Take command of your stickman army and lead them through nervous war campaigns. Mine resources, build your army, and unleash your strategic power to conquer enemy lands.

title: SCP 173 Escape
description: Step into the role of SCP-173 and break free from the Foundation’s control in a tense stealth experience built around a deadly rule: you can MOVE only when no one is LOOKING at you. Hide in the shadows, avoid patrols, and choose the perfect moment to dash through dark corridors where every mistake leads to capture.

title: Golf Mini
description: Golf Mini is a fun and addictive game in which your goal is to get the ball to the hole in the minimum number of strokes. Complete levels, each of which is a unique golf course with various obstacles and traps.

title: Merge Tower Hero
description: Dive into Merge Tower Hero, an exhilarating online puzzle - Merge game that sharpens your mathematical thinking while exhilaratingly combining action, strategy, and combat. Assemble your team and tackle challenging battles that require not only strength but clever gameplay strategies to prevail!

title: Max Mixed Cocktails
description: Do you want to become a master mixologist? Create cocktails by blending ingredients at the bar. Choose your ingredients, mix them skillfully, and sample the concoction. You'll reach a delightful conclusion by discovering the perfect recipe. Utilize clues in the collections to unlock different endings.

title: Cubidle

title: Tap It Away 3D
description: Tap It Away 3D is a fun and relaxing 3D block puzzle game. Tap the arrows to move and clear blocks, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and plan your moves carefully as blocks can block each other. Enjoy smooth, stress-free gameplay with no time limits. Play this free online puzzle game to relax, sharpen your logic, and train your brain anytime.

title: Idle Barber Shop
description: Play Idle Barber Shop free online and run your own salon in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Hire barbers, upgrade stations, style fresh cuts, and grow profits in a smart tycoon experience that feels like a light brain game of strategy and timing. This unblocked game works smoothly at school or home, is fully mobile-friendly, and runs perfectly on desktop and mobile. A free online game made for quick breaks and relaxing play.

title: Bubble Shooter Ultimate
description: Bubble shooter ultimate is a classic bubble shooter game with a modern twist. Each level-up you get to chose a power up like a change to get a bomb or rainbow bubble and more. Create combinations of three or more matching bubbles by launching bubbles of the same color at them. The more bubbles you pop in a single shot, the higher your score. If you miss a match 5 times, the playing field moves down by one row. The objective is to score as many points as possible while clearing all the bubbles!

title: Guess Word
description: Guess Word is a free online puzzle and word game for boys played on PuzzleGame. It's easy to play. You have six chances to guess words. The letter you guessed will change color to give you a hint. This tests your vocabulary. The game is simple and very suitable for players of all ages. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable! We have three modes for you. Challenge yourself!

title: Sort Game Toy Sort
description: Enjoy some adorable sorting fun in Sort Game: Toy Sort. This delightful match 3 puzzle and casual sort game challenges you to organize colorful dolls and toys. Match and eliminate all dolls within the limited time. When you encounter difficulties, use items to help you quickly clear the level. Such as Convert, Eliminate, Refresh or Break.

title: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits
description: Dive into Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits! Combine fruit balls in this unique blend of 2048 and billiards. Enjoy ASMR sounds, complete juicy levels, and compete with others. Master your merging skills and embark on a fun fruit-filled adventure today!

title: Chicken Banana Run
description: Explore the World and Space with the famous Chicken Banana! Run and keep running to collect gold, diamonds and special items and finish with the longest distance to get a high score! Play now the new free runner game for everyone.

title: Space Survivor
description: Jump right into the action, fighting dangerous aliens and executing amazing maneuvers! Sharpen your weapons and skills, you will need them to last as long as possible.

title: Murder Mystery
description: Murder Mystery – A fast-paced social deduction game. One player is the killer, another the sheriff, the rest are innocents. Use logic, stealth, and quick decisions to survive or expose the murderer. Perfect for high engagement and multiplayer retention.

title: Pin Detective
description:
Welcome to Pin Detective - Mystery Mansion!
A rich woman mysteriously vanished in a lavish mansion that was covered by the rumors of ghosts and dangerous monsters. A talented detective is committed to uncovering the mystery.
By pulling the pin, you can collect clues that enlighten the truth. What happens to the billionaire? Why do the biological laboratory and so many alien animals exist in this mansion? Let’s use your brain to solve the puzzle to find it out.

title: The Roman Empire Colosseum
description: The war in the colosseum has never been as epic as in this game! Arrange your units and send them into battle! This online game is a battle simulator similar to Totally Accurate Battle Simulator. Your units include warriors, riders, titans, dwarves, mages, and more.

title: Crazy Zoo Monkey
description: Crazy Zoo Monkey is a chaotic sandbox romp where you step into the cage as a mischievous monkey and decide how to handle curious visitors. You grab, throw, eat, or smash whatever’s nearby while humans react in funny, friendly, or aggressive ways.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Scary Shawarma Kiosk: The Anomaly
description: This is a first-person psychological horror game where you work night shifts in a small street kiosk. What seems like a normal job quickly turns into a nightmare: customers grow increasingly strange, and reality itself begins to warp. Some people just want to eat — others are only pretending to be human.

title: Sheep Sheep Duck
description: Sheep Sheep Duck is a very novel casual multiplayer party interactive game. You are free to choose and match the battle scenarios to your liking. The game has all kinds of cool scenes. You can control the game character flexibly by tapping directly on the screen, and take more challenges here. Show off your ability to defeat more enemies in this game, so you can get more weapons. You can challenge yourself better with great strength, so you can unlock new game maps.

title: 100 Doors Challenge
description:
Do you like puzzles and hidden object games? Do you play games from the 100 Doors series? Then this point-and-click game is just what you need! Use all your skills to complete all levels and get all achievements.
The main goal in the "100 Doors Challenge" is to get out of the room. Using all the capabilities of the device, you need to open each of the 100 doors and move the elevator to the next floor. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and use objects to do it!

description:
Crazy Zombies 3D is a fast-paced top-down zombie survival shooter with cartoon-style 3D graphics. Use 10+ weapons to fight endless waves of zombies, conquer a town map, and unlock powerful upgrades. Battle 5 zombie types and 4 deadly bosses with unique abilities. Customize your loadout and survive as long as you can. Fun, intense, and addictive—can you survive the apocalypse?

description: Prepare for a zombie showdown in Zombie Idle Defense! In this exciting idle defense game, you will be the last line of defense against wave after wave of zombie attacks! Build your defenses,upgrade your weapons, put your automatic turrets on fire, and fight off the undead!

title: Gear Factory
description: Gear Factory is an idle and incremental game where you build a coin-generating machine out of interlocking gears. You start with a single spinning center gear on a small grid and grow your factory into a massive, multi-tiered engine of wealth.

title: Duck Luck
description:
Guide a lovable duck and his humorous friend and drop numbered blocks that merge when identical numbers come into contact, creating larger numbers that help clear the board. 
As you strategize and match numbers, you'll earn points. 
The goal is to accumulate the highest score possible by making as big of a number as you can.
